summary_en.core_problem: Prefix KV caching is effective within a GPU or a node, but large-scale multi-node serving misses many reuse opportunities and can overload the nodes that hold popular prefixes.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but practical: long-context and retrieval-heavy deployments increasingly depend on prefix reuse, and the cost model changes when KV cache becomes a distributed storage and replication problem. The paper is useful for understanding the trade-off among cache granularity, metadata lookup cost, hot-prefix replication, memory capacity, and network bandwidth.
summary_en.technical_approach: PTStore treats reusable KV-cache prefixes as distributed tensor objects, following a CDN-like design. The first idea is fine-grained tensor-level incremental storage, so common prefixes can be shared while divergent continuations grow without redundant copies, similar to a trie. The second idea is consolidated metadata, which allows one-shot prefix lookup instead of walking a distributed trie hop by hop. The third idea is popularity-aware replication of hot prefixes, improving locality and reducing load imbalance at the cost of controlled redundancy. The system is positioned as a distributed prefix-cache layer that can integrate with existing LLM serving runtimes rather than replacing them.
summary_en.experiments: The reported headline result is a 5–6x efficiency gain on long-passage question-answering workloads compared with baselines that do not aggregate KV-cache memory across nodes and GPUs and therefore often regenerate reusable prefixes. The paper also reports reduced I/O overhead and lower end-to-end runtime under concurrent serving. The provided text does not include the full experimental tables, so the cluster size, model size, prompt length distribution, cache hit rate, and bandwidth numbers should be checked in Section 6.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Read Section 4 first for the design principles and the abstraction of a distributed prefix tensor store. Then read Section 5 for the metadata layout, prefix-query path, replication policy, and runtime integration. Section 6 is mainly for validating whether the reported gains come from higher cache hit rate, lower I/O cost, or better load balance. For pretraining researchers, the most useful part is the deployment cost implication for long-context models and prefix-heavy workloads.

recommendation.zh: 分布式前缀KV缓存的系统实现，思路借鉴CDN直观合理，长上下文服务场景可参考其架构设计，重点看§3的系统架构。
recommendation.en: Practical distributed prefix KV caching system borrowing CDN ideas; refer to Section 3 for architecture design when building long-context serving systems.

paper.title: LOCKS: Page-Local Compact Key Summaries for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
paper.abstract: Serving large language models at long context is bottlenecked by the key-value (KV) cache, which is read in full at every decode step. Attention keys are locally low-rank though globally high-rank: shared low-rank bases discard page-specific directions that a page's own compact basis retains. LOCKS gives every page its own spectral summary (resident, about a tenth the cache's size), reconstructs within-page logits, estimates each page's attention mass by log-sum-exp, and attends only the top pag

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM推理时每步解码都需要全量读取KV缓存，KV读取带宽成为长上下文高并发服务的核心瓶颈。现有页面级稀疏注意力的摘要方法存在三类局限：要么仅保留粗粒度统计信息、要么跨页共享投影存在内容盲区、要么需要训练代理模型，无法在极低读取预算下精准筛选高注意力质量的页面。
summary.importance: 为长上下文推理优化提供了可落地的工程参考，验证了注意力键的页内低秩特性，提出的无需训练的页局部谱摘要思路是KV缓存稀疏化方向的有效技术路径，且直接以vLLM插件形式实现，工程复用性强。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是为每个KV页面单独构造秩为8的谱特征基（页局部PCA），作为页面的紧凑摘要，体积约为原KV页面的1/10。解码时仅读取各页摘要，通过重建页内logit并计算log-sum-exp估计每页的注意力质量，仅选择top-k页面读取完整KV，选择过程无需读取任何候选页的原始键值。针对GQA分组注意力设计了共享平均的页面选择规则，整体作为vLLM的注意力后端插件实现，页面基在页面写满时通过一次小型特征分解生成，解码步骤融合进CUDA图。
summary.experiments: 在Llama-3.1 8B模型上测试，LongBench-v1长文档QA任务上性能损失不到1个点；RULER检索密集任务上，即使在极小的token预算下，效果也接近读取全部KV的oracle基线；作为drop-in插件集成进vLLM，实现了长上下文端到端推理加速。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，重点看第3章关于页局部低秩特性的理论分析（命题1、定理1）和第5章的vLLM集成实现细节，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。如果从事KV缓存优化研究，可以重点关注其页面选择的logit重建方法和消融实验。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context LLM decoding requires reading the full KV cache at every step, making KV read bandwidth the primary bottleneck for high-concurrency long-context serving. Existing page-level sparse attention summary methods have three limitations: they only retain coarse-grained statistics, have content blind spots from cross-page shared projections, or require trained surrogate models, failing to accurately select high-attention-mass pages under very tight read budgets.
summary_en.importance: Provides actionable engineering reference for long-context inference optimization. It validates the within-page low-rank property of attention keys, proposes a training-free page-local spectral summary approach as an effective path for KV cache sparsification, and ships as a production-ready vLLM plugin with strong reusability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a rank-8 spectral basis (page-local PCA) for each individual KV page as a compact summary, with roughly 1/10 the size of the original page cache. During decoding, only page summaries are read; within-page logits are reconstructed to estimate per-page attention mass via log-sum-exp, and only top-k pages are fetched for full attention computation — the selection step reads no raw keys or values from candidate pages. A shared-average rule is designed for GQA group attention, and the system is implemented as a drop-in attention backend plugin for vLLM, with page bases computed via a small eigendecomposition when a page is filled, and decode steps fused into CUDA graphs.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Llama-3.1 8B. On LongBench-v1 long-document QA, performance drops by less than 1 point compared to full cache. On retrieval-dense RULER benchmarks, it tracks the read-every-key oracle even at the smallest token budgets. Integrated as a drop-in vLLM plugin, it delivers end-to-end long-context inference speedups.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read. Focus on Section 3 for theoretical analysis of page-local low-rank properties (Proposition 1, Theorem 1) and Section 5 for vLLM integration details; estimated reading time 20-30 minutes. For KV cache optimization researchers, the logit reconstruction method for page selection and ablation studies are worth closer examination.

recommendation.zh: KV选择类工作中少有的干净设计，局部低秩/全局高秩的观察对长上下文架构设计有参考，只看§3方法和长推理结果即可
recommendation.en: A clean KV-selection design whose local-low-rank/global-high-rank observation informs long-context architecture design; focus on §3 and the long-reasoning results.

paper.title: KAP: Bridging the Knowledge Selection-Runtime Consumption Gap in LLM Systems
paper.abstract: Modern LLM systems increasingly rely on knowledge-selection processes that produce high-value structured priors, such as ranked evidence, graph topology, multimodal alignment, and confidence signals. Yet LLM serving remains fundamentally oblivious to this rich structure: once such signals are serialized into a prompt, the backend observes only a flat token sequence, forcing dense and uniform consumption of the full key-value (KV) state during decoding. We term this architectural mismatch the Kno

summary.core_problem: 现代LLM系统存在上游知识选择与下游服务运行时之间的架构不匹配（被命名为KSRC gap）：上游知识选择流水线（如RAG重排序、GraphRAG的图结构遍历、置信度估计等）会产出丰富的结构化先验，但这些信息在prompt序列化阶段被压缩为扁平的token序列，后端serving系统只能无差别加载全部KV缓存进行解码，导致运行时成本随序列化后的上下文长度线性增长，而非随推理实际需要的知识量增长。随着知识选择能力增强、上下文规模扩大，这一不匹配会愈发严重。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有三点：1. 长上下文预训练的性能收益需要与推理运行时效率协同设计，单纯扩大上下文窗口会被线性增长的解码成本抵消，无法充分释放价值；2. 预训练目标可考虑将结构化知识先验（重要性、图结构、置信度等）直接编码进模型表示，而非完全依赖prompt序列化传递，有望同时提升推理质量与效率；3. 长上下文预训练数据的价值评估应结合运行时知识消费模式，而非仅看原始上下文长度下的性能表现。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Knowledge Access Planning（KAP）范式，采用编译器-执行器的拆分架构，引入统一的中间表示「运行时访问计划」，解耦逻辑prompt语义与物理KV缓存访问。KAP编译器将上游知识选择产出的高维结构化先验（排序结果、图拓扑、多模态对齐信号、置信度等）编译为该中间表示，KAP执行器则根据计划控制后端KV缓存的物理访问，全程无需修改知识选择前端、语言模型本身或逻辑prompt结构。论文还给出了一个具体实例GraphSpec，以GraphRAG为知识选择前端、vLLM为服务后端，将图结构先验编译为访问计划，指导后端选择性消费知识，同时保留全上下文验证能力。
summary.experiments: 本次提供的论文片段未包含完整实验结果。根据文中提及的内容，后续将通过GraphSpec实例验证其服务效率与回答质量的平衡，并在第4节从分析和实证层面支撑一项缩放原则：当知识选择的选择性提升且能保持执行保真度时，LLM服务的物理成本可随上下文长度亚线性缩放。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可重点关注第1节中KSRC gap的定义与问题背景，以及第2节中KAP范式的核心设计思路。关注系统实现的读者可查看第3节GraphSpec与vLLM的适配细节，关注缩放理论的读者可查看第4节的亚线性缩放原则分析。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern LLM systems face an architectural mismatch termed the Knowledge Selection–Runtime Consumption (KSRC) gap. Upstream knowledge selection pipelines (e.g., RAG reranking, GraphRAG graph traversal, confidence estimation) produce rich structured priors, but these are collapsed into a flat token sequence during prompt serialization. The serving backend only sees a linear token stream and loads the full KV-cache uniformly during decoding, so runtime cost scales with serialized context length rather than the small fraction of context actually needed for reasoning. This mismatch worsens as knowledge selection becomes more sophisticated and context grows longer.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this work delivers three actionable implications: 1. Long-context pretraining gains require co-design with serving runtime efficiency; simply expanding context window size is offset by linear growth in decoding cost, preventing full realization of performance improvements. 2. Pretraining objectives could be adapted to encode structured knowledge priors (importance, graph structure, confidence) directly into model representations, rather than relying solely on prompt serialization, potentially improving both reasoning quality and inference efficiency. 3. The value of long-context pretraining data should be evaluated alongside runtime knowledge consumption patterns, not just raw context length performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Knowledge Access Planning (KAP), a plan-driven paradigm for runtime knowledge consumption built on a compiler-executor split. A universal intermediate representation called the runtime access plan decouples logical prompt semantics from physical KV-cache access. The KAP compiler translates high-dimensional structured priors from upstream systems (ranked evidence, graph topology, multimodal alignment, confidence scores) into this IR, while the KAP executor interprets the plan to control physical KV access in the serving backend. No changes are required to the knowledge selection frontend, the language model itself, or the logical prompt structure. As a concrete instantiation, GraphSpec implements KAP for GraphRAG frontends and vLLM backends, compiling graph-derived priors into access plans that guide selective KV consumption while retaining full-context verification capability.
summary_en.experiments: The provided paper fragment does not include full experimental results. The work states it will evaluate GraphSpec's serving efficiency and answer quality in Section 5, and provides both analytical and empirical grounding in Section 4 for a scaling principle: when knowledge selection becomes more selective while preserving execution fidelity, the physical cost of LLM serving can scale sublinearly with context length.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, focus on Section 1 for the formal definition of the KSRC gap and problem background, and the core KAP paradigm design in Section 2. Readers interested in system implementation can review Section 3 for GraphSpec's vLLM integration details, while those focused on scaling theory can check Section 4 for the sublinear scaling principle analysis. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 想法对长上下文 serving 有用；只看系统抽象和 KV traffic 实测，若无端到端数字就当概念稿。
recommendation.en: Useful for long-context serving design; read the abstraction and KV-traffic measurements, but treat it as conceptual if end-to-end numbers are missing.

paper.title: Kalypso: Relational LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as semantic operators for filtering, extracting, ranking, joining, and transforming unstructured data. Existing semantic query processing systems invoke request-centric LLM serving systems that are unaware of the query plan, leaving substantial performance opportunities unused. This paper introduces relational LLM serving, an abstraction that makes LLM serving aware of semantic query structure while preserving query semantics and output accuracy. The k

summary.core_problem: 现有请求中心化的LLM服务系统无法感知语义查询的算子计划结构，导致多算子流水线场景下KV缓存复用率低、推理成本高。
summary.importance: 跨算子KV缓存复用的思路，为预训练阶段优化缓存友好的注意力架构、针对结构化查询类工作负载设计训练数据提供了下游约束参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出关系型LLM服务抽象，在语义查询处理系统与底层推理引擎之间新增一层感知完整查询计划的服务层。核心是利用语义算子流水线执行时中间元组直接传递的KV前缀复用机会，设计自适应内存感知调度器：为每个算子预留前缀缓存的内存预算，根据内存利用率动态调整并发算子数量，在避免前缀提前淘汰的同时保证GPU利用率。还定义了支持语义算子与查询计划的通用API，兼容现有语义查询系统的代理模型、向量索引等优化。与现有减少请求数或使用近似模型的优化不同，该方法从服务层本身优化，不改变查询语义与输出精度。
summary.experiments: 给定的全文内容未覆盖完整实验章节，暂无法提供具体性能指标。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读系统设计与调度算法章节，以及实验部分（如有）。重点理解跨算子KV缓存复用的调度约束，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing request-centric LLM serving systems lack visibility into semantic query operator plan structure, leading to low KV cache reuse rates and high inference costs in multi-operator pipeline scenarios.
summary_en.importance: The cross-operator KV cache reuse idea provides downstream constraint references for pre-training research, including optimizing cache-friendly attention architectures and designing training data for structured query workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the relational LLM serving abstraction, a new layer between semantic query processing systems and underlying inference engines that has full visibility into the complete query plan. The core insight is that pipelined execution of semantic operators enables KV prefix reuse when intermediate tuples are passed directly between operators. An adaptive memory-aware scheduler reserves memory budgets for each operator's prefix cache, and dynamically adjusts concurrent operator count to avoid premature prefix eviction while maintaining GPU utilization. It also defines a general API for semantic operators and query plans, compatible with existing SQPS optimizations such as proxy models and vector indexes. Unlike prior optimizations that reduce request count or use approximate models, this approach optimizes serving itself without altering query semantics or output accuracy.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text does not cover the complete experimental section, so specific performance metrics are not available from the given content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the system design and scheduling algorithm sections, plus the experimental section if available. Focus on understanding the scheduling constraints of cross-operator KV cache reuse. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做 LLM serving / 批量数据处理系统的人看调度问题建模即可；KV-cache 跨调用复用的思路对长文档批量抽取有参考，预训练侧无关。
recommendation.en: Relevant if you build LLM serving or batch data-processing stacks — the cross-operator KV reuse idea matters for bulk extraction; irrelevant to pretrain.

paper.title: Benchmarking Confidential GPU Inference on NVIDIA H100 under Intel TDX
paper.abstract: Confidential computing is becoming a practical deployment requirement for AI inference workloads that process sensitive inputs or protect proprietary model assets. However, the performance cost of enabling confidential execution for GPU-accelerated large language model serving remains workload dependent and operationally important. This paper presents a benchmark study comparing standard non-confidential execution with confidential computing mode on a single NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU hosted in an Int

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文回答一个部署问题：在 Intel TDX confidential instance 上使用 NVIDIA H100 做 LLM 推理时，相比普通非机密模式，需要付出多少延迟和吞吐损失。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，也没有提出新的模型或推理算法。它的价值在工程容量规划：如果企业推理需要保护用户 prompt、检索上下文、模型输出或模型资产，confidential GPU inference 的开销必须被量化。对基座研究员的间接启发在于，安全执行环境会改变 serving budget，进而影响模型尺寸、MoE 激活参数量、KV-cache 策略和批处理策略的选择。
summary.technical_approach: 论文做的是受控系统 benchmark。硬件环境为 Google Cloud us-central1-a 的 a3-highgpu-1g：26 vCPU、234 GB 内存、单张 NVIDIA H100 80GB、250 GB balanced persistent disk；机密执行路径使用 Intel TDX。模型选择 Mistral-7B v0.1 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B，分别代表较小 dense LLM 和更大的 MoE 变体。实验分两类：固定 request rate 下测 TTFT、端到端延迟、单请求 token throughput、全局 token throughput；闭环并发下固定 N 个 in-flight requests，测 request throughput、p50 TTFT 和 p50 latency。论文也明确说明 Secure Boot 在该设置中关闭，因此结果只代表被测 confidential instance 的性能行为，不构成完整安全配置声明。
summary.experiments: 固定请求率实验中，Mistral-7B 使用 10.0 requests/s，Qwen3-30B-A3B 使用 5.0 requests/s。Mistral-7B 在 confidential mode 下平均 TTFT 从 279.56 增至 340.64，开销 21.8%；平均请求延迟从 314.72 增至 381.04，开销 21.1%；全局吞吐 gap 为 17.7%。Qwen3-30B-A3B 的平均 TTFT 从 394.61 增至 504.35，开销 27.8%；平均请求延迟从 414.51 增至 527.18，开销 27.2%；全局吞吐 gap 为 21.1%。论文还指出，在闭环并发实验中，大模型在 confidential mode 下更早进入饱和区间。当前结果没有 p90/p99 尾延迟，因此对线上 SLA 的判断还不完整。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 10 到 15 分钟。重点看 Experimental Setup，确认硬件、云实例、TDX 模式、模型和负载生成方式；再看 Fixed Request-Rate Results 中的 TTFT、latency 和 throughput gap。闭环并发部分适合做容量规划参考，尤其要看饱和点如何随 confidential mode 和模型规模变化。如果关注预训练或模型结构，可只保留一个结论：安全执行环境会带来约 20% 到 30% 量级的固定性能折损，较大模型在单卡 serving 中更容易提前受限。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper quantifies the performance cost of confidential GPU inference for LLM serving on an NVIDIA H100 hosted in an Intel TDX confidential instance, compared with a standard non-confidential setup.
summary_en.importance: This is a deployment benchmark, not a pretraining or modeling paper. Its practical value is capacity planning for deployments that need to protect sensitive prompts, private retrieval context, model outputs, or proprietary model assets. For foundation-model researchers, the indirect implication is that confidential execution changes the serving budget, which can affect model-size choices, MoE activation budgets, KV-cache policy, and batching strategy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study runs controlled benchmarks on a Google Cloud a3-highgpu-1g machine with 26 vCPUs, 234 GB RAM, one NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU, and Intel TDX confidential instance mode. It compares non-confidential execution and confidential execution using Mistral-7B v0.1 and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Two load patterns are used. The fixed-rate benchmark reports TTFT, end-to-end latency, per-request token throughput, and global token throughput. The closed-loop benchmark keeps a fixed number of in-flight requests and measures request throughput, p50 TTFT, and p50 latency. The paper notes that Secure Boot was disabled, so the results characterize the measured performance configuration rather than a complete security posture.
summary_en.experiments: In the fixed request-rate benchmark, Mistral-7B is tested at 10.0 requests/s and Qwen3-30B-A3B at 5.0 requests/s. For Mistral-7B, confidential mode increases average TTFT from 279.56 to 340.64, a 21.8% overhead, and average request latency from 314.72 to 381.04, a 21.1% overhead. The global throughput gap is 17.7%. For Qwen3-30B-A3B, average TTFT increases from 394.61 to 504.35, a 27.8% overhead, and average request latency from 414.51 to 527.18, a 27.2% overhead. The global throughput gap is 21.1%. The closed-loop benchmark indicates that the larger model reaches saturation at a lower concurrency level under confidential mode. The artifact does not include p90 or p99 tail latency, which limits direct SLA interpretation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 10–15 minute skim is sufficient. Read the experimental setup to verify the instance type, TDX configuration, model choices, and load-generation protocol. Then inspect the fixed request-rate results for TTFT, latency, and throughput gaps. The closed-loop concurrency section is useful for capacity planning because it exposes saturation behavior. For readers focused on model research, the main takeaway is that confidential execution introduces a roughly 20–30% performance penalty in this setup, and the larger model becomes capacity-limited earlier on a single H100.

recommendation.zh: 只看延迟分解和并发曲线；它不会改变训练 recipe，但会约束企业场景下的模型尺寸和 serving 预算。
recommendation.en: Read the latency breakdown and concurrency curves; it will not change training recipes, but it constrains model size and serving budgets for enterprise deployment.

paper.title: FineServe: A Fine-Grained Dataset and Characterization of Global LLM Serving Workloads
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as always-on online services, making efficient LLM serving a critical systems challenge. Achieving low latency and high throughput under volatile demand requires deep understanding of real-world serving workloads, yet existing studies often rely on proxy traces or coarse-grained characterizations that fail to capture the heterogeneity of modern multi-model LLM platforms. We present FineServe, an in-the-wild, multi-model LLM serving workload

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM serving负载研究依赖代理轨迹或粗粒度特征，无法捕捉现代多模型LLM平台的异构性，导致serving优化缺乏真实数据支撑。
summary.importance: 发布来自全球商业平台的细粒度多模型LLM serving工作负载数据集，系统分析真实负载的动态特征，属于系统测量与数据贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 从全球商业LLM市场收集真实多模型服务轨迹，细粒度刻画请求到达动态、token行为等特征，分析不同模型架构、规模、任务意图下的波动模式差异，基于此开发模型感知的负载生成器。
summary.experiments: 基于真实商业负载数据，揭示不同模型、任务下的波动机制差异，负载生成器可组合细粒度模型感知的工作负载。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM serving workload studies rely on proxy traces or coarse-grained characterizations, failing to capture the heterogeneity of modern multi-model LLM platforms and leaving serving optimizations without real-world data support.
summary_en.importance: Releases a fine-grained multi-model LLM serving workload dataset from a global commercial platform, systematically characterizes real workload dynamics, contributing to system measurement and public data resources.
summary_en.technical_approach: Collects real multi-model serving traces from a global commercial LLM marketplace, finely characterizes request arrival dynamics and token behavior, analyzes fluctuation regime differences across model architectures, scales, and task intents, and develops a model-aware workload generator based on the insights.
summary_en.experiments: Based on real commercial workload data, reveals distinct fluctuation mechanisms across models and tasks; the workload generator can compose fine-grained model-aware workloads for serving evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 真实LLM serving负载的特征分析对预训练的任务配比、上下文设计有弱参考价值，仅需了解负载异构性结论即可。
recommendation.en: Real LLM serving workload characterization provides weak reference for pretraining task mixture and context design; only skim the heterogeneity findings.

paper.title: Beyond Accuracy and Cost: Latency-Aware LLM Query Routing for Dynamic Workloads
paper.abstract: Modern language query routers improve inference efficiency by assigning each query to a model that balances response quality and monetary cost. However, current query routers are largely latency-agnostic and do not consider the generation latency experienced by queries at model instances. In practice, latency is often controlled by load-balancing policies such as round-robin or join-the-shortest-queue, which do not account for model accuracy or inference cost. Incorporating query latency into ro

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很实际但常被拆开看的问题：在多模型、多实例的 LLM 服务池里，查询路由不能只看质量和价格，还要显式考虑请求到达时各实例的实时负载，以及连续批处理下 prefill/decode 混合工作负载带来的时延变化。现有 query router 大多把 latency 当成系统层的事，先选模型，再让 serving 框架做负载均衡；而系统层方法又默认模型选择已固定，不关心准确率和成本。论文要解决的，就是把 accuracy、cost、latency 三者放进同一个路由决策里，而且 latency 不是静态表格值，而是依赖当前队列状态、输出长度、batching/scheduling 策略和实例异构性的动态量。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但对大模型训练—部署闭环有直接启发。第一，很多关于模型大小、蒸馏、MoE、长输出偏好、推理 token 分布的研究，最终都要落到 serving 代价和时延上；这篇工作给出了一种把“模型能力差异”和“系统负载状态”联合建模的方式。第二，它提醒一个常被忽略的事实：同样的模型，在不同 serving policy 和 workload composition 下，用户感知 latency 差异很大，因此只用离线 token/s 成本近似在线服务质量是不够的。第三，这类 latency-aware routing 会反过来影响预训练和后训练阶段的模型族设计：如果一个小模型在轻载时很划算，但在 decode-heavy 场景下吞吐退化明显，那么模型池配置、蒸馏目标、甚至输出长度控制策略都应一起考虑。贡献量级更接近“系统与模型选择接口”的扎实推进，而不是范式变化。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个联合优化框架，加一个轻量级 latency estimator。路由器对每个到达请求，不再只预测“发给哪个模型最可能答对、花多少钱”，还要预测“发到某个具体实例后会经历多长 TTFT/生成延迟”。难点在于 latency 不是 query 的静态属性，而是实例状态相关的。作者提出 Serving Framework Simulation, SFS 估计器：它显式模拟 autoregressive serving 中 token batch 的演化，跟踪实例上当前正在服务的请求在 prefill 和 decode 两个阶段的工作量，并把底层 serving framework 的 admission、batching、scheduling 规则纳入估计。这个设计比只用 prompt length、expected output length 或简单队列长度做回归更细，因为连续批处理下，prefill 是算力受限、decode 更偏带宽/内存受限，两者混合比例会改变新请求插入后的等待时间。

从论文给出的描述看，整体框架大致包含三部分：1）已有 accuracy/cost router 提供 query-to-model 的质量与价格估计；2）SFS 根据每个实例当前活跃请求集合、预估输出长度、硬件与模型配置，模拟未来若干 token iteration，得到新请求的 latency estimate；3）路由目标在满足 latency 约束或惩罚 latency 的前提下，选择最优模型实例。这里一个关键点是，它不是把 latency 当成训练时学出来的黑盒回归值，而是利用 serving mechanics 做结构化估计，因此更容易迁移到不同 batching policy 或异构实例组合。

和最接近的 prior work 相比，区别主要在 latency 建模粒度。已有方法会用输出长度或平均服务时间近似延迟，但没有显式区分 prefill/decode，也不跟踪实例当前 workload composition。作者这里把 serving framework policy 放进 estimator，意味着路由器知道“同样一个请求，发到 decode backlog 重的实例”和“发到 prefill 较空的实例”后果不同。这一点对长输出任务尤其关键。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见的重点，实验主要验证三件事：一是 latency estimator 的准确性；二是联合路由在 accuracy-cost-latency 三维上的收益；三是相对 latency-agnostic router 和纯系统负载均衡策略的优势。论文强调其方法在动态 workload 下优于两类基线：一类是只做 accuracy/cost 权衡的 query router，另一类是 round-robin、join-the-shortest-queue 这类不看模型质量和价格的负载均衡方法。

摘要截断，全文片段里没有完整数字表，但从实验设计可以确定作者评估了 TTFT 或相关 latency 指标，并在不同 serving framework policy、不同请求长度分布、不同实例负载条件下比较。值得注意的是，论文把 estimator 设计成 lightweight simulation，而不是高开销离散事件仿真器，说明实验里应当同时报告了在线路由可行性。若精读全文，建议重点核对：1）latency prediction error 在不同 workload regime 下是否稳定；2）accuracy 或 utility 提升是否来自更好的模型选择，而不是单纯把请求推给空闲实例；3）在高负载和长输出场景下，相比简单 queue-based heuristic 的收益是否更明显；4）是否分析了 output length prediction 误差对最终路由效果的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但方法部分值得看细一点。优先看 Introduction 和问题定义，先确认作者到底优化的是 TTFT、总延迟，还是带约束的综合效用。然后直接看 latency estimator 那一节，重点抓三件事：它如何表示实例状态；如何模拟 continuous batching 下 token batch 的推进；如何把 serving policy 编进估计器。实验部分建议重点看 latency estimation accuracy、主结果表，以及 workload shift 或 ablation。若时间有限，30-40 分钟足够把主线读清。若想深挖，值得思考两个延伸点：一是这种结构化 estimator 能否反向用于训练时的 system-aware data curriculum 或 output-length regularization；二是如果模型池里包含 MoE、长上下文模型或 speculative decoding，不同 serving mechanics 下 estimator 需要改哪些状态变量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical gap in LLM serving: query routing across a pool of models and replicas should not optimize only quality and monetary cost, but also the latency a request will actually experience under dynamic load. Existing query routers are mostly latency-agnostic, while system-level load balancers assume the model choice is fixed and optimize only queueing or utilization. The core problem here is to make routing decisions over accuracy, cost, and latency jointly, where latency is not a static per-model number but a state-dependent quantity shaped by prompt length, output length, current prefill/decode workload, batching policy, scheduling policy, and hardware/model heterogeneity.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for foundation-model research at the train–serve interface. It makes a useful point: model-family design cannot be separated from serving behavior. A model that looks efficient in offline token-cost accounting may behave poorly under decode-heavy workloads or under a particular continuous batching policy. That has implications for distillation targets, model pool composition, output-length control, and even how one evaluates small-vs-large model tradeoffs. The contribution is best viewed as a solid systems-and-routing advance rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main idea is a joint routing framework augmented with a lightweight latency estimator. For each incoming query, the router combines three signals: expected response quality, monetary cost, and predicted latency at a specific model instance. The difficult part is latency estimation. Unlike cost, latency depends on the current state of the serving system. The paper proposes a Serving Framework Simulation (SFS) estimator that simulates the evolution of autoregressive token batches at each instance. It tracks active requests, separates prefill and decode work, and incorporates the batching/admission/scheduling behavior of the underlying serving framework.

This is a more structured approach than using prompt length, expected output length, or queue length alone. In modern continuous batching systems, prefill is typically compute-bound while decode is more memory-bandwidth-bound, and the mix of the two phases strongly affects how much delay a new request will see. The estimator therefore models not just how long a query is, but what kind of workload is already occupying the instance.

The overall routing pipeline appears to have three components: (1) an accuracy/cost predictor from prior query-routing work, (2) the SFS latency predictor conditioned on per-instance workload state and serving policy, and (3) a routing objective that selects the model instance under a latency-aware utility or constraint. A notable design choice is that latency is not treated as a pure black-box regression target. Instead, the estimator uses serving mechanics explicitly, which should make it more robust across different batching policies and heterogeneous deployments.

Relative to prior latency-aware routing work based mainly on output-length heuristics, the key difference is the explicit modeling of prefill/decode composition and current instance workload. That matters especially for long-generation queries, where decode backlog dominates user-visible delay.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story has three parts: estimator fidelity, end-to-end routing quality, and robustness under dynamic workloads. The paper reports that the latency-aware router achieves a better accuracy–cost–latency tradeoff than both latency-agnostic query routers and system-only load-balancing baselines such as round-robin or shortest-queue style policies.

The full numeric tables are not visible in the provided text, so I should avoid inventing exact values. Still, the evaluation clearly targets TTFT and related latency metrics under varying workload conditions, likely including different prompt/output length distributions, load levels, and serving policies. The important checks when reading the paper are: whether latency prediction error remains controlled across workload regimes; whether the gains come from genuinely better model-instance selection rather than simply avoiding busy replicas; whether the advantage widens in high-load or long-output settings; and how sensitive the router is to output-length prediction errors.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but the method section is worth reading carefully. Start with the problem formulation to see whether the optimization target is TTFT, end-to-end latency, or a constrained utility. Then go straight to the latency-estimation section and focus on three questions: how instance state is represented, how continuous batching is simulated, and how serving policies are encoded. In the experiments, prioritize the latency-estimation accuracy plots, the main routing comparison table, and any ablations under workload shift. Around 30–40 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If reading more deeply, a useful follow-up question is how this estimator would need to change for MoE models, long-context serving, or speculative decoding.

recommendation.zh: 只看 latency estimator 和 routing objective；它提醒模型路由实验若不模拟 decode 队列，结论会偏乐观。
recommendation.en: Read the latency estimator and routing objective; it is a useful reminder that routing results are optimistic if decode queues are ignored.

paper.title: Talaria: Session-Aware Serverless Serving of Hundred-Billion-Parameter LLMs
paper.abstract: Serverless multi-model LLM systems multiplex popularity-skewed model catalogs over shared GPU pools, yet typically schedule each request independently. Tool-using agents break this abstraction: a session repeatedly calls an LLM across short tool gaps, carries a long reusable KV prefix, and is judged by session completion time (SCT). Load-only routing can separate a continuation from both its model and KV state, while round-based model multiplexing can delay even a correctly placed continuation u

summary.core_problem: 现有无服务器多模型LLM服务按单请求调度，破坏了工具调用Agent会话的连续性，导致KV缓存丢失和会话完成时间（SCT）显著恶化。
summary.importance: 系统创新：首个面向百亿参数LLM的会话感知无服务器服务系统，联合处理放置与准入控制以保留KV局部性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Talaria系统，路由按模型驻留、KV局部性和实例压力排序放置；引入软预留机制预测会话短工具间隙后的返回请求，避免轮次复用导致的延迟；联合优化放置与准入决策。
summary.experiments: 面向百十亿参数LLM、工具调用Agent会话场景；对比负载优先路由和轮次复用调度，在长上下文KV和多模型混部条件下降低会话完成时间，提升GPU池利用率。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing serverless multi-model LLM serving schedules requests independently, breaking session continuity for tool-using agents and causing KV-cache loss and degraded session completion time (SCT).
summary_en.importance: Systems innovation: first session-aware serverless serving system for hundred-billion-parameter LLMs, jointly handling placement and admission control to preserve KV locality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents Talaria, whose router ranks placements by model residency, KV locality, and instance pressure; adds soft reservations to predict returning requests after short tool gaps, avoiding delays from round-based multiplexing; jointly optimizes placement and admission decisions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on hundred-billion-parameter LLMs with tool-using agent sessions; reduces SCT and improves GPU pool utilization under long-context KV and multi-model co-location compared to load-only routing and round-based multiplexing baselines.

recommendation.zh: 做推理服务或长上下文Agent部署的人重点看§3软预留和路由打分，KV局部性对SCT的收益比单纯扩显存更直接。
recommendation.en: For inference-serving or long-context agent deployment teams, focus on §3 soft reservations and the routing scorer — KV locality improves SCT more directly than raw memory scaling.

paper.title: FailureAtlas: A Taxonomy of Failure Modes in Multi-Provider LLM Serving Infrastructure
paper.abstract: Multi-provider LLM gateways reverse proxies that route, load-balance, and rate-limit requests across foundation-model APIs have become critical production infrastructure. Yet the failure modes specific to this architectural layer remain undocumented, scattered across issue trackers and post-mortems with no unifying framework. We introduce \fa{}, a two-axis taxonomy that classifies failures by their \emph{origin layer} (Network/Transport, Streaming/Protocol, State/Session, Model~Behavior, Governa

summary.core_problem: 多提供商 LLM 网关（反向代理）在生产环境中存在哪些特定的故障模式，且这些故障为何难以被传统监控发现？
summary.importance: 首次系统性地对多提供商 LLM 服务基础设施的故障模式进行了分类（FailureAtlas），揭示了最严重的故障往往是“静默”的，对构建高可用 LLM 服务系统具有重要工程指导价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个二维分类法（FailureAtlas），按“起源层”（网络/传输、流/协议、状态/会话、模型行为、治理/成本）和“可检测性”（显式 vs. 静默）对故障进行分类。通过分析公开的 bug 报告和第一手压力测试，提供了五个经过验证的目录条目及机械性根本原因分析。
summary.experiments: 提供了五个具体的故障案例分析，其中三个包含独立的复现脚本。主要发现是：操作上最严重的故障是“静默”的（返回 HTTP 200，通过标准健康检查，但会破坏应用状态）。

summary_en.core_problem: What are the specific failure modes of multi-provider LLM gateways (reverse proxies) in production, and why are they difficult to detect with traditional monitoring?
summary_en.importance: Provides the first systematic taxonomy (FailureAtlas) of failure modes in multi-provider LLM serving infrastructure, revealing that the most severe failures are often 'silent', offering crucial engineering guidance for building highly available LLM serving systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a two-axis taxonomy (FailureAtlas) classifying failures by 'origin layer' (Network/Transport, Streaming/Protocol, State/Session, Model Behavior, Governance/Cost) and 'detectability' (Loud vs. Silent). Populates this with five verified entries from public bug reports and first-hand stress testing, including mechanistic root-cause analyses.
summary_en.experiments: Presents five specific failure case studies, three with standalone reproduction scripts. The principal finding is that the most operationally severe failures are 'silent' (returning HTTP 200 and passing health checks while corrupting application state).

recommendation.zh: LLM Serving 基础设施的避坑指南，揭示了网关层面的“静默故障”（如 HTTP 200 但状态损坏），对负责部署和 API 封装的工程师极具参考价值。
recommendation.en: A pitfall guide for LLM Serving infrastructure, revealing 'silent failures' at the gateway level (e.g., HTTP 200 but corrupted state), highly valuable for engineers handling deployment and API wrapping.

paper.title: Cache-Aware Prompt Compression:A Two-Tier Cost Model for LLM API Caching
paper.abstract: Production LLM deployments combine two cost-reduction primitives: prompt caching (a discounted rate for re-used token prefixes) and prompt compression (fewer tokens sent). The compression literature has standardized on query-aware methods that produce a different compressed prefix per query, mechanically invalidating the prefix-strict cache on every call. We characterize this cost empirically on Anthropic's Sonnet 4.6 API and find caching is far from the rho=1.0 ideal the literature assumes: Son

summary.core_problem: 现有query-aware prompt压缩方法会破坏前缀缓存复用，未考虑商用LLM API缓存的非理想命中率带来的成本权衡
summary.importance: 首次实证刻画了商用LLM API的两层缓存架构特性，提出了兼顾压缩率和缓存命中率的推理成本优化方法
summary.technical_approach: 在Anthropic Sonnet 4.6 API上实测缓存命中率，建立两层成本模型，提出Cache-Aware Prompt Compression (CAPC)，结合query-agnostic压缩、显式cache_control和保层压缩率边界避免过度压缩
summary.experiments: 实测发现Sonnet缓存存在3500token阈值，低于该长度命中率约0.83；高压缩率(r>=6)下query-aware压缩优于纯缓存，CAPC可进一步降低总成本

summary_en.core_problem: Existing query-aware prompt compression methods break prefix cache reuse, failing to account for cost tradeoffs introduced by non-ideal hit rates in commercial LLM API caches
summary_en.importance: First empirical characterization of the two-tier cache architecture in commercial LLM APIs, proposes an inference cost optimization method balancing compression ratio and cache hit rate
summary_en.technical_approach: Measures cache hit rates on Anthropic Sonnet 4.6 API, builds a two-tier cost model, proposes Cache-Aware Prompt Compression (CAPC) combining query-agnostic compression, explicit cache control, and tier-preserving ratio bounds to avoid over-compression
summary_en.experiments: Finds Sonnet cache has a 3500-token threshold with ~0.83 hit rate for shorter prefixes; query-aware compression outperforms naive caching at r>=6, CAPC further reduces total cost

recommendation.zh: 商用API缓存特性的实测很扎实，做推理成本优化可参考，和预训练关联弱，只看成本模型部分即可
recommendation.en: Solid empirical measurement of commercial LLM cache behavior, useful for inference cost optimization, weak relevance to pretraining, only read the cost model section

paper.title: ContinuityBench: A Benchmark and Systems Study of Stateful Failover in Multi-Provider LLM Routing
paper.abstract: In production large language model (LLM) deployments, high API availability guarantees do not equate to conversational continuity. When a primary provider experiences an outage or strict rate-limiting, naive stateless failover mechanisms successfully maintain uptime but silently discard conversation history, severely disrupting the user experience. To rigorously quantify and resolve this failure mode, we introduce two novel metrics: Continuity Preservation Rate (CPR) and Continuity Latency Overh

summary.core_problem: 评估并缓解多 LLM provider 路由中的 failover 问题：API 可用性保持了，但对话历史在切换 provider 时丢失，导致会话连续性中断。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测协议和系统研究，提出面向生产 LLM 路由的连续性指标与开源压力测试 harness；它更偏 serving reliability，不直接推进预训练方法，但对部署侧评估有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两个指标：Continuity Preservation Rate，衡量故障切换后上下文是否被保留；Continuity Latency Overhead，衡量转发历史带来的延迟代价。系统上实现 stateful multi-provider proxy，用 History-Forwarding 在异构 LLM endpoint 之间重建会话状态。
summary.experiments: 实验包含 750 次 failover 事件，测试高并发 provider 故障下的上下文保存情况。摘要未列出具体 provider、模型规模、延迟数值或相对 baseline 的完整提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates and mitigates conversational state loss during failover in multi-provider LLM routing.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation protocol and systems harness for production LLM reliability. It is about serving continuity rather than pretraining, but the failure mode is real in deployed LLM systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce Continuity Preservation Rate for measuring whether context survives failover, and Continuity Latency Overhead for measuring the latency cost of forwarding history. They implement a stateful multi-provider proxy that reconstructs conversation state across heterogeneous LLM endpoints via history forwarding.
summary_en.experiments: The study reports 750 failover events under high-concurrency provider-failure conditions. The abstract does not provide detailed model/provider choices, exact latency numbers, or full baseline deltas.

recommendation.zh: 这是部署可靠性评测，不是模型研究；只看指标定义和 failover setup，别把结论外推到训练侧。
recommendation.en: This is a deployment-reliability benchmark, not model research; read the metric definitions and failover setup, but do not extrapolate it to training.

paper.title: Uncertainty-Aware Sequential Decision Rules for Event-Triggered LLM Invocation in Streaming Systems
paper.abstract: Streaming inference pipelines increasingly pair lightweight fast models with Large Language Models (LLMs) that provide rich semantic understanding at substantial cost. The central question of when to invoke the LLM has received limited formal treatment. We cast this as a risk-based sequential stopping problem, where a trigger policy fires when a risk functional over the observation history exceeds a threshold. Within this framework, we prove six results: a minimum inter-event time bound excludin

summary.core_problem: 在流式推理系统中，如何用形式化规则决定何时调用成本较高的 LLM，而不是一直调用或完全不用。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理成本控制和级联系统的形式化分析。它不推进预训练方法，但对 fast model + LLM 的在线 serving、路由和触发策略有工程参考。
summary.technical_approach: 将 LLM 调用时机建模为基于风险的 sequential stopping 问题：当历史观测上的风险函数超过阈值时触发 LLM。论文把 event-triggered、optimal stopping、SPRT、CUSUM、Bayesian triggers 等触发族统一到同一框架，并分析阈值策略、在线阈值更新和校准误差传递。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要列出理论结果：最小触发间隔可避免 chattering；阈值策略具有 smooth pasting 意义下的最优性；估计参数下有近似 SPRT 保证；平稳流 regret 为 O(sqrt(T log T))，含 C_T 个 changepoints 时为 O(sqrt((C_T+1)T log T))；在线梯度下降阈值收敛率为 O(1/sqrt(T))。未见具体 LLM、数据流或系统吞吐实验信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when a streaming inference pipeline should invoke an expensive LLM instead of relying only on lightweight fast models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a formal treatment of inference-cost control and cascaded serving. It does not advance pretraining, but it is relevant to online LLM routing and trigger policies in production systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: It formulates LLM invocation as a risk-based sequential stopping problem: a trigger fires when a risk functional over the observation history crosses a threshold. The framework subsumes event-triggered, optimal stopping, SPRT, CUSUM, and Bayesian triggers, and analyzes threshold optimality, adaptive thresholds, and calibration-to-miss-rate transfer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theory: minimum inter-event time to prevent chattering, smooth-pasting optimality of threshold policies, approximate SPRT guarantees under estimated parameters, O(sqrt(T log T)) regret for stationary streams, O(sqrt((C_T+1)T log T)) regret under changepoints, and O(1/sqrt(T)) convergence for online threshold updates. No concrete LLM, stream dataset, or serving-throughput experiment is specified.

recommendation.zh: 只看形式化触发框架和 regret 条件；它是 serving 路由材料，不是 pretrain 信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the trigger formulation and regret assumptions; this is serving-routing material, not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: Reliability Scaling Laws for Quantized Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Quantization is a powerful strategy to build capable and resource-efficient large language models (LLMs) by reducing the bitwidth of the parameters. While quantized LLMs achieve state-of-the-art performance on unperturbed inputs using standard predictive metrics, their performance on perturbed inputs, measured using reliability metrics, remains underexplored, despite its importance for reliable deployment. To address this gap, we first conduct a comprehensive reliability evaluation of quantized

summary.core_problem: 量化 LLM 在标准评测集上表现良好，但在面对包含微小扰动（如拼写错误、语法错误）的输入时，其可靠性（不确定性估计、校准度和鲁棒性）如何变化，以及如何选择最佳量化位宽以平衡效率和可靠性。
summary.importance: 揭示了 LLM 量化中的一个重要盲区：准确率随模型总比特数单调增加，但可靠性却呈现非单调趋势。这为实际部署中选择量化策略提供了新的视角，指出单纯追求高精度或大模型并非总是最佳选择。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个包含三个维度的可靠性评估框架：预测不确定性、校准度（不确定性估计的准确性）以及对 15 种保持语义的输入扰动（字符级和词级）的鲁棒性。在 1B 到 70B 参数规模的模型上，系统评估了 6 种主流的量化方法（2、3、4、8 bit）。
summary.experiments: 发现 4-bit 量化在不同任务、模型架构和量化方法中，提供了可靠性与效率的最佳折中。中等规模的 4-bit 模型在可靠性指标上甚至优于更大规模的低比特模型或更小规模的高比特模型。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注图 1 中准确率与可靠性随总比特数变化的趋势对比。泛读即可，了解 4-bit 量化在可靠性上的优势结论。

summary_en.core_problem: While quantized LLMs perform well on standard benchmarks, how does their reliability (uncertainty estimation, calibration, and robustness) change when facing inputs with minor perturbations (e.g., typos, grammatical errors), and how to choose the optimal quantization bit-width to balance efficiency and reliability.
summary_en.importance: Reveals a critical blind spot in LLM quantization: accuracy increases monotonically with the total number of model bits, but reliability exhibits a non-monotonic trend. This provides a new perspective for selecting quantization strategies in practical deployment, indicating that simply pursuing high precision or large models is not always the best choice.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a reliability evaluation framework comprising three dimensions: predictive uncertainty, calibration (accuracy of uncertainty estimates), and robustness to 15 types of semantically-preserving input perturbations (character-level and word-level). Systematically evaluates 6 mainstream quantization methods (2, 3, 4, 8 bits) on models ranging from 1B to 70B parameters.
summary_en.experiments: Finds that 4-bit quantization offers the best trade-off between reliability and efficiency across different tasks, model architectures, and quantization methods. Moderately-sized 4-bit models even outperform larger low-bit models or smaller high-bit models in reliability metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the trend comparison between accuracy and reliability with respect to the total number of bits in Figure 1. Skim to understand the conclusion regarding the advantages of 4-bit quantization in reliability.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reliability-vs-bitwidth/scale 的图；它不改预训练 recipe，但会影响模型发布时的量化验收标准。
recommendation.en: Skim the reliability-versus-bitwidth/scale plots; it will not change pretraining recipes, but it can change release-time quantization acceptance tests.

paper.title: Accelerating GPU Inference of Large Language Models with Moderately Unstructured Sparse Weight Matrices
paper.abstract: With the growing deployment of large language models (LLMs), LLM inference cost has become a key challenge. Pruning techniques that introduce sparsity into weight matrices can accelerate inference. However, maintaining model quality typically limits pruning to moderate unstructured sparsity (around 50\%). At these sparsity levels, none of the existing GPU kernels for sparse matrix multiplication (SpMM) can outperform their dense counterparts. This paper proposes an efficient GPU inference method

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是中等非结构化稀疏权重在 GPU 上难以带来真实推理加速的问题。LLM 剪枝通常只能安全做到约 50% 稀疏；再往上，例如超过 70%，困惑度会明显恶化。但在 50% 左右的非结构化稀疏下，传统 SpMM kernel 的元数据开销、解码开销和 tensor core 不兼容问题会抵消计算量下降，实际速度常常不如 dense GEMM。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练方法，而在模型压缩与推理约束会反过来影响可训练结构的选择。它说明“非结构化稀疏是否有用”不能只看剪枝后困惑度，还要看硬件可执行格式。对于做基座模型的人，启发点是：如果希望预训练阶段引入稀疏友好的归纳偏置，稀疏模式必须考虑 tensor core、元数据编码和片上解码成本，而不是只优化参数重要性指标。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把一个中等非结构化稀疏矩阵拆成三层存储和执行格式。第一层是 Sparse-TC layer，把部分非零模式组织成稀疏 tensor core 可消费的形式，用硬件支持的稀疏矩阵乘法承担主要计算。第二层是 Slot-Filling layer，用 parallel differential distance 压缩不规则位置，目标是在降低元数据体积的同时，让片上解码足够轻，避免 CUDA core 成为瓶颈。第三层是 Residual Layer，保存无法被前两层表达的剩余非零项，保证 SpMM 结果正确。kernel 设计上同时使用 sparse tensor core 和 CUDA core：前者处理结构化可加速部分，后者处理格式解码和残差逻辑，并通过流水线尽量把片上计算与 HBM 访存重叠起来。与 CSR、bitmap 类格式相比，它不是单纯压缩元数据，而是把“能否被 tensor core 执行”作为存储格式的一部分来设计。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了 kernel 级和端到端 LLM 推理两类结果。核心数字是：在现代 HBM GPU 上，相比 SpInfer，kernel 级最高加速 1.64×；相比 FlashLLM，端到端最高加速 1.41×。背景实验还指出，现有剪枝方法如 Wanda、RIA 在约 50% 稀疏时能较好保持模型质量，但稀疏度超过 70% 后 perplexity 会急剧上升。这组结果的重点不是证明更高稀疏度可行，而是证明在质量可接受的中等稀疏区间，也可以通过存储格式和 kernel 协同设计获得实际加速。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和 Background，重点看作者如何拆解三个瓶颈：tensor core 不兼容、元数据占比过高、片上解码开销过高。技术部分重点看三层矩阵格式和 SpMM kernel 的执行流水线，尤其是 Sparse-TC layer 与 Slot-Filling layer 的边界。实验部分优先看与 cuBLAS、SpInfer、FlashLLM 的对比，以及不同稀疏度下的质量和速度权衡。预计阅读 25–35 分钟；如果只关心预训练启发，重点看稀疏模式与硬件执行格式之间的约束关系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical gap in sparse LLM inference: moderate unstructured sparsity preserves model quality, but current GPU SpMM kernels often fail to beat dense GEMM. Around 50% sparsity is usually the safe regime for pruned LLM weights, while higher sparsity, such as beyond 70%, can sharply hurt perplexity. The difficulty is that this moderate regime still carries heavy metadata and decoding costs, and its irregular patterns do not map cleanly to sparse tensor cores.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect but useful. The paper shows that sparsity is not only a modeling or pruning question; it is also an executable-format question. If sparse structure is to be encouraged during training or mid-training, the sparsity pattern must be compatible with tensor cores, metadata compression, and on-chip decoding. Otherwise, a model can look efficient in parameter count or FLOPs while remaining slow in serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method introduces a three-layer storage format for moderately unstructured sparse weight matrices. The Sparse-TC layer reshapes part of the nonzero pattern into a form that can use sparse tensor cores. The Slot-Filling layer applies parallel differential-distance encoding to compress irregular positions while keeping on-chip decoding cheap. The Residual Layer stores remaining entries that cannot be represented by the first two layers, preserving exact SpMM computation. The accompanying kernel co-schedules sparse tensor cores and CUDA cores: tensor cores handle the structured accelerated portion, while CUDA cores manage decoding and residual work. The execution pipeline is designed to overlap on-chip computation with HBM traffic. Compared with CSR or bitmap-like formats, the storage layout is optimized jointly with the GPU execution path rather than treated as a separate compression problem.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results cover both kernel-level SpMM and end-to-end LLM inference. The method reaches up to 1.64× kernel-level speedup over SpInfer and up to 1.41× end-to-end speedup over FlashLLM on modern HBM-based GPUs. The paper also uses pruning-quality observations to motivate the target regime: methods such as Wanda and RIA can preserve quality near 50% sparsity, whereas perplexity degrades rapidly once sparsity exceeds roughly 70%. The main experimental message is that moderate unstructured sparsity can become useful in practice if the matrix format and kernel are co-designed for the hardware.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction and Background first to understand the three bottlenecks: sparse tensor-core incompatibility, metadata overhead, and on-chip decoding cost. Then read the sections describing the three-layer matrix format and the co-optimized SpMM kernel. The most useful details are the split between Sparse-TC, Slot-Filling, and Residual layers, and how the pipeline overlaps decoding, computation, and memory movement. In the experiments, focus on comparisons against cuBLAS, SpInfer, and FlashLLM, plus the quality-speed tradeoff across sparsity levels. A focused read should take about 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看存储格式和 kernel 分工即可；若速度是在真实 batch/seq 下成立，50% 非结构化剪枝的 prior 要调一下。
recommendation.en: Read the format and kernel split; if the speedups hold at realistic batch and sequence settings, the prior on 50% unstructured pruning needs updating.

paper.title: CTA-Pipelining: A Latency-Oriented Spatial Scaling Method for Multi-GPU Systems
paper.abstract: The evolution of compute infrastructure has transformed multi-GPU systems into tightly integrated shared-memory structures. However, current software still mostly treats these coherent interconnects simply as high-speed networks. Simultaneously, the demand for serving Large Language Models under latency constraints has shifted GPU workload optimization from being throughput-driven to latency-bound, necessitating latency-oriented scaling methods beyond Tensor Parallelism (TP).   Thus, we introduc

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是多 GPU LLM 推理中的单请求低延迟扩展问题。现有 TP 在算子内部切分计算，但需要 AllReduce 等集合通信，延迟下降很快遇到上限；PP 更偏吞吐，不适合单 batch 交互延迟。作者试图利用 GB200、H200、B200 这类 NVLink/NVSwitch 共享内存多 GPU 系统，在 inter-operator 层面做更细粒度的空间流水。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对大模型 serving 和低延迟部署有参考价值。它的主要启发是：新一代多 GPU 节点不应只被当成高速网络互连，而可以被编程为更接近共享内存的执行域。对于基座训练研究员，价值主要在系统侧：理解未来模型架构、MoE 路由、MLP-heavy block 或推理优化可能如何利用节点内共享内存，尤其是单 batch、低延迟场景下 TP 之外的扩展维度。
summary.technical_approach: CTA-pipelining 在 Cooperative Thread Array 粒度建立跨 GPU 的生产者-消费者关系，让存在数据依赖的 kernel 可以在不同 GPU 上并发推进。实现上依赖 NVLink 统一内存域、atomic counters 和 queues 做跨设备同步。它不是把矩阵乘法再做一次 tensor shard，而是在多个相邻 GEMM 或 MLP 层之间按 CTA 级别传递就绪信号，使后继 kernel 不必等前一层完整结束。集成方式较轻量，只需在现有 CUTLASS kernel 中加入 prologue 和 epilogue 逻辑，避免重写成复杂 mega-kernel。论文还区分了传统 CUTLASS kernel 和 warp-specialized multi-stage persistent kernel，后者更容易把协议开销藏进已有流水中。
summary.experiments: 实验用多层 GEMM 模拟 Transformer MLP 层，在 8-GPU H200 NVLink 和 8-GPU B200 NVLink 系统上实现原型，底层使用 CUTLASS、cuBLAS 和 NCCL。协议开销分析显示，普通 CUTLASS kernel 上额外同步成本较小，在 warp-specialized persistent kernel 中多数开销可被隐藏。与 micro-batch chunk pipelining 相比，多层 GEMM 场景最高降低 31.8% 延迟；与 Tensor Parallelism 相比，MLP 设置中最高降低 29.6% 延迟。作者还展示 CTA-pipelining 可与 TP 叠加，作为正交空间扩展方式，同时改善计算等待和通信暴露问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 PP、TP、micro-batching 局限的定位；CTA-Pipelining Protocol 一节看清楚 CTA 级同步协议、prologue/epilogue 如何插入 CUTLASS；实验部分重点看协议 overhead trace、与 micro-batch pipelining 和 TP 的对比图。硬件展望部分可快速扫过，主要用于判断这种方法对未来 NVLink/NVSwitch 节点的依赖程度。需要注意它目前主要验证 GEMM/MLP，不等价于完整 LLM serving 系统已经可直接落地。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets single-request latency scaling for LLM inference on tightly coupled multi-GPU systems. Tensor parallelism can reduce latency but introduces collective communication such as AllReduce, which creates a hard limit. Pipeline parallelism is mostly a throughput tool. CTA-pipelining explores the space between layer-level PP and operator-level TP by exploiting the shared-memory semantics of modern NVLink/NVSwitch nodes.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to serving systems than to pretraining algorithms, but it is useful for understanding where future model execution may move. The key signal is that multi-GPU nodes are no longer just fast networked devices; they can be programmed as a shared-memory execution domain. This matters for low-latency inference, MLP-heavy blocks, MoE execution, and architecture choices whose efficiency depends on fine-grained intra-node scheduling.
summary_en.technical_approach: CTA-pipelining creates producer-consumer dependencies at the Cooperative Thread Array level across GPUs. Instead of waiting for one dependent kernel to finish before launching the next, the successor kernel can begin consuming ready CTA-level outputs on another GPU. The protocol uses the NVLink unified memory domain with atomic counters and queues for cross-device synchronization. Integration into CUTLASS is intentionally light: kernels receive small prologue and epilogue snippets rather than being rewritten as monolithic mega-kernels. The paper studies both conventional CUTLASS kernels and warp-specialized multi-stage persistent kernels, where much of the synchronization overhead can be hidden inside the existing execution pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: The prototype is evaluated on multi-layer GEMM workloads that represent Transformer MLP layers, using 8-GPU H200 NVLink and 8-GPU B200 NVLink systems with CUTLASS, cuBLAS, and NCCL. The overhead study shows that the protocol cost is small and is mostly hidden for warp-specialized persistent kernels. Against micro-batch chunk pipelining, CTA-pipelining reduces latency by up to 31.8% on multi-layer GEMMs. Against tensor parallelism on MLP-like setups, it reduces latency by up to 29.6%. The paper also shows that CTA-pipelining can be combined with TP as an orthogonal spatial scaling dimension, improving both computation overlap and communication exposure.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the positioning against PP, TP, kernel fusion, mega-kernels, and micro-batching. Then focus on the protocol section: the CTA-level dependency mechanism, atomic-counter design, and CUTLASS prologue/epilogue integration. The most useful experimental figures are the overhead traces and the comparisons against micro-batch pipelining and TP. Treat the hardware discussion as context. The current evidence is strongest for GEMM/MLP prototypes, not for a complete production LLM serving stack.

recommendation.zh: 看 §实现和算子形状表：若收益只在小 MLP 形状成立就是工程特例，若覆盖 decoder block 才值得复现。
recommendation.en: Read the implementation and shape tables: if the gain is limited to small MLP cases it is an engineering corner, but decoder-block coverage would make it worth reproducing.

paper.title: Towards Efficient Large Language Model Serving: A Survey on System-Aware KV Cache Optimization
paper.abstract: Despite the rapid advancements of large language models (LLMs), LLM serving systems remain memory-intensive and costly. The key-value (KV) cache, which stores KV tensors during autoregressive decoding, is crucial for enabling low-latency, high-throughput LLM inference serving. In this survey, we focus on system-aware KV infrastructure for serving LLMs (abbreviated as sKis). We revisit recent work from a system behavior perspective, organizing existing efforts into three dimensions: execution and

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理 LLM serving 中 KV cache 的优化空间，回答内存成本和吞吐瓶颈该如何从系统视角拆解。
summary.importance: 这是综述而非新方法，但主题很实用：KV cache 已经是大模型部署的主瓶颈之一。对做长上下文、推理成本、甚至训练-推理接口设计的人都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 文章把现有 KV cache 工作按三条轴组织：时间维的执行与调度、空间维的放置与迁移、结构维的表示与保留；同时讨论不同系统行为之间的协同设计关系，以及这些设计与延迟、吞吐、内存占用等目标的映射。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，没有统一实验。价值主要在分类框架和问题分解，而不是新的 benchmark 数字或方法增益。
summary.authors_note: The University of Melbourne、华中科技大学。作者未见到明确的一线 LLM serving 代表性团队信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper systematizes the optimization space of KV cache in LLM serving, focusing on how to decompose memory and throughput bottlenecks from a systems perspective.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey rather than a new method, but the topic is practical: KV cache is now one of the dominant bottlenecks in LLM deployment. It is useful for researchers thinking about long context, inference cost, and train–serve interface design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The survey organizes prior work along three axes: execution and scheduling in time, placement and migration in space, and representation and retention in structure. It also discusses co-design affinities across behaviors and their links to latency, throughput, and memory objectives.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not present a unified experimental contribution. The value is in the taxonomy and decomposition of the design space rather than new benchmark gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The University of Melbourne and Huazhong University of Science and Technology. No clearly identifiable flagship LLM serving lab signal from the metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 不是新结果，但分类框架还算干净；做长上下文或 serving 的人看 taxonomy 即可，别指望有新结论。
recommendation.en: Not a source of new results, but the taxonomy is clean enough; read it for the design map if you work on long-context serving, not for fresh conclusions.

institutions: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
Huazhong University of Science and Technology (www.ruizhang.info)

paper.title: SMetric: Rethink LLM Scheduling for Serving Agents with Balanced Session-centric Scheduling
paper.abstract: LLM scheduling is critical to serving, yet it remains unclear how well existing designs fit agentic serving--with LLM requests issued by agents instead of humans. This shifts the workload in two ways: (1) agents act only on complete responses, making the cluster's tokens per second (TPS) the primary goal and relaxing--not eliminating--per-token latency requirements; and (2) requests share much of their KV\$-reuse exceeds 80% of request tokens in a production trace from BAILIAN, versus 54-62% in

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM调度器面向Agent服务时，为提升KV复用率过度优先路由至缓存实例，导致负载不均，限制集群整体TPS
summary.importance: 系统类贡献，首次系统研究Agent场景下的LLM请求调度问题，提出会话中心的平衡调度框架
summary.technical_approach: 提出两个核心洞见：一是全局KV存储可在负载均衡的同时保留部分KV复用；二是利用会话内局部性，小范围负载平衡即可提升整体吞吐量。基于此设计SMetric调度算法，平衡负载与KV复用收益
summary.experiments: 基于阿里百炼生产trace和公开trace测试：Agent场景下KV复用率达80%（远高于聊天场景的54-62%）；所提方法在维持KV复用的同时显著提升负载均衡度与集群TPS
summary.authors_note: 作者来自上海交通大学陈海波、陈榕团队（操作系统与分布式系统领域知名团队）与阿里百炼团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM schedulers for agent serving overly prioritize routing to cache-hit instances to boost KV reuse, causing load imbalance and limiting overall cluster TPS
summary_en.importance: System contribution, presenting the first systematic study of LLM request scheduling for agent workloads and proposing a session-centric balanced scheduling framework
summary_en.technical_approach: Two key insights: 1) global-tier KV storage enables load balancing without sacrificing all KV reuse; 2) leveraging intra-session locality, small-scale balancing suffices to improve throughput. The SMetric algorithm is designed to balance load and KV reuse benefits
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Alibaba BAILIAN production traces and public traces: KV reuse rate reaches 80% in agent scenarios (vs. 54-62% in chat); the proposed method improves load balance and cluster TPS while maintaining KV reuse
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Haibo Chen and Rong Chen's team from Shanghai Jiao Tong University (renowned in operating systems and distributed systems) and Alibaba BAILIAN team

recommendation.zh: Agent场景下的LLM服务调度工作，生产trace揭示的高KV复用特征可参考，调度算法本身对预训练研究无直接价值
recommendation.en: LLM serving scheduling for agent workloads; high KV reuse characteristics from production traces are referable, but the algorithm has no direct value for pretraining research

paper.title: Akashic: A Low-Overhead LLM Inference Service with MemAttention
paper.abstract: Recent LLM-based agent systems continuously accumulate context across multi-turn interactions, tool invocations, and cross-session workflows. Replaying the full history for every request quickly becomes impractical: long contexts increase prefill cost, may exceed context limits, and often bury task-relevant evidence in irrelevant content, degrading both serving efficiency and output quality. We propose Akashic, a low-overhead memory system built around MemAttention, which organizes context into

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agent/长时交互场景里的推理期记忆管理问题：随着多轮对话、工具调用和跨会话工作流不断累积，直接把完整历史反复塞回上下文会带来高 prefill 成本、上下文长度上限压力，以及中间位置信息利用差导致的质量下降。已有 summarization memory 要么整段重写，更新成本随历史增长；要么分段独立压缩，跨段依赖容易丢失。作者要解决的是，如何在不反复重写全部历史的前提下，保留跨 chunk 的相关证据，并把语义检索和物理存储布局一起优化，降低服务延迟。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练的直接相关性不高，更偏 inference system 和 agent memory。保留它的理由主要有两点。第一，它把长上下文问题拆成了语义压缩与物理 locality 两个层面，这对理解“为什么长上下文不等于有效记忆”有帮助。第二，它展示了 retrieval/memory 设计如何反过来影响模型质量，而不只是吞吐。这对做长上下文训练、外部记忆、continual interaction 的人有一些启发。但如果只关心预训练目标、数据、优化器或 scaling，这篇不是优先级高的阅读对象。
summary.technical_approach: Akashic 的核心设计有两部分。第一部分是 MemAttention。它不是在触发阈值时把整段历史压成一个总摘要，也不是把每个 segment 各自独立总结，而是采用 chunk-granular maintenance：每次只处理一个有界 chunk。关键在于写回前会做 cross-chunk inference，把当前新 chunk 与少量语义相关的旧 chunk 一起建模，生成更新后的 memory。这样做的目的，是在保持单次维护成本受控的同时，恢复那些被简单分段切开后本应联合出现的证据。作者把这看成对 whole-context summarization 和 segment-level summarization 之间 trade-off 的折中。第二部分是硬件-软件协同的 memory placement。作者指出，memory 不只是语义对象，也是存储对象；即使检索只命中少量相关记忆，如果这些 chunk 在物理上分散在很多页或块里，最终延迟仍然高。于是系统会把可能共同被检索的 chunk 尽量共置，并把 stale data 做 out-of-place compaction，减少 retrieval 侧的 read amplification 和并发争用。这个视角比常见的纯 RAG/memory 论文更系统，因为它把 serving 路径上的 I/O 和并发也纳入设计目标。
summary.experiments: 作者在四类 workload 上评估：LoCoMo、SWE-bench、BrowseComp、WebArena，并使用不同规模模型。给出的 headline 结果是：相对最强 memory baseline，在相同设置下任务准确率最高提升 10.2 个点，throughput 最高提升 1.21 倍，并发服务下可持续 request rate 最高提升 1.88 倍。引言还强调 Akashic 位于 accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier。实验设计里值得注意的不是单一平均分，而是作者显式考察了 context density heterogeneity 和 locality gap 这两个瓶颈。也就是说，系统收益并不只来自更好的摘要质量，还来自更好的物理布局。当前提供内容没有完整表格和消融细节，但按正文结构推测，关键消融应包括：chunk 大小、cross-chunk 关联数量、不同 summarization policy 的维护开销、placement 优化对 I/O/吞吐的独立贡献，以及并发场景下的 tail latency 或 request rate 变化。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合带着系统问题去读，不适合当作预训练论文精读。先看 Introduction 和 Background，确认作者定义的两个瓶颈：非均匀 context density 与 locality gap。然后直接看方法部分的 §4.1 和 §4.2，理解 MemAttention 如何在 chunk 级别维护记忆，以及 placement manager 如何把语义相关性映射到物理共置。实验部分优先看 Figure 1 和四个 benchmark 的主表，再找消融验证两个设计分别贡献了什么。若只想抓住主线，25-35 分钟足够。真正值得借鉴的点，是它把“记忆质量”和“服务代价”放在同一个优化目标里；不太值得深挖的是具体 benchmark 分数本身，因为它们更依赖 agent stack 细节。
summary.authors_note: Rednote/RedKnot 相关团队；文中提到代码将并入 RedKnot 框架。具体作者背景在当前提供内容中无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets inference-time memory management for agentic LLM systems. As conversations, tool traces, and cross-session workflows accumulate, replaying the full history becomes expensive and often hurts quality. Existing summarization-based memory systems either rewrite the whole history, which scales poorly, or summarize segments independently, which breaks cross-segment dependencies. The paper asks how to preserve cross-chunk evidence without repeatedly rewriting everything, while also reducing the storage-side latency of retrieval.
summary_en.importance: This is more of an inference/serving paper than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but still real. It separates the long-context problem into two layers: semantic compression and physical locality. That is useful for anyone thinking about external memory, long-horizon interaction, or why larger context windows do not automatically translate into better usable memory. If the focus is core pretraining objectives, data, or optimization, this is not a priority read.
summary_en.technical_approach: Akashic has two main ideas. The first is MemAttention. Instead of summarizing the entire history at each trigger point, or summarizing each segment independently, it performs chunk-granular memory maintenance. Each new bounded chunk is reconciled with a small set of semantically related prior chunks before being written back to memory. This is meant to keep maintenance cost bounded while recovering evidence that would otherwise be fragmented across independently summarized segments. The second idea is hardware-software co-designed memory placement. The paper argues that memory is not just a semantic object but also a storage object: even if retrieval selects the right chunks, latency remains high if those chunks are physically scattered. Akashic therefore co-locates chunks likely to be co-retrieved and compacts stale data out of place, reducing read amplification and contention under concurrent serving. This is a stronger systems framing than typical memory/RAG work because it optimizes both semantic retrieval quality and storage locality.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers four workloads: LoCoMo, SWE-bench, BrowseComp, and WebArena, with models of different sizes. The headline numbers reported in the visible text are up to +10.2 accuracy points over the strongest memory baseline, up to 1.21x higher throughput, and up to 1.88x higher sustainable request rate under concurrent serving. The paper also claims Akashic lies on the accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier. The interesting part of the setup is that gains are attributed to both better memory maintenance and better physical placement, not just better summarization. The provided text does not include the full tables or ablation details, but the critical ablations to inspect are chunk size, number of related chunks used in cross-chunk inference, maintenance overhead versus whole-history or segment-level summarization, and the isolated effect of placement optimization on I/O and concurrency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this as a systems paper, not as a pretraining paper. Start with the introduction and background to understand the two bottlenecks the authors care about: heterogeneous context density and the locality gap. Then go straight to Sections 4.1 and 4.2 for MemAttention and the placement manager. In the experiments, prioritize Figure 1, the main benchmark tables, and the ablations that separate semantic gains from storage-layout gains. A focused 25 to 35 minute read should be enough. The main takeaway is the joint optimization of memory quality and serving cost; the exact benchmark scores matter less than the design decomposition.
summary_en.authors_note: Associated with the Rednote/RedKnot team; the text says the code will be merged into the RedKnot framework. Specific author backgrounds are not recoverable from the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 读系统设计和 workload 定义；它提醒长上下文训练不该只优化全量 replay，chunk 级记忆会改变真实分布。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and workload setup; it argues that long-context training should not assume full-history replay as the serving distribution.

paper.title: Think Before You Grid-Search: Floor-First Triage for LLM Serving
paper.abstract: LLM serving optimization typically benchmarks many configurations and reaches for heavy profilers when latency targets are missed. We argue for the reverse discipline: estimation is the analytical layer of profiling -- without it, optimization degenerates to grid search. Floor First is a residual-driven triage workflow. Each decode step is modeled as a five-dimensional resource vector (HBM bytes, FLOPs, network bytes, network messages, KV capacity); summing within a resource and maximizing acros

summary.core_problem: LLM推理服务优化的配置空间覆盖并行布局、批处理、量化、稀疏注意力、内核调优等多个维度，现有实践主要依赖网格搜索和临时性能分析，缺乏系统化的分诊决策流程，无法快速判断性能差距是源于硬件理论下限还是实现层面的可优化空间。
summary.importance: 提出了残差驱动的服务优化分诊方法，比盲目网格搜索效率更高，对生产环境LLM部署的性能调优有实际指导意义。对预训练研究员的价值在于可以清晰理解MoE等模型的部署资源瓶颈边界，辅助训练-部署联合设计。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是Floor First工作流：先基于模型维度、校准后的硬件速率、并行策略和负载形态计算每步延迟的理论下限，再将实测延迟与下限的差值作为残差判断优化优先级。具体包含四层设计：一是有明确停止规则的分诊流程，区分管线优化和内核优化两个方向；二是双边下限模型，乐观下限取各资源争用的最大值（假设资源完全重叠），悲观下限取各资源成本的总和（假设无重叠），实测值在区间内的位置可直接诊断资源重叠程度；三是墙序分析，按负载增长时的瓶颈先后（KV容量、KV带宽、权重带宽、计算）对比部署方案，而非仅看同批次延迟；四是屋顶线指标规范，明确不同阶段的有效利用率指标和分诊阈值校准方法。同时提供零依赖的Python计算器和可在Agent优化循环中执行的技能。
summary.experiments: 以DeepSeek-V3.2风格MoE模型在16张H20 GPU上的解码阶段为案例，推导了TP与EP+DP的最优选择、单流延迟物理边界、稀疏注意力的影响，首次给出了外销版H20 GPU的ridge点表征。案例数据为分析性下限值，通信常数经集群校准，GPU速率来自官方数据手册；实测延迟与下限的残差扫描实验计划在后续版本中补充。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2章的分诊工作流设计和第3章的双边下限模型，第5章的H20部署案例有实际参考价值。全文泛读约15-20分钟，适合需要做LLM部署性能调优的工程师快速了解方法论。
summary.authors_note: 具体作者与所属机构未在提供内容中明确，研究参考了LMSYS、蚂蚁集团的DeepSeek部署实践。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM serving optimization spans a vast configuration space including parallelism layout, batching, quantization, sparse attention, and kernel tuning. Current practices rely heavily on grid search and ad-hoc profiling, lacking a systematic triage workflow to quickly determine whether a performance gap comes from fundamental hardware limits or addressable implementation inefficiencies.
summary_en.importance: The residual-driven triage methodology provides a more efficient alternative to blind grid search for production LLM deployment. For pretraining researchers, it clarifies the resource bottleneck boundaries of models like MoE, which informs co-design of training and deployment pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core is the Floor First workflow, which first computes per-step latency floors from model dimensions, calibrated hardware rates, parallelism setup, and workload shape, then uses the gap (residual) between measured latency and the floor to prioritize optimization. It has four key components: 1) A triage workflow with explicit stopping rules that dispatches work to pipeline optimization or kernel optimization tracks; 2) A two-sided floor model with an optimistic bound (max of per-resource contention, assuming full resource overlap) and a pessimistic bound (sum of per-resource costs, assuming no overlap), where the measurement's position in the interval directly diagnoses resource overlap; 3) Wall-order analysis that compares deployment options by which resource binds first as load grows (KV capacity, KV bandwidth, weight bandwidth, compute) rather than just same-batch latency; 4) Roofline metric discipline that defines meaningful utilization metrics per phase and calibration protocols for triage thresholds. A zero-dependency Python calculator and agent-enforceable optimization skill are also provided.
summary_en.experiments: A case study on a DeepSeek-V3.2-style MoE model with 16 H20 GPUs analyzes decode-stage tradeoffs between TP and EP+DP, single-stream latency physical bounds, and sparse attention effects. It provides the first ridge-point characterization of export-grade H20 GPUs. Results are analytical floors calibrated with cluster-measured communication constants and datasheet GPU rates; empirical residual sweep experiments are planned for a future revision.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 (triage workflow design) and Section 3 (two-sided floor model). Section 5 (H20 deployment case study) has practical reference value. Full skimming takes ~15-20 minutes, suitable for engineers doing LLM serving performance tuning.
summary_en.authors_note: Specific authors and affiliations are not clearly disclosed in the provided content; the research references DeepSeek deployment practices from LMSYS and Ant Group.

recommendation.zh: 只看§3的五维资源建模和[max, sum]区间判断法，做新架构推理成本估算时能省不少无意义的profiling工作。
recommendation.en: Read §3 for the 5-dim resource model and [max, sum] interval diagnostic; it cuts down pointless profiling work when estimating inference cost for new architectures.

paper.title: PEEK: Predictive Queue-Informed KV Cache Management for LLM Serving
paper.abstract: We present PEEK, a lightweight scheduling and eviction framework for both online (streaming) and offline (batch) LLM serving; this paper focuses on the online regime. PEEK maintains an incremental radix tree over the pending queue, exposing   prefix-sharing clusters no existing engine surfaces. A low-overhead dual-walk matches the tree against the engine's prefix cache to yield longest-prefix-match for every waiting request; PEEK then admits cluster pioneers first so siblings   inherit the fresh

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 LLM serving 中 KV cache 复用没有利用等待队列结构的问题。现有 SGLang 和 vLLM 主要根据当前 cache 状态调度或按到达顺序调度，无法提前看到排队请求之间的 prefix sharing，导致长上下文、RAG、批量相似请求场景中出现 cache thrashing。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于推理系统优化，对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对大模型研究平台有实际参考价值。长上下文训练和评测越来越依赖高吞吐推理管线，尤其是数据合成、agent rollout、RL sampling 和 benchmark evaluation。PEEK 的启发点是：请求队列本身包含可预测的未来 KV 需求，调度和 eviction 应该联合使用这个信号，而不是只看已缓存内容。
summary.technical_approach: PEEK 在 pending queue 上维护一个增量 radix tree，用来表示等待请求之间的公共前缀结构。插入和删除开销为 O(D)，调度和 eviction 查询可近似 O(1) 读取聚类信号。对 SGLang 的 radix cache，PEEK 使用 dual-walk 同时遍历 pending tree 和 engine cache，为所有等待请求计算 longest-prefix-match，复杂度从 naive 的 O(ND) 降为 O(CD)，其中 C 是 prefix-sharing clusters 数量，通常小于 N。调度上，Cluster-LPM 不只看当前 cache hit length，也让同一 prefix cluster 的请求尽量相邻进入系统，使一次 prefill 能被后续 sibling 复用。eviction 上，PEEK 保护未来排队请求依赖的 ancestral blocks，优先淘汰没有 pending demand 的 blocks。为避免 cluster-first 导致 singleton 饥饿，系统加入按到达时间排序的 fairness lane，并用 stride scheduler 和动态 lane controller 在 locality 与等待时间之间调整。
summary.experiments: 实验在 SGLang 和 vLLM 上进行，覆盖 5 类 workload，包含 shared-prompt chat、long-prefix RAG、multi-GPU 70B 场景、agentic conversation bursts 和 singleton-dominated chat，规模最高到 4×H100，DP=2、TP=2。在线 serving 结果显示，在有明显 prefix 结构的 W1/W2/W3 中，PEEK 在 SGLang/vLLM 上分别带来最高 3.0×/2.6× cache hit 提升，7.9×/7.1× TTFT 改善，6.7×/5.5× end-to-end latency 改善，以及 3.6×/4.5× throughput 提升。在 prefix 结构弱或已经按到达顺序较好聚集的 W4/W5 中，E2E 和 throughput 基本与最强 baseline 持平，波动约 ±2%，TTFT 波动约 ±5–7%。消融显示 cluster-aware admission 是主要来源：cLPM 单独已经接近完整系统，cache hit 与 full stack 相差约 3 个百分点；queue-aware eviction 在 SGLang 上进一步降低 0–3% TTFT/E2E，在 vLLM 上影响较小；dynamic lane 主要用于减少 singleton deferral 带来的延迟。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Background and Motivation 中对 SGLang LPM、DFS_WEIGHT、vLLM FCFS/APC 的限制分析；然后看方法部分的 pending radix tree、dual-walk、cLPM admission 和 queue-aware eviction。实验部分优先看 W1/W2/W3 的 cache pressure 分析和 ablation，因为它们说明收益来自哪里。低重叠 workload 的结果也值得扫一眼，用来判断这种调度策略是否会牺牲尾部请求或 singleton 请求。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a serving inefficiency: current LLM engines reuse KV cache based mostly on the current cache state or arrival order, but they do not exploit prefix sharing among requests that are still waiting in the queue. This leaves a strong predictive signal unused and can cause cache thrashing in long-context, RAG, and bursty shared-prefix workloads.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems paper rather than a pretraining method paper, but it is relevant to large-scale model research infrastructure. Data generation, evaluation, agent rollouts, and RL sampling often run through high-throughput serving stacks with repeated long prefixes. The useful idea is to treat the waiting queue as a forecast of future KV demand, and to co-design scheduling and eviction around that forecast instead of optimizing them separately.
summary_en.technical_approach: PEEK maintains an incremental radix tree over the pending queue to expose prefix-sharing clusters. Inserts and removals cost O(D), while scheduling and eviction can read cluster-level signals cheaply. On SGLang, PEEK performs a dual walk over the pending radix tree and the engine’s radix cache to compute longest-prefix matches for waiting requests in O(CD), instead of O(ND), where C is the number of prefix-sharing clusters and N is the queue size. On vLLM’s flat block-hash cache, it still uses the queue tree for cluster signals even if cache probes are per request. The scheduler uses Cluster-LPM to admit cluster pioneers first so that sibling requests can reuse the freshly materialized prefix. The eviction hook protects blocks that are ancestors of large queued clusters and evicts zero-demand blocks first. To avoid starving singleton requests, PEEK adds an arrival-ordered fairness lane, stride interleaving, and a dynamic lane controller that increases the fairness share when singleton pressure or wait time grows.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers SGLang and vLLM across five workloads, from shared-prompt chat and long-prefix RAG to multi-GPU 70B settings, agentic conversation bursts, and singleton-heavy chat. The largest online setup uses 4 H100 GPUs with DP=2 over TP=2. On prefix-rich workloads, PEEK improves cache hit rate by up to 3.0× on SGLang and 2.6× on vLLM, TTFT by up to 7.9×/7.1×, end-to-end latency by up to 6.7×/5.5×, and throughput by up to 3.6×/4.5×. On workloads with little sharing or already coherent arrivals, it stays close to the strongest baselines, with E2E and throughput within about ±2% and TTFT within roughly ±5–7%. Ablations show that cluster-aware admission is the main lever: cLPM alone is within about 3 percentage points of the full cache-hit gain. Dynamic lanes recover latency lost to singleton deferral, while queue-aware eviction adds a smaller 0–3% TTFT/E2E improvement on SGLang and is mostly flat on vLLM.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes. Start with the motivation section comparing SGLang LPM, DFS_WEIGHT, and vLLM FCFS/APC, because it clarifies what signal existing engines miss.
