Then read the method sections on the pending radix tree, dual-walk matching, Cluster-LPM admission, and queue-aware eviction. In the experiments, prioritize the cache-pressure studies and ablations on W1/W2/W3; they show why the method works. Also check the low-sharing workloads to understand the fairness and no-regression behavior.

recommendation.zh: 队列感知KV缓存调度思路新颖，提升幅度扎实，做长上下文推理/Serving优化的人值得读方法和实验部分。
recommendation.en: The queue-aware KV cache scheduling idea is novel with solid performance gains, worth reading the method and experiment sections for practitioners working on long-context inference and serving.

paper.title: Metronome: Bound the Cache, Keep the Beat for Real-Time Interaction Model Serving
paper.abstract: Real-time interaction models -- Moshi, MiniCPM-o, Qwen-Omni -- turn serving into a periodic real-time task: on every frame a session ingests streaming audio and must respond by a recurring wall-clock deadline, while its KV cache grows monotonically and stays pinned for the whole conversation. This regime hides a dangerous failure mode. On a real full-duplex stack, sustained load does not degrade serving gracefully: it falls off a cliff, jumping in one step from milliseconds per frame to a stalle

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是实时交互式模型服务里的一个新型系统失效模式：会话是周期性实时任务，但每个会话的 KV cache 又会随时间单调增长并常驻 GPU，结果在持续负载下不是平滑退化，而是突然掉下“延迟悬崖”。更麻烦的是，这个崩溃是静默的：延迟和 deadline-miss 指标在崩溃前后都可能看起来正常，但模型已经开始按时返回空帧，不再真正输出内容。作者要解决的核心问题，是如何让这种 interaction serving 从不可控、不可观测的内存崩溃，变成可稳定运行、且能被控制器感知的系统。
summary.importance: 它和传统 LLM serving 论文不同，价值不在吞吐优化，而在指出一种由新模型形态带来的基础设施约束。Moshi、Qwen-Omni、MiniCPM-o 这类持续听说的模型，把 serving 从一次性请求变成长期驻留的流式会话。对做语音 LM、统一多模态预训练和在线推理系统的人，这篇文章的重要性在于：KV cache 不再只是推理成本问题，而是决定系统是否可部署的状态变量。文章提出的结论也很直接——先把每个 session 的 resident state 设上界，系统才会重新出现单调、可信的负载信号，后续 admission control、autoscaling、load shedding 才有抓手。这对未来原生实时多模态模型的 serving 设计有基础意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法很克制，核心只有两步，而且作者明确强调重点是“知道该约束什么”，不是堆复杂机制。

第一步是 bounded resident KV。作者在引擎内部启用 windowed KV / sliding-window attention，让每个 session 只保留最近 W 个 token 的 KV，而不是把整段对话的全部状态永久钉在 GPU 上。为了避免把全注意力 backbone 直接切成局部窗口后生成质量明显变差，作者再额外保留少量 pinned attention sinks，作为始终可见的全局锚点。这个设计的关键不是压缩 KV 本身，而是把“每个 session 的显存占用随时间无界增长”改成“有上界的常驻状态”。

第二步是在这个被约束后的系统上做 AIMD admission control。作者使用 deadline-aware 的加性增、乘性减控制器在线寻找可调度并发度 N*。这里有一个很重要的因果论证：同一个控制器在未约束 KV 的系统上会持续 over-admit，最后直接撞墙；只有在 resident state 被限制后，per-frame latency 才会随负载平滑上升，控制器才有可用反馈。

文章还给出一个一阶 pool-fill 模型来解释崩溃何时发生。这个模型把 block pool 饱和看成由每帧新增 KV 累积触发的内存事件，而不是算力瓶颈。也因此，作者强调 interaction serving 和普通 chatbot serving 的根本区别：后者请求是短暂的，KV 可释放、可换出、可在 turn 间重算；前者没有 idle gap，会话状态必须持续驻留，传统吞吐优化手段并不能解决无界状态问题。
summary.experiments:
实验是端到端的真实栈，而不是离线模拟。作者用真实音频驱动完整 full-duplex 服务链路，包括 WebSocket client、Go gateway 和 GPU worker，并在四个 interaction model 上验证现象和方案。文中给出的代表性时间尺度包括：Moshi 约每 80ms 一个 frame，omni 类模型约每 1–2s 一个 frame；会话持续数分钟，足以让 KV pool 填满。

关键结果有四点。第一，未修改的 resumable-KV 路径在持续负载下会出现明显 cliff：per-frame latency 长时间维持在毫秒级，然后突然钉死在上限，engine 停止正常产出 token。第二，这个 cliff 是 memory-triggered 而不是 compute-triggered；直到最后一刻，每帧计算仍然便宜，但 block pool 因会话 KV 持续增长而耗尽。第三，这个失效是 metastable 的：相同五分钟实验有时崩、有时不崩，原因是 pool fill 速度受运行时微小波动影响。第四，也是最重要的，bounded KV 把 cliff 变成 slope：延迟会随负载平滑、单调上升，系统开始“说真话”，AIMD 控制器可以据此收敛到可调度并发度并干净地拒绝多余会话。

作者还做了质量相关消融，验证 sliding window 和 pinned attention sinks 各自的作用：前者负责把 resident memory 设上界，后者负责在窗口化后维持生成质量。另一个关键消融是控制器依赖性实验：相同 admission controller 在无界 KV 系统上失效，在有界系统上才有效，这说明控制收益不是控制器本身带来的，而是来自可观测、单调的系统响应。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2/3，先把问题形态建立起来：interaction serving 不是聊天服务的轻微变体，而是周期 deadline + 常驻增长状态的组合。然后看第 3 节的 failure characterization，尤其是 memory event、metastability、silent collapse 这三个性质，以及一阶 pool-fill 模型。最后看第 4 节和第 5.3 节，理解为什么 bounded KV 是 admission control 的前提，而不是一个独立的小优化。

如果只花 25 分钟，建议顺序是：Introduction → failure case figures → bounded KV 机制 → controller ablation。阅读时重点盯住两个问题：一，为什么传统 swap/recompute 在这里不可用；二，attention sinks 为什么是必要的，而不是只做滑窗就够。若你关心语音/多模态模型部署，这篇文章值得把实验图认真看完，因为它揭示的是一种很容易被常规 latency dashboard 掩盖的系统风险。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a serving failure mode specific to real-time interaction models. In this regime, each session is a periodic real-time task with recurring wall-clock deadlines, but its KV cache also grows monotonically and remains pinned on GPU for the entire conversation. Under sustained load, the system does not degrade gracefully. It falls off a latency cliff when the KV pool saturates. Worse, the failure is silent: latency and deadline-miss metrics can remain healthy while the engine starts returning empty frames on time. The core problem is how to turn this unbounded-state, poorly observable serving regime into one that is stable and controllable.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not another throughput optimization for standard LLM serving. It identifies an infrastructure constraint created by a new model class: streaming speech and omni models such as Moshi, MiniCPM-o, and Qwen-Omni. For researchers working on speech LMs, unified multimodal models, or online inference systems, the paper makes an important point: KV cache is no longer just an efficiency concern; it becomes the state variable that determines whether the system is deployable at all. The practical lesson is simple and strong. Until per-session resident state is bounded, latency is not a trustworthy control signal, and admission control, autoscaling, and load shedding cannot work reliably.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is intentionally minimal. The paper argues that the key is identifying what must be bounded, not adding elaborate machinery.

The first component is bounded resident KV. Inside the engine, the authors enable a windowed-KV or sliding-window path so that each session retains only the most recent W tokens rather than the full conversation history on GPU. To avoid the quality drop that often comes from naively replacing full attention with a local window, they keep a small set of pinned attention-sink tokens that remain globally visible. The important shift is not KV compression in the abstract; it is changing per-session memory from unbounded growth to a bounded resident footprint.

The second component is a deadline-aware AIMD admission controller. Once resident state is bounded, per-frame latency becomes a monotone function of load, and the controller can search online for the schedulable concurrency N*. The paper demonstrates the dependency rather than assuming it: the same controller over-admits and runs into collapse on the unbounded-KV system, but converges cleanly on the bounded one.

The paper also introduces a first-order pool-fill model to explain when collapse occurs. This model frames the cliff as a memory event driven by cumulative KV growth, not a compute bottleneck. That distinction is central. In ordinary chatbot serving, requests are ephemeral and KV can be freed, swapped, or recomputed between turns. In interaction serving, there is no idle gap, so the session state must remain resident. Standard throughput-oriented serving tricks do not solve the unbounded-state problem.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is end-to-end on a real full-duplex stack rather than a synthetic microbenchmark. The system includes WebSocket clients, a Go gateway, and a GPU worker, and the paper tests four interaction models. Representative timing scales are also realistic: Moshi operates around 80 ms frames, while omni-style models use roughly 1–2 second frames, and sessions last for minutes, long enough to expose pool saturation.

The main findings are clear. First, the unmodified resumable-KV path exhibits a sharp cliff under sustained load: per-frame latency stays in the millisecond range and then abruptly pins at a ceiling while the engine stops producing meaningful tokens. Second, the cliff is memory-triggered rather than compute-triggered; per-frame compute remains cheap until the end, but the block pool fills because each session keeps accumulating KV. Third, the failure is metastable: nominally identical five-minute runs may collapse or survive due to small run-to-run variation in pool fill. Fourth, and most importantly, bounded KV turns the cliff into a slope. Latency rises smoothly and monotonically with load, making the system observable again and allowing the AIMD controller to converge to a schedulable concurrency while shedding excess sessions cleanly.

The paper also includes quality-oriented ablations. Sliding windows are needed to bound resident memory, while pinned attention sinks are needed to preserve generation quality under the bounded context. Another important ablation shows controller dependence: the same admission controller fails without bounded KV and succeeds with it, which supports the claim that the gain comes from restoring a truthful latency signal rather than from controller tuning alone.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim starts with the introduction and the first few figures. The paper is easiest to understand once you accept that interaction serving is not just chatbot serving with audio attached; it is periodic deadlines plus ever-growing resident state. Then read the failure characterization section, especially the three properties of the collapse: memory-triggered, metastable, and silent. The first-order pool-fill model is also worth reading because it explains why the failure appears random in practice. After that, read the bounded-KV mechanism and the controller ablation, especially the section showing that admission control only works once resident state is bounded.

A practical 25-minute path is: Introduction → failure figures → bounded-KV mechanism → controller ablation. Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: why swap/recompute strategies from turn-based serving are not available here, and why attention sinks are necessary instead of using a sliding window alone. If your work touches speech or multimodal model deployment, the experimental plots are worth careful inspection because the paper exposes a failure mode that ordinary latency dashboards can easily miss.

recommendation.zh: 首次明确实时交互多模态/语音LLM serving的亚稳态KV崩溃盲区，重点看失效模式分析和KV窗口实现细节。
recommendation.en: First explicit analysis of metastable KV cache collapse in real-time interactive multimodal/audio LLM serving; focus on failure mode analysis and KV window implementation details.

paper.title: Tile-Level Activation Overlap for Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: SwiGLU is the dominant MLP activation in modern large language models, yet its intermediate tensor materialization costs 9-37% of MLP execution time. We present two complementary CUTLASS-based SM90 kernels that fuse SwiGLU into GeMM at the tile level. Kernel-1 overlaps Swish computation on the Gate accumulator with Up-tile loading using the Pingpong warp-specialized schedule; Kernel-2 interleaves SwiGLU with tile stores via a custom Epilogue Visitor Tree. Evaluated on Qwen-2.5 models (0.5B-72B)

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 LLM 推理中 SwiGLU MLP 的中间激活物化开销。现代模型的 gated MLP 需要分别计算 Gate=A W1 和 Up=A W2，再做 SiLU(Gate)⊙Up。常规实现会把 Gate 和 Up 写回 HBM，再读出做逐元素激活和乘法。作者在 H100 上的 profiling 显示，这部分占 MLP 时间的 9–37%，小模型更严重，例如 Qwen-2.5 0.5B 超过 30%。
summary.importance: 对预训练方法本身影响有限，但对基座模型的推理效率研究有直接参考价值。它指出 MLP 中的非 GEMM 部分已经成为可见瓶颈，尤其在 FP8、INT4 等让矩阵乘更便宜之后，激活和内存流量的相对成本会继续上升。对做模型结构或训练-部署联合设计的人来说，结论是明确的：SwiGLU 不是“免费”的，门控 MLP 的部署成本需要在架构选择时一起考虑。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是用 CUTLASS SM90 写两个 tile-level fused kernels，把 SwiGLU 融进 GEMM 的 tile 计算和 epilogue 中，避免 Gate/Up 中间张量落到 HBM。Kernel-1 使用 Hopper SM90 的 Pingpong warp-specialized schedule。生产者 warp 用 TMA 异步加载下一块数据，消费者 warp 做 MMA；作者利用 Gate tile 完成后、Up tile 加载期间的空隙，在寄存器里计算 Swish，然后继续计算 Up，最后在 epilogue 中做乘法并写回。这个版本使用 [M,N] threadblock，更适合较大 batch。Kernel-2 使用自定义 Epilogue Visitor Tree，设计 PairMulStore，在 tile store 阶段交织完成 SwiGLU，采用 [M,2N] threadblock，提升小 batch 时的 occupancy。区别于 torch.compile 这类图级融合，这里跨越的是两个独立 GEMM 和不同权重矩阵，编译器很难自动做出这种硬件调度级融合。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen-2.5 0.5B 到 72B、5 个 batch size，硬件为 NVIDIA H100。作者报告相对 PyTorch 最高 2.47× 加速，BF16 峰值利用率最高达到 79.5%。roofline 分析显示，融合后算术强度提升 6–247%，部分 workload 从 memory-bound 转向 compute-bound。torch.compile 即使开启最大优化和融合提示，也不能复现这种跨双 GEMM 的 tile-level fusion，整体比手写 kernel 慢 3–7×，有些情况下还不如 eager PyTorch。数值检查中，作者报告 fused kernels 为 0 mismatch，而 cuBLAS 路径有 4.5–11% mismatch；这一点需要看清比较口径，可能与参考实现、容差和计算顺序有关。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 的 profiling 结论、Method 中两个 kernel 的调度差异，以及实验部分的 roofline 分析和 batch-size 分段结果。若关注 serving kernel，可细看 Kernel-1 如何利用 Pingpong schedule 的空隙，以及 Kernel-2 的 Epilogue Visitor Tree 设计。若关注模型预训练，不需要投入太多时间，主要吸收 gated MLP 在部署侧的真实成本信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete inference bottleneck in SwiGLU MLPs. A standard gated MLP computes Gate=A W1 and Up=A W2, then applies SiLU(Gate)⊙Up. The usual implementation materializes Gate and Up in HBM before the elementwise activation. On H100, the authors profile this activation and materialization path as 9–37% of MLP time, with small models such as Qwen-2.5 0.5B paying more than 30%.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in inference kernels rather than pretraining methodology. It is still useful for foundation-model researchers because it quantifies a cost that is often hidden behind GEMM throughput. As FP8 and INT4 make matrix multiplication cheaper, the relative cost of activation traffic increases. The practical implication is that gated MLP choices should be evaluated with deployment kernels in mind, not only with training loss or parameter-count arguments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors implement two CUTLASS SM90 kernels that fuse SwiGLU at tile granularity and avoid HBM materialization of intermediate tensors. Kernel-1 uses the Hopper Pingpong warp-specialized schedule: producer warps issue TMA loads while consumer warps run MMA, and the idle window between Gate accumulation and Up computation is used to compute Swish in registers. It uses an [M,N] threadblock layout and is better suited to larger batches. Kernel-2 uses a custom Epilogue Visitor Tree with a PairMulStore visitor, interleaving SwiGLU with tile stores. Its [M,2N] layout improves occupancy for small batches. This is not ordinary graph fusion: the operation spans two independent GEMMs with distinct weight matrices, which explains why torch.compile cannot reproduce the same schedule.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Qwen-2.5 models from 0.5B to 72B across five batch sizes on NVIDIA H100. The reported speedup over PyTorch reaches 2.47×, and peak BF16 utilization reaches 79.5%. Roofline analysis shows a 6–247% increase in arithmetic intensity after removing intermediate traffic, shifting some cases from memory-bound toward compute-bound. torch.compile with aggressive settings remains 3–7× slower than the custom kernels for this pattern. The paper also reports 0 mismatches for the fused kernels versus 4.5–11% mismatches for a cuBLAS path; this result should be interpreted together with the exact reference, tolerance, and accumulation-order settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the profiling in the introduction, the two kernel designs in the method section, and the roofline plus batch-size breakdown in the experiments. Kernel engineers should inspect the Pingpong overlap in Kernel-1 and the Epilogue Visitor Tree in Kernel-2. Pretraining researchers can mainly take away the deployment-side cost signal of gated MLPs.

recommendation.zh: 非常扎实的底层算子优化工作，证明了在 H100 上 torch.compile 仍无法替代手写 CUTLASS kernel，做推理加速/Serving 的同学必看。
recommendation.en: Solid low-level operator optimization proving torch.compile still cannot replace hand-written CUTLASS kernels on H100; a must-read for inference acceleration/serving engineers.

paper.title: Online Linear Programming for Multi-Objective Routing in LLM Serving
paper.abstract: We study the online routing problem in large language model serving, where requests arrive sequentially and must be dispatched to parallel decode workers under tight batch-size and KV-cache constraints. Unlike widely used routing heuristics that are not tied to explicit service-level objectives (SLOs) and offer limited control over latency-throughput trade-offs, we introduce a multi-objective optimization framework that formulates routing as an online linear programming with interpretable decisi

summary.core_problem: LLM serving 中请求在线到达时，如何在 batch-size 与 KV-cache 约束下做路由，并显式控制多种 SLO（延迟/吞吐/收益）权衡。
summary.importance: 把常见“启发式路由”改写成可解释的在线优化目标（online LP + shadow price），对大规模推理系统的可控性与可调参性更强；对预训练本身不直接，但对“训练-推理闭环”的成本与吞吐约束有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach: 将路由建模为在线线性规划：每个请求有 SLO 加权收益，资源约束由 KV-cache、并行 decode worker、batch 约束表达；用 bid-price control（对偶变量/影子价格）决定接收与分配；为毫秒级决策实现 warm-start 的投影一阶更新，在线跟踪对偶价格以保证稳定运行时延。
summary.experiments: 在 Vidur simulator 集成路由器，对比“标准基线路由策略”（摘要未给出具体名称与数值）；在多个 SLO regime 下展示显著改进（摘要截断，缺少具体提升幅度、模型/trace 规模与统计显著性细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: Online request routing for LLM serving under tight batch-size and KV-cache constraints, with explicit control over multiple SLOs (latency/throughput/utility).
summary_en.importance: Replaces ad-hoc routing heuristics with an interpretable online optimization objective (online LP + shadow prices). Not pretraining-facing, but relevant to the training–inference cost loop and controllable serving trade-offs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates routing as an online linear program with SLO-weighted rewards and resource constraints; uses bid-price control via dual shadow prices to admit/route requests; implements millisecond decisions with warm-started projected first-order dual updates to track evolving prices online.
summary_en.experiments: Integrated into the Vidur simulator; reports substantial gains over standard routing baselines across multiple SLO regimes (abstract is truncated; lacks concrete numbers, traces, and ablation details).

recommendation.zh: 把“路由拍脑袋”换成 shadow price 的可控框架，适合做 serving 侧成本建模；但只在模拟器里赢，先当工程思路备查。
recommendation.en: A clean shadow-price framing for controllable routing—useful for serving cost modeling, but simulator-only wins make it a weak signal until reproduced on real traces.

paper.title: TraceLab: Characterizing Coding Agent Workloads for LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Coding agents are rapidly becoming a major application of agentic LLMs, but serving them efficiently remains challenging. Progress on this challenge requires understanding real workload patterns, yet the data needed for such analysis is largely absent. Existing public traces and benchmarks do not capture real, day-to-day coding-agent usage across multiple agents and model families for serving-system analysis. To help fill this gap, we collect and release a trace of roughly 4,300 coding-agent ses

summary.core_problem: 编码 Agent 正成为 LLM 的重要负载，但现有公开 trace 和能力 benchmark 都无法反映真实日常使用中多模型、多 Agent、多步工具调用的工作负载特征，导致服务系统优化缺乏数据依据。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 pretrain↔posttrain↔serving 的闭环视角：编码 Agent 的真实使用模式（长上下文、短输出、频繁工具调用、高前缀缓存依赖）直接反推基座模型应该在哪些维度优化——长上下文注意力效率、工具调用格式的稳定性、短输出场景的 decode 开销、推理时的 KV-cache 友好结构。这些数据也能指导构造更贴近真实分布的 agent 预训练 / SFT 数据混合，而不是只在 SWE-bench 这类窄任务上过拟合。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一套 trace 采集、格式归一化、隐私匿名化、统计分析的完整流水线。数据来自 43 名开发者约 8 个月的日常使用，覆盖 Claude Code 和 Codex 两个 Agent、20+ 模型版本。分析维度分为四层：(1) 会话级：自主循环长度、完成时长、上下文增长与缩减模式；(2) 单步 LLM 调用级：前缀 token 数、新增输入 token 数、输出 token 数、decode 速度与 TTFT；(3) 工具调用级：工具种类分布、调用频次长尾、延迟长尾；(4) 前缀缓存级：命中率、miss 来源、miss 带来的额外 prefill 开销。最后基于观察提出面向编码 Agent 的服务系统优化方向。
summary.experiments: 核心统计结果：约 4,300 个会话、350,000 次 LLM 步骤、430,000 次工具调用。会话平均 8.8 次 LLM 调用、10.8 次工具调用，平均完成时长 4.3 分钟，p90 超过 6.4 分钟。单步中位数：前缀缓存读取约 119K token、新增输入 875 token、输出仅 214 token，呈现典型长上下文短输出特征。decode 速度中位数：Claude 46.8 归一化 token/s，Codex 33.9 归一化 token/s，变异系数均大于 50%；Codex 纯 decode 中位数 61.3 token/s，TTFT 约 3.1 秒。工具调用：观察到 80+ 种工具，前 3 种工具占全部调用的 80% 以上；超过 1 分钟的工具调用只占 4%，却占总工具调用时间的 85%。前缀缓存全局命中率 95.7%，主要 miss 发生在跨请求的人类思考/输入间隙（超过缓存淘汰时间）；缓存 miss 导致的额外 prefill token 数是真正新输入 token 的 3.8 倍。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。先读引言和贡献部分明确数据规模与覆盖范围；然后直接看各节的统计图表和关键分位数数字，跳过流水线的工程实现细节；重点关注会话级上下文增长模式、单步 token 长度分布、工具延迟长尾、前缀缓存 miss 来源这四组观察；最后读作者列出的系统优化方向清单，把其中与模型架构/训练相关的点（稀疏注意力、KV 缓存友好结构、工具延迟预测的语义信号）摘出来即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Coding agents are becoming a major LLM workload, but existing public traces and capability benchmarks fail to capture real, day-to-day usage patterns across multiple agents, model families, and multi-step tool-calling behavior, leaving serving-system optimizations without empirical grounding.
summary_en.importance: The main implication for pretraining research lies in the closed-loop view of pretrain ↔ posttrain ↔ serving. Real coding-agent usage patterns—long contexts, short outputs, frequent tool calls, heavy reliance on prefix caching—directly suggest which dimensions base models should be optimized for: long-context attention efficiency, stability of tool-call formatting, decode cost under short-output regimes, and KV-cache-friendly structures during inference. These statistics can also guide the construction of agentic pretraining / SFT data mixtures that better match real usage, instead of overfitting to narrow benchmarks such as SWE-bench.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds a complete pipeline for trace collection, format normalization, privacy anonymization, and statistical analysis. Data comes from 43 developers over roughly eight months of daily use, covering two agents (Claude Code and Codex) and more than 20 model versions. Analysis is organized into four layers: (1) Session level: length of autonomous loops, end-to-end completion time, patterns of context growth and reduction. (2) Per-step LLM invocation level: prefix tokens, newly appended input tokens, output tokens, decode speed, and TTFT. (3) Tool-call level: tool-type distribution, long-tailed call frequency, and long-tailed latency. (4) Prefix-cache level: hit rate, sources of misses, and extra prefill cost caused by misses. The paper concludes with a list of serving-system optimization directions derived from these observations.
summary_en.experiments: Key statistics: roughly 4,300 sessions, 350,000 LLM steps, and 430,000 tool calls. Per session: on average 8.8 LLM calls, 10.8 tool invocations, 4.3 minutes mean completion time with p90 above 6.4 minutes. Per-step medians: about 119K tokens read from prefix cache, 875 newly appended input tokens, and only 214 output tokens—a clear long-context / short-output profile. Decode speed medians: 46.8 normalized tokens/s for Claude and 33.9 for Codex, both with coefficient of variation above 50%; Codex has a median pure decode speed of 61.3 tokens/s and estimated TTFT of 3.1 seconds per step. Tool calls: more than 80 distinct tools observed, with the top 3 tools accounting for over 80% of all invocations; tool calls longer than 1 minute represent only 4% of calls but 85% of total tool-call time. Prefix cache: 95.7% global hit rate; most misses occur across request boundaries during human reading / thinking / typing gaps that exceed cache eviction windows; cache misses cause 3.8× more tokens to be prefilled than truly unique input tokens would require.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading, estimated 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction and contributions to grasp dataset scale and coverage. Then jump directly to the statistical figures and key percentile numbers in each analysis section, skipping low-level engineering details of the collection pipeline. Focus on four groups of observations: session-level context growth patterns, per-step token length distributions, long-tailed tool latency, and sources of prefix-cache misses. Finally, read the list of proposed system optimizations and extract points relevant to model architecture and training—sparse attention, KV-cache-friendly structures, and semantic signals for tool-latency prediction.

recommendation.zh: UW团队发布的首个真实代码智能体工作负载trace，§3的负载统计可直接指导agent基座的训练数据分布设计与推理适配
recommendation.en: First real coding agent workload trace released by UW team; §3 workload statistics can directly guide training data distribution design and inference adaptation for agent foundation models

paper.title: ReFreeKV: Towards Threshold-Free KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: To reduce memory consumption during LLM inference, a handful of methods have been proposed for KV cache pruning. While these techniques can accomplish lossless memory reduction on many datasets, they often hinge on an under-emphasized condition: an input/domain-specific threshold for KV cache budget needs to be pre-determined to achieve the optimal performance. However, such input-sensitive design may be considerably limited in real-world scenarios, as open-domain inputs span diverse domains, le

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 KV cache 压缩方法在真实开放输入中依赖数据集特定阈值的问题：同一个 cache budget 在 LongBench、GSM8K、needle-in-the-haystack 等任务上表现差异很大，固定阈值难以迁移。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对长上下文模型的推理侧评估有启发。它把 KV 压缩目标从“在某个 benchmark 上压到多小”改成“在不调输入特定阈值的情况下维持接近 full-cache 的性能”。这个目标更接近实际服务场景，也提醒长上下文能力评估不能只看单一数据集上的压缩率。
summary.technical_approach: ReFreeKV 采用两阶段流程。第一步根据位置重要性对所有 KV cache 位置排序。第二步按排序逐步保留 key-value 向量，并用一个输入不敏感的停止准则决定何时停止保留。核心是 Uni-Metric：它不是为每个数据集预先设定 cache ratio 或固定 token 数，而是用一个相对稳定的指标动态决定预算。方法仍然有停止阈值，但不需要针对输入域、长度或任务难度校准。实现上强调并行算子，避免逐 token 的顺序处理，使延迟接近已有高效 KV pruning 方法。
summary.experiments: 论文使用 13 个数据集，覆盖数学与常识推理、阅读理解、代码、长上下文检索等任务，并在多个规模的 LLM 上测试。引言给出的关键数字包括：Llama3-70B 在 20K tokens 下 KV cache 可达约 50GB；D2O 在 LongBench 上 20% cache budget 可接近 full-cache，但在 GSM8K 上可能需要约 80%；CAKE 在 LongBench 上保留 1024 个位置可行，但同样预算在 needle-in-the-haystack 上失效。ReFreeKV 在 Llama3-8B 上自动分配平均 63.7% 的 KV budget，并在 13 个数据集平均表现上略高于 full-cache。它不是每个数据集压缩率最高的方法，但在“不调数据集阈值且保持性能”这个约束下更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对阈值敏感性的实验动机，尤其是不同数据集所需预算差异；再看 Methodology 中 Uni-Metric 的定义和停止准则，这是论文的主要技术点；最后看 Table 2 和延迟实验，判断它是否真的在性能、压缩率、运行开销之间取得了可用折中。对基座预训练研究员来说，不必深挖所有推理系统实现细节，但可以关注它提出的评估目标：压缩方法需要在混合分布输入上稳定，而不是只在单一 benchmark 上报告最优预算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical weakness in KV-cache compression: most pruning methods require an input- or dataset-specific cache budget, and the same threshold can fail badly when domains, sequence lengths, or task difficulty change.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its useful lesson for foundation-model work is the evaluation objective. For long-context models, a KV-compression method should not only report the smallest budget on a fixed benchmark; it should preserve full-cache behavior under mixed, open-domain inputs without per-dataset calibration.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReFreeKV uses a two-stage pruning procedure. It first ranks cache positions by positional importance, then keeps KV vectors progressively according to that ranking until a stopping rule is satisfied. The key component is Uni-Metric, a stopping metric designed to be insensitive to input domain and sequence length. The method is not literally thresholdless; rather, its threshold does not need to be tuned for each dataset or input type. The implementation is designed around parallel operators, so the pruning overhead stays comparable to prior efficient KV-pruning approaches.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 13 datasets spanning reasoning, reading comprehension, coding, and long-context retrieval, with multiple LLM sizes. The paper reports several calibration failures for prior methods: D2O can match full-cache performance on LongBench with a 20% budget but may need around 80% on GSM8K; CAKE works with 1024 retained positions on LongBench but underperforms on needle-in-the-haystack. With Llama3-8B, ReFreeKV allocates an average KV budget of 63.7% and slightly exceeds full-cache performance on average across the 13 datasets. Its main result is not maximum compression on every dataset, but stable performance without dataset-specific budget tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the motivation experiments in the introduction first, because they define the failure mode clearly. Then focus on the Uni-Metric definition and the stopping rule in the method section. The most informative results are the mixed-dataset comparison table and the latency study. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main takeaway is the evaluation principle for long-context serving: robustness under distribution mixtures matters more than a tuned compression ratio on one benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 预训练研究员重点看§3的目标函数设计，其自适应预算思想可迁移到训练时的稀疏注意力正则与KV感知预训练。
recommendation.en: For pretraining researchers, focus on §3 objective design; its adaptive budgeting idea transfers to sparse attention regularization and KV-aware pretraining.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: KernelSight-LM: A Kernel-Level LLM Inference Simulator
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) move into production serving, practitioners must rapidly evaluate inference performance across diverse hardware, models, and serving parameters to meet cost and latency targets. However, the end-to-end behavior of LLMs couples serving-layer policies with low-level GPU kernel execution and rapidly evolving architectures, forcing slow, deployment-specific benchmarking that is hard to generalize.   We present KernelSight-LM, a fine-grained inference simulator that mo

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM推理性能评估需要在目标硬件上做端到端实测，成本高、泛化性差，难以快速迭代serving配置与硬件选型。
summary.importance: 工程系统创新，提出细粒度内核级LLM推理模拟器，支持跨GPU世代的性能预测，无需目标硬件实测即可输出延迟拆解。
summary.technical_approach: 将每个serving步骤拆解为带学习效率项的roofline内核模型、通信模型、主机开销模型，通过离散事件调度器组合，原生支持前缀缓存、连续批处理等机制；提供两档预测：跨世代预测（无需目标GPU数据，仅需硬件规格）和校准预测（少量实测数据换更高精度）。
summary.experiments: 跨不同GPU、模型架构、serving参数验证，跨世代预测延迟误差处于可用范围，内核级延迟拆解与实测匹配度高，可准确捕捉连续批处理、前缀缓存带来的性能变化。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自波士顿大学、AWS AI，其中George Karypis是AWS资深首席科学家，长期从事图计算、推荐系统、大规模ML系统研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Current LLM inference performance evaluation requires end-to-end measurement on target hardware, incurring high cost and poor generalizability, making rapid iteration of serving configurations and hardware selection difficult.
summary_en.importance: Engineering system contribution, presenting a fine-grained kernel-level LLM inference simulator that supports cross-GPU performance prediction without on-device measurement, and produces granular latency breakdowns.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes each serving step into a roofline kernel model with learned efficiency term, communication model, and host overhead model, composed via a discrete-event scheduler that natively supports prefix caching and continuous batching; offers two prediction tiers: cross-generation (no target GPU data required, only hardware specs) and calibrated prediction (small amount of measurement for higher accuracy).
summary_en.experiments: Validated across diverse GPUs, model architectures, and serving parameters; cross-generation prediction achieves usable latency error, kernel-level breakdowns closely match real hardware measurements, and accurately captures performance gains from continuous batching and prefix caching.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Boston University and AWS AI; George Karypis is a Senior Principal Scientist at AWS with long-standing work in graph computing, recommender systems, and large-scale ML systems.

recommendation.zh: 推理性能建模工具，适合做架构tradeoff分析时快速估算延迟，无需读全文，知道有这个工具即可。
recommendation.en: Inference performance modeling tool useful for quick latency estimation during architecture tradeoff studies; no need to read the full paper, just be aware of its existence.

paper.title: Cluster, Route, Escalate: Cascaded Framework for Cost-Aware LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs) in production forces a trade-off between accuracy and cost. Operators often default to a single model that is either expensive for easy queries or insufficient for hard ones. To address this challenge, we propose a two-stage cascaded solution. Stage 1 clusters incoming queries and assigns each cluster to its most cost-effective model. The cost budget for this routing process is set by an interpretable hyperparameter, tuned offline. Stage 2 add

summary.core_problem: 在生产环境中，单一 LLM 服务策略容易在简单请求上浪费昂贵模型算力，在困难请求上又可能精度不足。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理服务系统改进。它关注模型池中的成本—质量路由问题，对 serving 和模型级联有实用价值，但对基座预训练方法本身的增量信息有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两阶段级联系统：第一阶段先对输入 query 聚类，并为每个 cluster 离线选择最具成本效率的模型，路由预算由可解释超参数控制；第二阶段加入质量估计级联，当第一阶段输出被判定为低质量时，再升级到更强模型。方法不需要人工重配模型池，只依赖任务正确性标签进行离线调参。
summary.experiments: 论文报告在测试数据集上保留最强模型 97-99% 的准确率，同时降低 Time Per Output Token。摘要未给出具体模型池规模、数据集名称、TPOT 降幅和与现有路由器的详细对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 ADAPT Centre、Trinity College Dublin 和 Huawei Research。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the cost-quality trade-off in production LLM serving, where a single-model policy is wasteful for easy queries and underpowered for hard ones.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a serving-system improvement for cost-aware model cascading. It is practically relevant to deployment, but it does not directly change pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses a two-stage cascade. Stage one clusters incoming queries and assigns each cluster to the most cost-effective model under an interpretable offline-tuned budget parameter. Stage two adds a quality-estimation cascade that escalates low-confidence or low-quality outputs to stronger models.
summary_en.experiments: The reported system retains 97-99% of the strongest model's accuracy on test datasets while reducing Time Per Output Token. The abstract does not specify the model pool, datasets, absolute TPOT gains, or full routing baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with ADAPT Centre, Trinity College Dublin, and Huawei Research.

recommendation.zh: 这是常规级联 serving 工作；扫一下路由目标和 QE 触发条件即可，不会改变预训练侧判断。
recommendation.en: A standard cascaded serving paper; skim the routing objective and QE trigger, but it should not move any pretraining prior.

paper.title: PersistentKV: Page-Aware Decode Scheduling for Long-Context LLM Serving on Commodity GPUs
paper.abstract: Autoregressive large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly limited by key-value (KV) cache movement rather than dense matrix multiplication. Modern paged-attention systems reduce KV-cache fragmentation and mature kernels such as FlashInfer provide highly optimized native-paged decode attention. However, the best single-kernel implementation is not always the best serving schedule: low-active long-context decode can under-utilize commodity GPUs, while mixed sequence lengths introduce a ten

summary.core_problem: 在长上下文 LLM 推理的 decode 阶段，由于算术强度低，性能瓶颈往往在于 KV-cache 的访存和调度。现有的单一最优 kernel（如 FlashInfer）在面对低并发、长上下文或混合序列长度的 serving 场景时，可能无法充分利用 GPU 资源。
summary.importance: 深入探讨了长上下文 decode 阶段的调度策略，指出不存在“一招鲜”的 attention kernel。通过提出 PersistentKV 并与 FlashInfer 进行对比，强调了在 LLM serving 系统中，应根据请求状态动态选择 kernel 调度策略，而非强制使用单一方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 PersistentKV，一个针对 GQA (Grouped-Query Attention) 的原生块表 (block-table) decode attention 引擎。其核心设计包括：1) 按 KV-head 组映射任务，在分组的 query head 间复用 K,V tile；2) 采用原生 paged cache 布局，避免 KV 重排开销；3) 引入行级序列长度调度和紧凑工作队列 (workqueue)，使任务划分和预取严格遵循实际请求长度，减少 padding 浪费。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama 风格的 GQA 配置下，将 PersistentKV 与 FlashInfer 在相同的页表分布、上下文长度和数值精度下进行了直接对比。结果表明，PersistentKV 在低并发和中等并发的长上下文场景下具有优势，而 FlashInfer 在小 batch 场景下表现更好（因为 PersistentKV 的 split-merge 开销占主导）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Methodology 部分关于 PersistentKV 的任务映射（按 KV-head group 和 sequence split）以及紧凑工作队列的设计。实验部分需注意其在不同并发度和上下文长度下与 FlashInfer 的性能交叉点，这直接支撑了其“自适应调度”的核心主张。

summary_en.core_problem: During the decode phase of long-context LLM inference, low arithmetic intensity makes KV-cache memory traffic and scheduling the primary bottlenecks. A single highly-optimized kernel (like FlashInfer) may under-utilize GPUs in serving scenarios with low-active, long-context requests or mixed sequence lengths.
summary_en.importance: Provides a deep dive into decode scheduling for long-context LLMs, demonstrating that no single attention kernel is optimal across all regimes. By introducing PersistentKV and comparing it with FlashInfer, the paper advocates for an adaptive serving policy that chooses the kernel schedule based on request state rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all approach.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces PersistentKV, a native block-table decode attention engine tailored for Grouped-Query Attention (GQA). Key features include: 1) Mapping work by KV-head group to reuse K,V tiles across grouped query heads; 2) Operating directly on native paged cache layouts to avoid repacking overhead; 3) Implementing row-local sequence-length scheduling and a compact workqueue to align split boundaries and prefetches with true request lengths, minimizing padding waste.
summary_en.experiments: Compared PersistentKV directly against FlashInfer using a Llama-style GQA configuration under identical page-table distributions, context lengths, and numerical tolerances. Results indicate PersistentKV excels in low- and moderate-active long-context regimes, whereas FlashInfer remains superior for small active batches where PersistentKV's split-merge overhead dominates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methodology section detailing PersistentKV's work mapping (by KV-head group and sequence split) and the compact workqueue design. In the experiments, pay attention to the performance crossover points between PersistentKV and FlashInfer across different batch sizes and context lengths, which justify the proposed adaptive scheduling policy.

recommendation.zh: 只看调度设计和混合长度实验即可；它不改变模型训练，但能提醒长上下文效率瓶颈已从 kernel 转到 page-level scheduling。
recommendation.en: Read the scheduler and mixed-length experiments; it does not change training, but it shows long-context serving bottlenecks moving from kernels to page-level scheduling.

paper.title: OpenAI and Broadcom unveil LLM-optimized inference chip
paper.abstract: OpenAI and Broadcom introduce Jalapeño, a custom AI chip built for LLM inference to improve performance, efficiency, and scale across AI systems.

summary.core_problem: OpenAI 与 Broadcom 发布面向 LLM 推理优化的定制 AI 芯片 Jalapeño，目标是提高推理性能、能效和规模化部署能力。
summary.importance: 这是顶级实验室围绕推理硬件栈的行业动态。它不直接推进预训练算法，但会影响未来模型服务成本、模型形态选择、KV-cache/带宽权衡以及推理侧计算预算。
summary.technical_approach: 公开摘要只说明芯片面向 LLM inference 优化，并由 OpenAI 与 Broadcom 共同推出；未披露具体架构、制程、内存层级、互联、精度格式、编译栈或 benchmark 细节。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出吞吐、延迟、能效、成本、模型规模、上下文长度或与 GPU/TPU/ASIC 的量化对比。因此当前只能作为产业信号，不能作为技术结论引用。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research 是 OpenAI 的研究发布渠道；Broadcom 是网络与定制芯片领域的重要供应商。该发布反映 OpenAI 正在更深地介入 LLM 推理硬件协同设计。

summary_en.core_problem: OpenAI and Broadcom announce Jalapeño, a custom AI chip optimized for LLM inference, aiming to improve performance, efficiency, and deployment scale.
summary_en.importance: This is an industry signal from a top lab around the inference hardware stack. It does not directly advance pretraining algorithms, but it may affect serving cost models, model-shape decisions, KV-cache and bandwidth tradeoffs, and inference compute budgets.
summary_en.technical_approach: The public abstract only states that the chip is optimized for LLM inference and co-developed by OpenAI and Broadcom. It does not disclose architecture, process node, memory hierarchy, interconnect, numerical formats, compiler stack, or benchmark details.
summary_en.experiments: No throughput, latency, energy efficiency, cost, model scale, context length, or GPU/TPU/ASIC comparison is provided in the abstract. At this point it should be treated as an industry signal rather than technical evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: OpenAI Research is OpenAI's research communication channel. Broadcom is a major vendor in networking and custom silicon. The announcement suggests deeper OpenAI involvement in LLM inference hardware co-design.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫一眼硬件约束信号；没有公开指标前，别把它当推理架构证据。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming as a hardware-constraint signal; without public metrics, it is not evidence for inference architecture decisions.

paper.title: Geometry-Aware Online Scheduling for LLM Serving: From Theoretical Bound to System Practice
paper.abstract: The explosive demand for interactive Large Language Model serving has highlighted the management of the Key-Value cache's dynamic memory footprint as a critical area for performance optimization in inference engines. Modern inference systems overwhelmingly rely on time-centric scheduling heuristics, such as Shortest Job First. However, their theoretical optimality is rooted in traditional schedule modeling, failing to capture the highly dynamic, 2D spatio-temporal geometric growth specific to LL

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM推理调度普遍采用SJF（短作业优先）等一维时间优先的启发式策略，未建模LLM推理独有的KV缓存时空二维动态增长特性：自回归解码每生成一个token就线性扩张KV内存占用，连续批处理机制带来batch size的动态波动。已有理论证明SJF在LLM服务模型下最坏情况竞争比无界，导致平均延迟与尾延迟优化存在根本性缺陷。
summary.importance: 现有LLM服务调度多依赖工程启发式，缺少跨工作负载的通用性能保证。这套几何调度框架把KV缓存与时间的耦合关系建模从经验试错推进到有严格理论界支撑的层面，为推理友好的预训练设计、KV缓存结构优化、长序列训练的内存-时间权衡提供了系统侧的参考基准。轻量版1-bit SVF几乎不需要额外预测开销，可直接集成进vLLM等主流推理框架，落地成本低。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是将调度优先级从一维的“剩余执行时间”替换为二维的“KV缓存占用对时间的积分（即KV体积）”，提出Smallest Volume First（SVF）算法：优先调度KV体积最小的请求，从几何层面匹配LLM推理的内存-时间耦合特性。进一步提出1-bit SVF轻量变体，仅需1比特信息（判断请求输出长度属于长序列还是短序列）即可实现接近完整SVF的调度效果，无需精准预测输出长度。理论推导覆盖不同流量模型、不同信息可得性下的四类竞争比界，其中突发流量到达、已知输出长度场景下的最坏情况竞争比从此前的48收紧至5。实现上为vLLM的即插即用调度器替换，与分页注意力、连续批处理等现有底层执行优化完全兼容。
summary.experiments: 集成进vLLM的评测显示，SVF可同时降低平均延迟与尾延迟；1-bit SVF仅需极少量预测信息，调度本身计算开销可忽略，性能接近完整SVF。算法与现有推理系统的执行层优化无冲突，叠加使用不会引入额外开销。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言中对传统调度理论与LLM推理动态特性的本质差异分析，以及SVF/1-bit SVF的核心设计逻辑、理论边界条件。形式化证明部分可跳过，系统实现部分仅需了解与vLLM的集成方式即可，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。从事推理系统研发的读者可重点关注几何建模的证明思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM inference schedulers overwhelmingly rely on 1D time-centric heuristics such as Shortest Job First (SJF), which fail to model the unique 2D spatio-temporal dynamics of LLM decoding: autoregressive generation linearly expands KV cache memory per output token, and continuous batching introduces dynamic fluctuations in concurrent batch size. Prior theoretical work has proven SJF has an unbounded worst-case competitive ratio under LLM-specific serving models, creating fundamental limits to average and tail latency optimization.
summary_en.importance: Most production LLM scheduling rules are derived from ad-hoc engineering heuristics without universal performance guarantees across workloads. The geometric scheduling framework models the coupled dynamics of KV cache memory and time with rigorous competitive ratio bounds, providing a system-level reference for inference-aware pretraining design, KV cache compression, and memory-time tradeoffs in long-context training. The lightweight 1-bit SVF variant requires almost no additional prediction overhead and can be directly integrated into mainstream inference frameworks such as vLLM with minimal deployment cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design replaces the 1D 'remaining processing time' priority metric with a 2D measure: the integral of KV cache consumption over time, referred to as KV 'volume'. The Smallest Volume First (SVF) algorithm prioritizes requests with the smallest predicted KV volume, natively matching the memory-time coupling of LLM decoding. A lightweight 1-bit SVF variant requires only a single bit of information (whether a request will produce a long or short output) to achieve near-SVF performance, eliminating the need for precise output length prediction. Four separate competitive ratio bounds are derived across traffic models and information availability settings; most notably, the worst-case competitive ratio under burst arrival with known output lengths is tightened from the prior bound of 48 to 5. The implementation is a plug-and-play scheduler replacement for vLLM, fully compatible with existing execution optimizations including paged attention and continuous batching.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations in the vLLM framework show SVF reduces both average and tail latency across workloads. 1-bit SVF delivers near-identical performance with negligible scheduling compute overhead, requiring no precise length prediction. The scheduler operates orthogonally to lower-level inference optimizations, and can be deployed without modifying existing execution engine logic.
summary_en.reading_guide: For casual reading, focus on the introduction's analysis of fundamental mismatches between classical scheduling theory and LLM inference dynamics, the core design logic of SVF and 1-bit SVF, and the high-level conditions for the theoretical bounds. Formal proofs can be skipped unless working directly on LLM serving systems; skim the implementation section for vLLM integration notes. Expected reading time: 15-20 minutes. Readers focused on inference systems may dive into the proof methodology for the geometric scheduling model.

recommendation.zh: 只看调度模型和竞争比证明即可；它把 KV-cache 成本从“时间”改成“体积”，这个抽象值得系统侧复用。
recommendation.en: Read the scheduling model and competitive-ratio proof; the useful abstraction is treating KV-cache cost as volume rather than time.

paper.title: RLM-Cascade: Response-Level Speculative Decoding for Cost-Efficient LLM API Serving
paper.abstract: We present RLM-Cascade, a proxy-layer system that applies speculative decoding at the response level to reduce LLM API costs without requiring model architecture access or a shared vocabulary. A fast, inexpensive draft model generates a candidate response; a capable verify model accepts, enhances, or is bypassed entirely depending on a lightweight complexity router. On a real-world agentic coding workload (Claude Code), RLM-Cascade achieves a draft-use rate of 88.8% across 125 production request

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很工程化但也很现实的问题：在只能通过黑盒 API 调用不同厂商模型、拿不到 logits、也没有共享词表的前提下，如何把 speculative decoding 的思路迁移到生产级 LLM serving，降低大模型 API 成本，同时尽量不牺牲质量。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接启发有限，因为核心贡献在 serving proxy 和跨 API 编排，不在训练方法。但它对后训练系统和 agent 部署有一个值得记住的点：很多真实工作负载的收益不来自更细的 token-level 技术，而来自 workload 结构本身。这里真正带来成本和延迟改善的，不只是 draft→verify，而是大量请求可以被 router 直接判成 SKIPPED，用便宜模型单独处理。这对研究推理系统、agent serving、以及训练时如何按 turn type 分层建模有一些间接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法可以概括为 response-level speculative decoding。不同于传统 speculative decoding 需要 draft model 和 verify model 共享词表并暴露 token logits，这里把“完整响应”作为 speculation 单位。便宜模型先生成整段候选回复，强模型再做整体判定：直接接受、增强改写，或者在某些请求上完全绕过。

系统由三部分组成。第一是 proxy 层，拦截 Anthropic API 请求，对客户端保持兼容，不需要改 Claude Code 客户端。第二是 rule-based complexity router：若请求包含 tools 字段，直接走 Opus，因为小模型不稳定地产生 schema-correct 的 tool JSON；若是普通文本生成，则用关键词和长度阈值做 O(1) 路由，把简单请求直接交给 DeepSeek，复杂请求走 draft→verify。第三是 verify 阶段，强模型不做 token 级 acceptance，而是用自然语言判断 draft 是否可用，必要时增强。

和已有工作相比，它不是 FrugalGPT 那种单次请求只选一个模型的 routing，也不是标准 speculative decoding 那种 lossless token verification。它处在两者之间：同一请求可先由小模型起草，再由大模型做 response-level 审核。代价是理论上不再保持 verifier 分布不变，收益是可以跨 provider、跨架构、纯 API 落地。
summary.experiments:
实验主要基于真实 agentic coding workload，场景是 Claude Code。系统使用 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 作为 draft，Claude Opus 4.8 作为 verify。作者报告在 125 个生产请求上，draft-use rate 为 88.8%，相对直接调用 Opus 的基线，API 成本下降 45.8%。更有意思的是延迟也下降：p50 从 3698 ms 降到 2026 ms，约 1.83× 加速。作者解释原因不是 verify 更快，而是 SKIPPED 路径占了工作负载的大头，约 64–70% 请求根本不需要 Opus。

质量方面，文中给了一个 20 任务 benchmark，RLM-Cascade pass rate 为 100%，直接 Opus 基线为 95%。这个结果可以看，但不宜过度解读：样本量偏小，而且 benchmark 是否覆盖复杂失败模式、router 误判、tool-call 边界情况，决定了结论强度。

从正文描述看，tool-selection turn 在生产会话中约占 70–80%，而 speculative 只作用于剩余 20–30% 的 text-generation turn。这一点很关键，也解释了为什么系统必须做 tool-call carve-out，否则 schema failure 会直接破坏 agent loop。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可，重点看 Introduction、System Design 和结果表。先确认问题设定：黑盒 API、异构模型、无共享词表。然后看 router 规则和三条路径——SKIPPED、draft→verify、tool bypass——因为真正决定收益的是流量分布，而不是 verify prompt 本身。

实验部分主要看三件事：一是 workload 构成，尤其 tool turn 与 text turn 的比例；二是成本和延迟拆账，确认收益来自哪里；三是质量评估是否足够严格。若时间有限，20–30 分钟足够抓住主线。

值得留意的局限也很明显：router 是规则式的，泛化能力有限；response-level verification 不是 lossless speculative decoding，质量保证依赖 verifier prompt；评测规模较小，且高度绑定 Claude Code 这一工作负载。若关心 serving 系统而非训练，可把它当作一个可复用的工程模式；若关心 pretrain，本篇只需了解其 workload 结构观察。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical serving problem: how to obtain some of the benefits of speculative decoding when models are only accessible through black-box APIs, do not share a vocabulary, and do not expose token logits.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited, since the contribution is a serving-layer system rather than a training method. The useful takeaway is structural: in real agent workloads, large gains may come less from fine-grained token tricks and more from workload decomposition. In this system, much of the benefit comes from routing a large fraction of requests to a cheap model without ever invoking the expensive verifier. That observation is indirectly relevant to post-training and agent system design, especially when different turn types have very different quality requirements.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core idea is response-level speculative decoding. Instead of drafting k tokens and verifying them with token-level acceptance, a cheap model drafts an entire response and a stronger model decides whether to accept it, enhance it, or be skipped entirely. This makes the method deployable across providers and architectures through standard HTTP APIs.

The system has three main components. First, a proxy layer intercepts Anthropic-format API calls, so the client can remain unchanged. Second, a rule-based complexity router sends tool-selection requests directly to Opus, because smaller models are unreliable at producing schema-valid tool JSON; simple text-generation requests are sent directly to DeepSeek; more complex text requests go through draft→verify. Third, the verifier performs response-level judgment in natural language rather than token-level acceptance.

Relative to prior work, this is neither standard speculative decoding nor pure request-level routing. It sits between them: both models can participate on the same request, but only through API-level orchestration. The trade-off is clear. It loses the lossless guarantee of token-level speculative decoding, but gains deployability across heterogeneous black-box models.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is built around a real agentic coding workload using Claude Code. DeepSeek-V4-Pro serves as the draft model and Claude Opus 4.8 as the verifier. On 125 production requests, the paper reports an 88.8% draft-use rate and a 45.8% API cost reduction relative to a direct Opus baseline.

Latency also improves: median response time drops from 3698 ms to 2026 ms, a 1.83x speedup at p50. The reason is not that verification is intrinsically faster, but that the SKIPPED path dominates the workload, with roughly 64–70% of requests handled by the cheap model alone.

For quality, the paper reports 100% pass rate on a 20-task benchmark versus 95% for the direct Opus baseline. This is directionally interesting but should be treated cautiously because the benchmark is small and may not fully cover routing mistakes, verifier failures, or edge cases in tool use.

One operational detail matters a lot: tool-selection turns account for roughly 70–80% of production turns, while speculative handling only applies to the remaining text-generation turns. That explains why the tool-bypass rule is essential.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Read the introduction, system design, and the main results table. First confirm the deployment setting: black-box APIs, heterogeneous models, no shared vocabulary. Then focus on the three execution paths—SKIPPED, draft→verify, and tool bypass—because the gains depend more on traffic composition than on the verifier prompt itself.

In the experiments, check three things: the workload mix, the cost/latency breakdown, and how strict the quality evaluation really is. If time is limited, 20–30 minutes is enough to extract the main idea.

The limitations are straightforward. The router is rule-based and may not generalize well. Response-level verification is not lossless. The evaluation is small and tightly coupled to Claude Code. For serving researchers, it is a reusable systems pattern. For pretraining researchers, it is mainly a useful workload observation rather than a training contribution.

recommendation.zh: 读系统设计和 workload 分布即可；黑盒 API 级联很实用，但 125 个请求支撑不了泛化结论。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and workload distribution; black-box API cascading is practical, but 125 requests cannot support broad generalization.

paper.title: Recency/Frequency Adaptive KV Caching for Large Language Model Serving
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) caching is a powerful technique for accelerating large language model inference and generation. Inference workloads are large and diverse, which makes them difficult to cache effectively. Existing cache management strategies adopt the least-recently-used policy for evicting cache blocks. However, LRU leads to multiple unrelated workloads flushing each other's caches. To address this, we integrate adaptive caching that dynamically allocates cache space between recently and frequent

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM serving 中 KV cache 只按 LRU 驱逐时，异质请求流会相互冲刷缓存、降低命中率和首 token 延迟的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统层面的缓存策略改进，对长上下文、多租户和 RAG/文档问答服务有实际参考价值；贡献是把 recency 与 frequency 自适应结合，而不是改模型结构或训练目标。
summary.technical_approach: 方法在 KV cache 管理中动态分配空间给最近出现和高频出现的 cache blocks，避免单纯 LRU 被多个无关 workload 轮流污染。它面向 vLLM 式块级 KV 管理，可解释性较强，并支持 batch inference。
summary.experiments: 在合成文档问答 workload 上，相比 naive vLLM，KV cache hit rate 最多提升 10.8%，TTFT 最多降低 12.6%；在真实对话 workload 上，命中率和 TTFT 分别提升 2.1% 和 2.0%。摘要未给出模型规模和硬件细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV-cache eviction in LLM serving, where a pure LRU policy lets heterogeneous request streams flush each other’s useful cache blocks and hurts time to first token.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems contribution relevant to long-context, multi-tenant, and RAG/document-QA serving. The main idea is an adaptive recency-frequency cache policy rather than a change to model architecture or training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method dynamically partitions KV-cache capacity between recently accessed and frequently reused blocks, reducing cache pollution from unrelated workloads. It targets vLLM-style block-level KV management, remains interpretable, and generalizes to batched inference.
summary_en.experiments: On synthetic document-QA workloads, it improves KV-cache hit rate by up to 10.8% and reduces TTFT by up to 12.6% over naive vLLM. On real conversation workloads, the gains are 2.1% hit-rate improvement and 2.0% TTFT reduction. Model scale and hardware details are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验 workload 和消融即可；真实对话收益很小，但 recency/frequency 拆分适合内网 serving 复现。
recommendation.en: Read the workload setup and ablations only; real-chat gains are small, but the recency/frequency split is worth reproducing in internal serving.

paper.title: FlexServe: A Fast and Secure LLM Serving System for Mobile Devices with Flexible Resource Isolation
paper.abstract: Device-side Large Language Models (LLMs) have grown explosively, offering stronger privacy and higher availability than their cloud-side counterparts. During LLM inference, both the model weights and the user data are valuable, and attackers may compromise the OS kernel to steal them. ARM TrustZone is the de facto hardware-based isolation technology on mobile devices, used to protect sensitive applications from a compromised OS. However, protecting LLM inference with TrustZone incurs significant

summary.core_problem: 移动端本地部署LLM时，使用ARM TrustZone做硬件隔离保护模型权重和用户数据，会同时拖累安全推理性能和正常应用性能，根源是两个问题：一是资源隔离不灵活——安全内存需大块连续物理空间、NPU无法在安全世界有效利用；二是安全资源管理低效——正常世界OS与安全世界互相不可见对方负载，无法协同调度内存，多LLM移动Agent场景下问题更突出。
summary.importance: 虽不直接涉及预训练流程，但为面向端侧优化的小模型预训练设计提供了落地侧约束参考，包括权重布局、KV缓存规模权衡、算力适配等方向的设计需兼顾隐私保护场景下的性能要求。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思路是将资源的访问权限与管理权限解耦：正常世界OS可管理安全资源但无法读取其内容。针对资源隔离不灵活问题，提出可召回资源隔离机制，基于ARM二级页表（S2PT）实现可召回安全内存（Flex-Mem）和可召回安全NPU（Flex-NPU），支持内存与NPU在保护/非保护模式间快速切换，无安全任务时按需关闭保护以消除虚拟化开销。针对资源管理低效问题，设计FlexServe框架，复用现有安全世界软件栈执行推理，与正常世界OS协同调度内存：正常世界监控内存压力在普通应用与安全推理间分配资源，安全侧执行LLM感知的缓存与内存回收。
summary.experiments: 给出两项基础观测数据：分配8GB连续安全内存耗时6.44秒，远长于典型LLM预填充时延，而普通mmap仅需0.56秒；仅用CPU的安全推理性能显著低于可调用NPU的方案。论文提及已实现原型系统，但提供的内容截断未给出完整性能对比结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读预计15-20分钟，重点关注引言部分的两个挑战分析（对应Figure 1/2）、可召回资源隔离的S2PT实现细节、协同内存调度逻辑，无需深挖底层ARM硬件细节。

summary_en.core_problem: When deploying LLMs on mobile devices, using ARM TrustZone for hardware isolation to protect model weights and user data degrades both secure inference performance and normal application performance, stemming from two bottlenecks: inflexible secure resource isolation (secure memory requires large contiguous physical regions and NPUs cannot be effectively used in the secure world), and inefficient secure resource management (normal-world OS and secure world have no visibility into each other's workloads, making coordinated memory scheduling impossible, especially in multi-LLM mobile agent scenarios).
summary_en.importance: Not directly related to pretraining pipelines, but provides deployment-side constraint references for edge-optimized small LLM pretraining design, including weight layout, KV cache size tradeoffs, and compute adaptation that need to balance performance under privacy protection requirements.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design decouples access permission from management permission: the normal-world OS can manage secure resources without reading their content. For inflexible isolation, it proposes a Recallable Resource Isolation mechanism built on ARM Stage-2 Page Tables (S2PT) to implement Recallable Secure Memory (Flex-Mem) and Recallable Secure NPU (Flex-NPU), supporting fast switching between protected and unprotected modes, with on-demand protection to eliminate virtualization overhead when no secure inference tasks are running. For inefficient management, it builds the FlexServe framework that reuses the existing secure-world software stack for inference, and implements cooperative memory scheduling: the normal-world OS monitors memory pressure to allocate resources between regular apps and secure inference, while the secure side performs LLM-aware caching and memory reclamation.
summary_en.experiments: Two baseline observations are reported: allocating 8GB of contiguous secure memory takes 6.44s (far longer than typical LLM prefill latency), compared to 0.56s for regular mmap; CPU-only secure inference delivers significantly lower performance than NPU-accelerated inference. Full experimental results of the FlexServe prototype are not included in the provided truncated content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim read in 15-20 minutes. Focus on the two challenge analyses in the introduction (Figures 1 and 2), S2PT implementation details of the recallable isolation mechanism, and cooperative memory scheduling logic; skip low-level ARM hardware details.

recommendation.zh: 端侧LLM安全推理的系统工作，重点看资源权限解耦的核心设计，可作为端侧预训练模型大小约束的参考
recommendation.en: System work on secure on-device LLM inference, focus on the permission decoupling design as a reference for size constraints of pretrained models targeting edge deployment

paper.title: Execution-State Capsules: Graph-Bound Execution-State Checkpoint and Restore for Low-Latency, Small-Batch, On-Device Physical-AI Serving
paper.abstract: Mainstream LLM serving systems reuse prefix work mainly through paged or radix key-value (KV) caches. This is highly effective for high-throughput, high-concurrency serving, but it manages only one positional fragment of execution state: the KV cache. We study the opposite regime: low-latency, small-batch, on-device physical-AI serving, where interactive LLM agents, speech systems, and robot policies repeatedly branch, reset, interrupt, and re-enter under tight responsiveness budgets. We introdu

summary.core_problem: 在单流/小 batch、端侧 GPU 的“物理 AI/交互式”低延迟推理场景里，主流 serving（vLLM PagedAttention、SGLang RadixAttention）围绕高并发吞吐与 KV 复用设计，其 CUDA Graph 捕获刻意不把 KV 绑定成可冻结的自包含状态，导致难以在中断、分支、回到旧会话等交互变化下快速恢复一个完整、可继续执行的推理状态。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统论文，不是预训练方法论文；对基座预训练的直接影响较弱。价值主要在工程接口层：如果你的研究需要在端侧/机器人/语音交互里做“频繁打断与回滚”的在线数据采集或闭环训练，执行状态的可 checkpoint/restore 会显著影响实验吞吐与可重复性。它也提醒一个常被忽略的点：KV cache 只是执行状态的一部分，面向交互控制的 serving 需要更显式的状态边界与生命周期管理。
summary.technical_approach:
论文提出两层系统：
1) FlashRT：一个 latency-first 的白盒 runtime，用来把 concurrency=1 的冷启动路径做得足够便宜（计入 graph replay 与状态准备成本，不含 tokenizer/网络）。
2) Execution-State Capsule：把“执行状态”做成图绑定（graph-bound）的自包含胶囊，用于 checkpoint 与 restore。动机是：vLLM/SGLang 的 CUDA Graph 通过可变 block-table 间接读取 KV，从而支持任意物理块复用；但这种间接性意味着“捕获的 graph + 绑定 buffer”不是一个可冻结快照，无法直接拿来做会话级恢复。
该工作转而面向相反目标：在小并发下，牺牲部分通用的块复用灵活性，换取可冻结、可搬运、可快速恢复的完整 continuation state，以支持新 turn、分支、interrupt、re-entry 等交互控制流。
summary.experiments: 你提供的全文片段仅覆盖引言与问题设定，没有性能表、端到端延迟分解、与 vLLM/SGLang 的对比数字、硬件型号、模型规模、以及 capsule 的内存开销等关键信息，因此无法给出具体实验结论与量化收益。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 15–25 分钟）：
- 先读 Introduction，把它的目标函数记清楚：只优化 concurrency=1 的 wall-clock latency，并且强调“可恢复的执行状态”而不只是 KV 复用。
- 重点看 §2（runtime 的执行路径、graph capture/replay 的边界）与 §3（capsule 的状态组成、绑定方式、restore 流程）。
- 看实验时优先找三类图表：① 端到端延迟分解（prefill/decoding/状态准备/graph replay）；② 中断/分支/回滚场景的恢复时间；③ capsule 的显存占用与可并发会话数上限。

summary_en.core_problem: For extreme low-latency, small-batch (often single-stream) on-device serving in interactive/physical-AI loops, mainstream KV-cache systems (vLLM PagedAttention, SGLang RadixAttention) are optimized for high-concurrency throughput and capture CUDA Graphs without binding KV as a self-contained snapshot. That design hinders fast checkpoint/restore of a complete continuation state under interrupts, branching, and session re-entry.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference/serving systems contribution rather than pretraining. The practical relevance to foundation-model research shows up when experiments depend on tight interactive loops (robotics, voice, coding assistants) where frequent interruption/rollback affects data collection and iteration speed. The paper also clarifies an architectural point: a positional KV cache is only part of the execution state; interactive control requires explicit state boundaries and lifecycle management.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The system has two layers:
1) FlashRT: a latency-first, white-box runtime targeting minimum wall-clock latency at concurrency=1 (including graph replay and state-prep costs, excluding tokenizer/network).
2) Execution-State Capsules: graph-bound, self-contained execution-state snapshots that can be checkpointed and restored. Motivation: vLLM/SGLang rely on indirection (mutable block tables) so one captured graph can gather from arbitrary physical KV blocks—great for reuse, but the captured graph + bound buffers is not a freezable snapshot. Capsules instead bind the necessary buffers/state to make continuation state portable and quickly restorable, trading some generality for predictable low-latency reuse across new turns, branches, interrupts, and re-entry.
summary_en.experiments: The provided excerpt does not include evaluation results (latency numbers, breakdowns, hardware, model sizes, memory overhead), so quantitative comparisons and ablations cannot be stated without guessing.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (15–25 minutes):
- Read the Introduction to lock in the objective: lowest observed latency at concurrency=1, and explicit support for session branching/interrupt/re-entry.
- Focus on §2 (runtime execution path and CUDA Graph capture/replay boundaries) and §3 (what exactly is inside a capsule, how buffers are bound, restore procedure).
- In experiments, look for: (1) end-to-end latency breakdown, (2) restore time under interrupt/branch scenarios, and (3) VRAM overhead vs number of resumable sessions.

recommendation.zh: 跳出了纯文本 LLM 的 KV Cache 管理范式，针对端侧多模态/物理 AI 提出了全量状态（包含 RNN/CNN 状态）的快照机制，做端侧部署和多模态 Serving 的同学必看。
recommendation.en: Steps outside the pure-text LLM KV cache management paradigm, proposing a full-state (including RNN/CNN states) snapshot mechanism for on-device multimodal/physical AI; a must-read for those working on on-device deployment and multimodal serving.

paper.title: UltraQuant: 4-bit KV Caching for Context-Heavy Agents
paper.abstract: Context-heavy agents place unusual pressure on the key-value (KV) cache: long prefixes are reused across many short turns, while concurrency determines whether the serving system can keep GPUs utilized. We study 4-bit KV-cache compression for this setting, using TurboQuant-style rotation and codebook quantization as a quality anchor and vLLM FP8 KV caching as the deployment anchor. We report three contributions. First, we frame 4-bit KV caching around multi-round agent workloads where task quali

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注长上下文 agent serving 中的 KV cache 压力：多轮会话会反复复用长前缀，高并发又要求尽量把更多前缀常驻在 GPU HBM 中。核心问题不是单纯把 KV 压到 4 bit，而是在质量、cache residency、TTFT/TPOT 三者之间找到可部署的折中。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对长上下文模型的系统可用性有参考价值。它说明 4-bit KV cache 的瓶颈不只在量化误差，还在 decode attention kernel、paged serving、cache eviction 以及多轮 agent workload 的真实延迟结构。对做长上下文预训练或 agent-oriented pretrain 的团队，价值在于帮助判断长上下文能力落地时的 memory budget，而不是改变训练目标本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分成两个端点。Ultra-TQ 保留 TurboQuant 的 4-bit key/value 表示，用 Walsh–Hadamard rotation 分散 outlier energy，让 KV 维度更接近轻尾分布，再用 16-entry codebook 做标量量化。论文进一步做了 model-specific centroid calibration：原始 TurboQuant 的 Lloyd–Max centroids 假设旋转后的坐标服从随机单位向量坐标的理论分布，但真实激活有偏差，因此只对高 MSE 的约 10% 层用少量捕获激活重拟合 centroids。UltraQuant 则把 codebook lookup 换成 FP4 micro-tensor approximation，让反量化更容易折入 AMD CDNA4 的 scaled-MFMA 指令路径，减少软件查表带来的 kernel 开销。论文强调 K/V 非对称处理、rotation、layout、lookup、MFMA scheduling 等工程选择，而不是只报告压缩率。
summary.experiments: 主要实验围绕 vLLM 多轮 benchmark，使用 ShareGPT 会话，模拟 32 个并发 chat sessions，并报告 P50 TTFT 与 P50 TPOT。结果显示，在长前缀和高并发下，FP8 KV cache 会因为 resident cache 容量不足而频繁驱逐有用前缀；UltraQuant 能保留更多上下文，后期轮次 TTFT 相比 FP8 提升 3.47×。量化消融中，model-specific centroids 将 key 的 per-element quantization MSE 从 1.32e-4 降到 1.18e-4，下降 10.3%，GPQA 提升 1.20 个百分点。未旋转分布即使重拟合 centroids，MSE 仍约为旋转后的 2.3×，说明 rotation 对误差控制比 codebook 微调更关键。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 agent workload 的问题定义、Agentic Workflow and Concurrency Analysis 中的 TTFT/TPOT 评测设置和 Fig. 1/Table 1、Ultra-TurboQuant 中关于 rotation 与 centroid calibration 的消融。若关注 serving kernel，可再看 appendix 的实现细节。若只关心预训练，不必深读 FP4/MFMA 的底层优化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies KV-cache compression for long-context, multi-turn agent serving. The key issue is not just reaching 4-bit storage, but preserving task quality while keeping long prefixes resident on GPU memory and avoiding latency regressions from quantization overhead.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but practical. Long-context pretraining only becomes useful if the serving stack can keep reusable prefixes in memory under concurrency. The paper gives a deployment-oriented view of the tradeoff among KV precision, cache residency, TTFT, and TPOT, which is useful for teams designing context-heavy agents or long-context model releases.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper studies two implementations. Ultra-TQ keeps the TurboQuant-style representation: Walsh–Hadamard rotation spreads outlier energy across channels, after which 4-bit scalar codebook quantization becomes more accurate. It then calibrates the Lloyd–Max centroids on real model activations because the theoretical random-unit-vector assumption is only approximate. In practice, the authors recalibrate only the roughly 10% of layers with higher MSE. UltraQuant replaces codebook lookup with an FP4 micro-tensor approximation so dequantization can be folded into native AMD CDNA4 scaled-MFMA execution. The engineering focus is on asymmetric K/V handling, layout, lookup, and decode-attention scheduling rather than compression ratio alone.
summary_en.experiments: The main serving evaluation uses vLLM’s multi-turn benchmark with ShareGPT conversations and 32 concurrent chat sessions, reporting P50 TTFT and P50 TPOT. Under long-prefix pressure, FP8 caching evicts useful state, while UltraQuant keeps more prefixes resident; in later rounds TTFT improves by 3.47× versus FP8. For the quantization ablation, calibrated centroids reduce key per-element MSE from 1.32e-4 to 1.18e-4, a 10.3% reduction, and improve GPQA by 1.20 percentage points. Fitting centroids without rotation still leaves about 2.3× higher MSE, showing that rotation is the dominant accuracy lever.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough, roughly 20–30 minutes. Read the workload framing in the introduction, the concurrency and latency analysis around Table 1 and Fig. 1, and the Ultra-TQ ablation on rotation and centroid calibration. Kernel specialists may want the appendix. Readers focused only on pretraining can skip most of the FP4/MFMA implementation detail.

recommendation.zh: 多轮Agent场景4-bit KV量化的工程落地，读§3设计选择和§5 CDNA4 kernel优化即可
recommendation.en: Practical 4-bit KV cache for multi-turn agent workloads; focus on §3 design choices and §5 CDNA4 kernel optimizations.

paper.title: Closing the Calibration Gap in Semantic Caching
paper.abstract: Semantic caching cuts LLM inference costs by serving a cached response to semantically similar queries. Standard practice evaluates these systems using PR-AUC, a metric that only measures how well scores rank and ignores whether they are usable at a fixed threshold. We show this mismatch leads to systematically poor deployment choices, as models with the highest PR-AUC are often the worst in operation. We introduce Precision-Cache Hit Ratio (P-CHR) AUC, a cache-aware metric that measures precisi

summary.core_problem: 现有语义缓存系统采用PR-AUC作为评测指标，仅关注排序能力，无法反映固定阈值下的实际部署效果，导致部署选型出现系统性偏差
summary.importance: 指标/方法创新，提出适配语义缓存部署场景的新评测指标，分解了离线与部署效果差距的来源，为缓存系统优化提供了量化依据
summary.technical_approach: 提出P-CHR AUC衡量不同缓存利用率下的精度，CRR衡量离线排序质量的部署留存率；将离线与部署的效果差距分解为可恢复的校准误差与不可恢复的数据集结构误差
summary.experiments: 实验验证校准gap主要由训练目标而非数据规模决定，事后校准仅能部分消除差距；摘要截断，未完整披露具体模型与量化提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Existing semantic caching systems use PR-AUC as the evaluation metric, which only measures ranking ability and fails to reflect real deployment performance at fixed thresholds, leading to systematic deployment selection biases
summary_en.importance: Metric/method innovation that proposes deployment-aligned evaluation metrics for semantic caching, decomposes the source of offline-to-deployment performance gaps, and provides quantitative guidance for cache system optimization
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes P-CHR AUC to measure precision across cache utilization levels, and CRR to measure the retention of offline ranking quality in deployment; decomposes the offline-deployment performance gap into recoverable calibration error and irreducible dataset structural error
summary_en.experiments: Experiments verify that the calibration gap is mainly determined by training objectives rather than data scale, and post-hoc calibration only partially closes the gap; abstract is truncated, with no full model details or quantitative improvement disclosed

recommendation.zh: 语义缓存评测指标的修正工作，仅对负责LLM serving的团队有参考价值，预训练研究员无需深入阅读
recommendation.en: Metric correction work for semantic caching evaluation; only relevant for LLM serving teams, no value for pretraining researchers

paper.title: Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference
paper.abstract: LLM serving exhibits extreme length variability, making size-based scheduling difficult in practice. Recent LLM schedulers approximate SJF/SRPT using predicted decode lengths or ranks and primarily report mean-centric metrics such as TTFT and TBT. We show that these prediction-driven policies can be fragile under distribution shifts, bursty arrivals, and GPU memory pressure, while offering limited control over the tail latency (P90-P99) that dominates user experience, even with perfect decode-le

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 LLM 在线推理调度中的尾延迟问题。现有系统常用输出长度预测来近似 SJF 或 SRPT，以降低平均响应时间。但 reasoning workload 的 decode 长度高度不稳定，分布会随时间和请求类型变化，预测驱动策略在 bursty arrival、分布漂移和 GPU KV cache 压力下容易失效，也很难直接控制 P90 到 P99 的 TTLT。
summary.importance: 它和基座预训练的关系偏系统侧，但对研究有现实意义：reasoning model 的生成长度、KV cache 占用和用户可见延迟正在成为模型训练目标之外的约束。若 posttrain 鼓励更长链路推理，serving 层就需要更稳健的调度策略。该工作强调不要只围绕平均 TTFT/TBT 优化，也不要假设 decode length 可可靠预测；这对设计推理模型的训练预算、长度控制和部署评测都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法用 distribution-aware boosting 替代显式长度预测。它以 FCFS 为基线，对请求计算连续的 soft boost，再按 arrival time minus boost 排序。boost 来自轻量可观测信号，例如已解码 token 数、历史请求延迟分布等，而不是预测最终 decode 长度或剩余长度。这样的策略避免了硬性的短作业优先排序，在部分可观测和分布漂移下更稳。LLM serving 的特殊难点是 KV cache 让调度和内存强耦合：抢占、换出和重算会影响 TTLT。为此，方法把 boost-based scheduling 和 cache-aware preemption / eviction 联合设计，避免为了降低排队时间而造成 KV cache thrashing。
summary.experiments: 可见内容报告了多种异构 workload 下的实验，包括 decode 长度长尾、bursty arrivals、predictor 质量下降和分布漂移场景。指标关注 tail TTLT、吞吐 tokens/s，以及 TTFT/TBT 等交互延迟。结果主张是：相比 prediction-heavy 的 SRPT 近似，distribution-aware 且 eviction-conscious 的调度在 P90/P99 TTLT 和吞吐上更稳定，尤其在预测器退化或 workload 变化时优势更明显。当前提供内容未包含完整结果表，因此不宜补充具体提升百分比。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Background，重点理解为什么“完美长度预测也不等于尾延迟可控”。再看 boost policy 的定义，以及它如何从经典 tail-optimal scheduling 改造成适合 LLM serving 的在线策略。系统部分重点看 KV cache eviction 与 preemption 的联合设计。实验部分优先看 P90/P99 TTLT、throughput、predictor degradation、distribution shift 的图表。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Cornell University、Microsoft Azure System Research、NVIDIA。可见内容只显示 Yueying Li 为通讯作者，完整作者列表无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: This work targets tail latency in online LLM inference. Existing schedulers often predict output length or remaining decode length and approximate SJF or SRPT, which is effective for mean latency when size estimates are accurate. In reasoning-heavy workloads, decode length is highly variable, workload distributions shift, and bursty arrivals are common. Under these conditions, prediction-driven scheduling can be fragile and may still provide poor control over P90 to P99 TTLT.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly on the serving side, but it matters for model research because reasoning-oriented posttraining changes the length and memory profile of inference. Longer adaptive generation increases KV-cache pressure and makes average-centric metrics less informative. The work argues for deployment-aware evaluation of reasoning models: output-length behavior, tail latency, and cache dynamics should be treated as part of the practical cost of a model, not just as an implementation detail.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed scheduler replaces explicit decode-length prediction with distribution-aware soft priority boosting. It starts from FCFS and assigns each request a smooth boost computed from lightweight observable signals, such as decoded-token progress and historical latency statistics. Requests are then ordered by arrival time minus boost, rather than by predicted final length or remaining length. This avoids hard size-based ranking and is intended to be more robust under partial observability and distribution shift. The system also co-designs scheduling with cache-aware preemption and eviction, since LLM decoding is stateful and memory-coupled. A priority decision that ignores KV-cache capacity can reduce queueing delay but increase TTLT through recomputation and cache thrashing.
summary_en.experiments: The visible content reports experiments across heterogeneous workloads with long-tailed decode lengths, bursty arrivals, degraded predictors, and distribution shifts. The evaluation emphasizes tail TTLT, throughput in tokens per second, and interactive latency metrics such as TTFT and TBT. The reported conclusion is that distribution-aware boosting combined with eviction-aware execution improves tail TTLT and throughput more consistently than prediction-heavy SRPT-style baselines, especially when predictor quality drops or workload distributions change. The supplied text does not include the full result tables, so exact percentage gains are not recoverable here.
summary_en.reading_guide: A productive skim takes about 20 to 30 minutes. Read the Introduction and Background first to understand why accurate length prediction alone does not solve tail latency. Then focus on the boost-based scheduling rule and how it differs from SJF/SRPT-style ranking. The most important systems detail is the coupling between prioritization, KV-cache eviction, and preemption. In the evaluation, prioritize the plots for P90/P99 TTLT, throughput, predictor degradation, and distribution shift.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations shown in the supplied text include Cornell University, Microsoft Azure System Research, and NVIDIA. Yueying Li is listed as the correspondence contact; the complete author list is not available from the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 推理调度方向的扎实工作，尾延迟优化思路对 pretrain 研究员理解 serving 约束反哺训练配置有参考，重点看 §3 优先级设计与 §5 尾延迟分解。
recommendation.en: Solid inference-scheduling work; tail-latency insights inform how serving constraints should feed back into pretraining configs; focus on §3 priority design and §5 tail breakdown.

paper.title: Towards Distributed Inference of LLMs on a P2P Network
paper.abstract: Prefix caching can reduce LLM inference latency by reusing KV caches across requests with shared prompts, but cluster-scale reuse is challenging because caches are partitioned across nodes. We propose a decentralized, prefix-cache-aware routing scheme for peer-to-peer LLM serving. Each node maintains a local radix tree of its own cached prefixes and asynchronously refreshed estimates of peer caches using periodic anti-entropy. Requests are routed to the node with the longest estimated prefix mat

summary.core_problem: 在没有中心化协调和 KV-cache 迁移的 P2P LLM serving 网络中，利用前缀缓存复用降低推理延迟。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统设计。它关注 prefix cache 在多节点、弱一致性、去中心化环境中的路由问题，对 serving 侧的缓存命中率、热点和网络延迟分析有参考价值，但对预训练方法论影响间接。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 prefix-cache-aware decentralized routing。每个节点维护本地 cached prefix 的 radix tree，并通过周期性 anti-entropy 异步刷新对 peer cache 的估计；请求被路由到估计最长前缀匹配的节点。元数据过期只会导致 cache miss，不会改变模型输出，因此系统不需要强一致性。
summary.experiments: 在模拟的 MMLU workload 上评估。结果显示，在网络通信延迟低、prompt 前缀分布偏斜时，去中心化路由能降低延迟；当网络延迟较高或 prefix affinity 造成热点时，收益受限。摘要未给出真实集群规模、模型参数量或绝对延迟数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to exploit prefix-cache reuse for LLM inference on a peer-to-peer network without centralized coordination or KV-cache transfer.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems contribution. It is useful for understanding cache-aware routing, weak consistency, hotspots, and network-latency limits in serving, but its relevance to pretraining methodology is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system uses decentralized prefix-cache-aware routing. Each node keeps a local radix tree of cached prefixes and asynchronously refreshes estimates of peer caches through periodic anti-entropy. Requests are routed to the peer with the longest estimated prefix match. Stale metadata can cause a missed cache hit but cannot affect output correctness, so weak consistency is sufficient.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses simulated MMLU workloads. Decentralized routing improves latency when communication delay is low and prefix distributions are skewed, while high network latency and affinity-induced hotspots limit the benefit. The abstract does not report real-cluster scale, model sizes, or absolute latency numbers.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练影响间接，但 prefix-cache 路由的负结果边界有用；看模拟假设和热点分析即可。
recommendation.en: The pretraining impact is indirect, but the boundary conditions for prefix-cache routing are useful; read the simulation assumptions and hotspot analysis.

paper.title: Service-Induced Congestion in Memory-Constrained LLM Serving
paper.abstract: In large language model (LLM) serving, each request accumulates persistent graphics processing unit (GPU) memory during service as its key-value cache grows with every generated token.
