paper.title: Threshold-Based Exclusive Batching for LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Mixed batching (MB)--interleaving prefill and decode in a single batch--has become the standard scheduling strategy for large language model (LLM) inference due to its efficiency in maximizing compute and memory utilization. However, through controlled experiments, we find that prefill-decode interference inflates MB's per-step marginal cost above that of pure decode. On the high-bandwidth H200 (4.8 TB/s), this occurs only when decode tokens exceed 80% of the batch; however, on the bandwidth-con

summary.core_problem: LLM 推理调度中混合批处理（MB）将 prefill 和 decode 交错在同一批内，被 vLLM、SGLang 等主流引擎作为默认策略。但预训练研究者注意到，在带宽受限 GPU 上 prefill-decode 干扰会显著提高边际成本，使得独占批处理（EB）反而更优。论文系统研究了 GPU 内存带宽如何决定 EB 与 MB 的最优选择。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 推理服务调度有直接工程价值。揭示了一个常被忽视的硬件依赖性：MB 的普适优势并不成立，带宽受限 GPU 上 EB 可显著更优。这解释了为什么中国大规模生产系统中 EB 仍被广泛使用（受出口限制影响的 GPU 带宽较低）。
summary.technical_approach: 将单步迭代时间建模为 T_iter = α + β·n_tok，其中 β（边际成本）依赖于硬件和 batch 中 decode token 的比例 r。在两个对比 GPU 上的受控实验发现交叉点（MB 边际成本超过纯 decode 的点）在 RTX PRO 6000（1.792 TB/s）上约 r≈20%，在 H200（4.8 TB/s）上约 r≈80%。论文推导了 EB-MB 性能交叉的闭合条件，给出最优相位切换阈值 θ*的解析表达式，并开发了自适应调度器 EB(k̂*) 和混合调度器 EB+。
summary.experiments: 在带宽跨度 0.9-8.0 TB/s 的 4 个 NVIDIA GPU 上验证：EB(k̂*) 在带宽受限 GPU 上实现最高 41.9% 的吞吐量提升；在高带宽硬件和大模型上 vLLM v1（MB）仍保持优势；EB+ 在各流量模式下实现最高的 TTFT/TPOT 综合 goodput。核 profiling 显示 GEMM 时间对 r 基本不变，而 Attention 时间随 r 增长，是跨 GPU 差异的主要来源。
summary.reading_guide: 推荐重点阅读第 1 节的实验诊断（图 1 和图 2），清晰展示了带宽如何影响交叉点；第 3 节的闭合形式条件推导；第 4 节的自适应调度器设计。预估阅读时间 40-50 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者信息未在提供的片段中完整给出，研究团队来自学术界，关注 LLM 推理调度与系统优化。

summary_en.core_problem: Mixed batching (MB)—interleaving prefill and decode in the same batch—has become the default scheduler in vLLM and SGLang. However, on bandwidth-constrained GPUs, prefill-decode interference significantly inflates marginal cost, making exclusive batching (EB) more efficient. This work systematically investigates how GPU memory bandwidth determines the optimal choice between EB and MB.
summary_en.importance: Direct engineering value for LLM serving scheduling. Reveals a commonly overlooked hardware dependence: MB does not universally dominate; EB can be substantially better on bandwidth-limited GPUs. This explains why EB remains widely used in large-scale production systems in China (where GPUs operate under tighter bandwidth budgets due to export restrictions).
summary_en.technical_approach: Models per-step iteration time as T_iter = α + β·n_tok, where β (marginal cost) depends on hardware and decode ratio r in the batch. Controlled experiments on two contrasting GPUs find the crossover point (where MB marginal cost exceeds pure-decode cost) at r≈20% on RTX PRO 6000 (1.792 TB/s) vs r≈80% on H200 (4.8 TB/s). The paper derives a closed-form condition for the EB-MB crossover, gives an analytical expression for the optimal phase-switching threshold θ*, and develops adaptive scheduler EB(k̂*) and hybrid scheduler EB+.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 4 NVIDIA GPUs spanning 0.9-8.0 TB/s bandwidth: EB(k̂*) achieves up to 41.9% throughput gains on bandwidth-constrained GPUs; vLLM v1 (MB) retains advantage on high-bandwidth hardware with larger models; EB+ delivers the best joint TTFT/TPOT goodput across traffic regimes. Kernel profiling shows GEMM time is largely invariant to r while Attention time grows with r, accounting for the cross-GPU gap.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1's experimental diagnostics (Figures 1 and 2) that cleanly demonstrate bandwidth-dependent crossover; Section 3's closed-form condition derivation; Section 4's adaptive scheduler design. Estimated reading time: 40-50 min.
summary_en.authors_note: Author affiliations not fully specified in the provided excerpts; the team is from academic institutions focusing on LLM inference scheduling and systems optimization.

recommendation.zh: 读模型和阈值推导；它把 serving 策略和显存带宽绑定，能直接检查现有调度器的默认 MB 假设。
recommendation.en: Read the model and threshold derivation; it ties serving policy to memory bandwidth and directly tests the default mixed-batching assumption.

paper.title: Lodestar: An Online-Learning LLM Inference Router
paper.abstract: Efficiently serving large language model (LLM) inference tasks is crucial both for user-perceived latency such as time-to-first-token (TTFT) and for GPU utilization. However, LLM request routing, that is, assigning each inference request to a GPU instance, is particularly challenging: execution is highly input-dependent; batching and KV-cache reuse create strong cross-request coupling; and latency responds nonlinearly to context length, model/engine settings, and heterogeneous accelerators. As a

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 LLM 推理集群里的请求路由问题：面对输入长度、输出长度、KV cache 命中、异构 GPU、batching 和队列状态共同作用的复杂系统，传统负载均衡和手工启发式很难稳定选出低延迟路由。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对大模型研究基础设施有现实启发：推理系统的性能面并不适合用静态 cost model 近似，在线学习式控制器可能比规则系统更能适应模型、引擎和工作负载的快速变化。对做 serving-aware pretrain/post-train 联动的人，这类工作有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Lodestar 的核心是一个在线学习的 reward predictor。系统持续收集每个时刻的 cluster state、请求特征和路由后的真实回报，用神经网络预测“把当前请求发到某个实例后会得到什么延迟收益”，再按预测 reward 选路。论文把主要 reward 设为负的 TTFT。难点有两个：一是延迟由多层因素共同决定，包括引擎版本、模型、硬件、cache、并发和网络状态，因此预测器必须在线更新；二是路由策略本身会改变未来状态分布，形成 policy–data feedback loop。Lodestar 的设计重点就是在真实线上环境中持续采样、持续训练，并把状态收集和推理开销控制在请求关键路径可接受的范围内。
summary.experiments: 从引言可见，实验主要比较 Lodestar 与 round-robin、JSQ 以及考虑 prefix/cache locality 的 LLM 专用启发式路由。核心指标是 TTFT，也可能包含吞吐和 GPU 利用率。论文想证明的不是离线预测精度本身，而是在线适应后在真实动态集群里能持续取得更低延迟。当前给出的全文片段没有完整数值，因此更适合把握实验结构：看不同工作负载、不同引擎、异构硬件和状态漂移条件下，Lodestar 是否仍优于启发式，以及在线学习收敛速度和额外开销有多大。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看问题设定、系统架构图和关于 feedback loop 的讨论，再看实验主表。重点不是模型细节，而是特征设计、在线更新机制、探索与利用如何平衡，以及 critical path overhead 是否足够低。若只想判断是否值得深入，30–40 分钟足够。若你主要做 pretrain，可以把它当作 serving 侧的系统方法参考，而不是核心必读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles LLM inference routing in distributed GPU clusters, where request latency depends on a complicated interaction among prompt length, generation length, batching, KV-cache reuse, queue state, engine behavior, and hardware heterogeneity. Under these conditions, standard load balancing and hand-written heuristics are often too crude.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining contribution, but it matters as infrastructure work around large models. The main lesson is that the serving surface for LLMs is too nonlinear and too state-dependent for static routing rules to remain robust. For researchers interested in the interface between model design, deployment, and system-aware training, the paper is a useful reference point.
summary_en.technical_approach: Lodestar is built around an online-learned reward predictor. At routing time, it gathers request features and a snapshot of cluster state, then predicts the reward for assigning the request to each candidate instance, using negative TTFT as the main objective in the paper. The router chooses the destination with the best predicted reward. Two challenges drive the design. First, latency depends on many layers at once: serving engine and configuration, model architecture, hardware type, cache locality, concurrency, and network conditions. This makes online adaptation necessary. Second, the routing policy changes the future state distribution and therefore the latency profile itself, creating a policy–data feedback loop. The system is designed to keep collecting fresh observations during deployment and update the predictor continuously while keeping routing overhead low enough for production use.
summary_en.experiments: From the available text, the experimental comparison is against generic baselines such as round robin and JSQ, as well as LLM-specific heuristics that account for prefix sharing or cache locality. The main metric is TTFT, likely accompanied by throughput and utilization measurements. The important question is not just offline prediction quality, but whether online learning improves end-to-end latency under changing workloads, engines, and heterogeneous accelerators. The excerpt here does not include the full numerical tables, so the right reading strategy is to inspect how the gains hold across workload mixes, hardware diversity, and non-stationary cluster conditions, and how much overhead the online learner adds.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should focus on the problem setup, the system diagram, and the discussion of the feedback loop between routing and observed latency. Then jump to the main experimental tables. The most relevant details are the feature representation, online update mechanism, exploration strategy if any, and critical-path overhead. If your main interest is pretraining, this is best read as a serving systems paper with indirect relevance rather than a core paper. About 30–40 minutes should be enough for a useful pass.

recommendation.zh: 只看 routing state 特征和 reward 设计；它不改预训练，但能校准长上下文与 KV 复用的真实 serving 约束。
recommendation.en: Skim the routing-state features and reward design; it will not change pretraining, but it calibrates real serving constraints around long context and KV reuse.

paper.title: Observation, Not Prediction: Conversation-Level Disaggregated Scheduling for Agentic Serving
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents resolve a user task through many turns of dependent inference and tool calls, producing a workload whose total cost is unknown when the task arrives. Existing multi-turn systems keep the turn as the scheduling unit and decide, turn by turn, whether to disaggregate prefill from decode. That decision rests on the turn's decode length, tool behavior, and KV growth, quantities that are not observable when the scheduler must act, forcing the system to predict them. We show this depen

summary.core_problem: Agent 类多轮 LLM 推理中，传统调度以「轮次（turn）」为单位，需要预测每个轮次的 decode 长度、工具调用行为、KV 缓存增长等不可观测量，导致调度决策本质脆弱。作者论证这种对预测的依赖是调度单位选择带来的人为限制，而非工作负载本身固有。
summary.importance: 提出 TTFET（time-to-first-effective-token）作为用户真正关心的服务指标，并将调度单位从 turn 提升到 conversation，把多轮不规则性转化为稳定的两阶段结构，从根本上消除了对预测的依赖。这是 agentic serving 系统设计思路的一个有意义转变，相关思路可能影响未来多轮 LLM 服务框架。
summary.technical_approach: ConServe 调度器将整个 conversation 视为一个调度单位，呈现两个稳定阶段：① 计算密集型的首轮 prefill（建立任务状态），② 内存密集型的长尾（首次 decode 及所有后续 append-prefill/decode 轮次）。仅在两阶段边界进行一次 KV 缓存传输，避免跨轮次重复搬运；分配决策完全基于可观测数量（输入 token 数、decoder KV 缓存利用率）；超额配置 decode replicas 吸收对话长度波动。
summary.experiments: 第三节通过实验刻画 prefill/decode 可预测性差距，量化 turn-level 预测的固有脆弱性。完整评估包括在异构集群环境下对比现有 turn-level 调度策略。
summary.reading_guide: skim。重点阅读 Intro（核心论证清晰有力）、Section 3（预测量化分析）、ConServe 设计章节。跳过调度器实现和集群模拟细节。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-turn agentic LLM serving, conventional schedulers take the turn as the atomic unit and must predict unobservable quantities per turn (decode length, tool call behavior, KV cache growth) to make placement decisions. The paper argues this dependence on prediction is an artifact of the scheduling unit choice, not an inherent property of the workload.
summary_en.importance: Proposes TTFET (time-to-first-effective-token) as the user-relevant metric for agentic serving, and elevates the scheduling unit from turn to conversation, collapsing turn-level irregularity into a stable two-phase structure and fundamentally eliminating the need for prediction. A meaningful design-shift for agentic serving systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: ConServe treats the entire conversation as the scheduling unit, exposing two stable phases: (1) a compute-bound first-turn prefill that materializes task state, and (2) a memory-bound tail comprising the first decode and all subsequent append-prefill/decode turns. KV cache is transferred exactly once at the phase boundary, avoiding repeated cross-turn movement. Placement decisions use only observable quantities (input token count, decoder KV-cache utilization). Over-provisioned decode replicas absorb variation in conversation length.
summary_en.experiments: Section 3 empirically characterizes the prefill/decode predictability gap, quantifying the inherent brittleness of turn-level prediction. Full evaluation compares against turn-level scheduling baselines in heterogeneous cluster environments.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Introduction (well-argued core thesis), Section 3 (predictability gap analysis), and ConServe design section. Skip low-level scheduler implementation and cluster simulation details. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将Agent Serving的调度粒度从turn提升到conversation，利用Agent对话'首轮重prefill+后续长尾decode'的特性，避免了复杂的长度预测，对设计Agent专属推理引擎很有启发。
recommendation.en: Elevating the scheduling granularity of Agent Serving from turn to conversation leverages the 'heavy initial prefill + long-tail decode' characteristic of Agent dialogues, avoiding complex length predictions. Highly inspiring for designing Agent-specific inference engines.

paper.title: Speculative Pipeline Decoding: Higher-Accruacy and Zero-Bubble Speculation via Pipeline Parallelism
paper.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) accelerates low-concurrency LLM inference by employing a draft-then-verify paradigm. However, mainstream methods typically rely on multi-token prediction, which introduces escalating prediction difficulty and serial drafting latency. To address these, we propose Speculative Pipeline Decoding (SPD), a groundbreaking framework that unlocks the true potential of pipeline parallelism. By partitioning the target LLM into $n$ pipeline stages, SPD allows LLM to process $n$ tok

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是单序列低并发场景下 speculative decoding 的两个结构性瓶颈。第一，主流方法依赖 multi-token drafting，越往后预测越依赖草稿模型自己生成的浅层、未验证状态，误差会沿 draft length 累积，接受率快速下降。第二，draft 与 verify 往往仍有串行依赖，目标模型会等待草稿，或者草稿模块本身要串行生成多个 token，导致加速被 drafting latency 吃掉。作者想解决的不是再把 draft 头做得更强，而是换一个执行范式：把 target LLM 改成 pipeline 形式，让不同 token 同时处在不同深度，再只预测“下一个需要填进流水线的 token”，从而避免传统 speculative decoding 中 draft length 带来的长程衰减和等待开销。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练，而在推理执行范式。它给出的启发是：speculation 不一定要围绕“多预测几个未来 token”来设计，也可以围绕“如何持续喂满 target model 的执行流水线”来设计。这个视角把 speculative decoding 从 token-level lookahead 改成 pipeline occupancy optimization。对 serving 和系统研究更有价值，对训练侧的启发相对有限，但如果未来训练时就考虑中间层可预测性、分层特征可聚合性，可能会反过来影响模型结构和中间表示设计。论文的贡献量级属于中等偏上：提出了一个清楚的新框架，也给了比 EAGLE-3 更好的理论速度指标，但目前主要还是 inference-side 方法，且收益依赖 pipeline 切分和实现条件。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心有两部分。第一部分是把目标模型切成 n 个 pipeline stages。这样在任一 cycle 内，模型不是让一个 token 走完整个网络，而是让 n 个 token 分别位于不同深度并行推进。为了避免 bubble，每个 cycle 都需要有一个新 token 被送入第一阶段。SPD 的 speculation module 就负责预测这个 token。

第二部分是 speculation module 的设计。作者没有像 PPSD 那样只用第一阶段的浅层 hidden state 做 early exit，而是做 multi-depth feature aggregation：收集当前流水线中各 token 在不同 stage 的部分特征，以及已经验证 token 的完整特征，再把这些信息聚合后预测下一个 token。这样做的关键原因是，预测时不再只依赖某个很浅的局部表示，而是利用了“多 token、多深度”的上下文切片。论文强调一个重要性质：由于流水线长度固定为 n，预测所依赖的不完整特征的缺失程度被上界在常数 n 内，不会像传统 multi-token drafting 那样随着 draft length 增长而无界恶化。

另一个关键设计是 zero mutual waiting。常规 speculative decoding 中，草稿往往要等 target model 产出某些状态后才能继续。SPD 把 speculation module 的执行窗口前移，只基于当前 cycle 的 pipeline 输入状态来预测下一 token，而不是等本 cycle 输出出来后再预测。这样 speculation 和 target pipeline step 可以严格并行。代价是预测时可用信息更早、更少，理论上更难；作者用更强的 multi-depth aggregation 来补偿，并指出因为该模块延迟被 target step 完全掩蔽，所以可以把 speculation network 做得更深而不增加端到端时延。

论文还提出了 Equivalent Acceptance Length 这一指标，用来替代传统 acceptance length。原因是 pipeline speculative decoding 里存在初始化和 flush penalty，简单统计接受 token 数会高估真实收益。这个指标把 rejection 后流水线清空、重新填充的代价算进去，更接近理论吞吐提升。
summary.experiments:
实验基于 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Qwen3.5-9B，评测覆盖 MT-Bench、GSM8K、HumanEval。摘要和引言里给出的主结论是：SPD 在 equivalent acceptance length 上与主流方法相当或更高，并且在大多数设置下理论 speedup 超过 EAGLE-3。全文可见作者重点不是宣称绝对 wall-clock 全面领先，而是先证明这种 pipeline speculation 在接受长度和理论吞吐上成立。

从实验设计看，值得注意的点有几个。第一，作者专门把 SPD 与 PPSD 对比，说明只看第一阶段浅层特征会明显损伤接受率，且 stage 数增加后更难扩展；这支撑了 multi-depth aggregation 的必要性。第二，作者把 zero-bubble 并行执行作为核心卖点，因此消融里应重点看 speculation module 是否真的被完全 latency hidden，以及不同模块深度对端到端速度的影响。第三，Equivalent Acceptance Length 这个指标本身也是实验的一部分，因为它解释了为什么某些方法表面 acceptance 高，但真实 pipeline speedup 并不高。

从已给出的数字看，论文没有在你提供的片段里列出完整表格数值，但明确声称 SPD 在多数设置下超过 EAGLE-3 的理论加速，并保持可比的等效接受长度。若精读全文，建议重点核对：不同 pipeline stage 数 n 下的收益曲线、rejection flush 带来的损失、4B 与 9B 模型上趋势是否一致、以及 wall-clock 与理论 speedup 的偏差有多大。这些决定方法是否只是分析上成立，还是工程上也稳。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐行推公式。先看 Introduction，把作者批评现有 speculative decoding 的两点抓住：long-range decay 和 mutual waiting。然后直接看方法图，理解“不是一次猜多个 token，而是每个 cycle 猜一个 token 去填流水线”。如果这个执行图看懂了，后面的设计就顺了。

接着重点看三处。第一，multi-depth feature aggregation 的输入到底包含哪些 token、哪些 stage 的特征，聚合方式是否足够轻量。第二，zero mutual waiting 的时间线图，确认 speculation 用的是 pipeline input state 而不是 output state。第三，Equivalent Acceptance Length 的定义和推导，这决定了作者的速度结论是否公平。

实验部分建议优先看：SPD vs EAGLE-3 vs PPSD 的主表；不同 stage 数、不同 speculation module 深度的消融；理论 speedup 与真实 latency 的对应关系。预计 30 到 45 分钟可以抓住主要内容。如果只想判断是否值得后续跟进，看方法图、指标定义、主结果表就够了。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two structural limits of speculative decoding in low-concurrency, single-sequence inference. First, mainstream methods rely on multi-token drafting, where later draft tokens are conditioned on shallow and unverified states produced by the draft process itself. This creates compounding error and sharply lowers acceptance as draft length grows. Second, drafting and verification still introduce waiting: either the target model idles while drafts are produced, or the draft path itself is partially serial. SPD reframes the problem. Instead of predicting a long future chunk, it keeps a pipelined target model continuously fed by predicting only the next token needed to fill the pipeline.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is a meaningful inference-side idea for foundation model researchers. The main value is conceptual: speculation does not have to be framed as longer lookahead in token space; it can be framed as maintaining pipeline occupancy in execution space. That shift is useful for serving systems and may eventually feed back into model design if intermediate representations are trained to be more predictable or more aggregatable across depths. The contribution is moderate but real: a clean new decoding framework, a better metric for pipelined speculation, and stronger theoretical speedup than EAGLE-3 in most reported settings.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SPD has two central components. First, the target LLM is partitioned into n pipeline stages. Instead of running one token through all layers, the model processes n tokens concurrently at different depths. To avoid bubbles, each cycle must inject one new token into stage 1. The speculation module predicts exactly that token.

Second, the speculation module uses multi-depth feature aggregation. Unlike PPSD, which only uses shallow hidden states from the first stage, SPD collects partially processed features from tokens currently inside the pipeline, together with fully processed features from already verified tokens. These features are aggregated to predict the next token. The key argument is that prediction is grounded in richer and better-aligned internal states from the target model itself, rather than in a shallow early-exit view. The paper emphasizes a bounded-difficulty property: because the pipeline length is fixed at n, the incompleteness of the available features is bounded by a constant, instead of growing unbounded with draft length as in conventional multi-token speculation.

A second key design is zero mutual waiting. SPD shifts the speculation window forward so that the speculation module runs from the current pipeline input state, not from the output state after the current pipeline step. This allows speculation and target execution to run strictly in parallel. The trade-off is that prediction is made from earlier, less complete information. The authors compensate with stronger multi-depth aggregation and argue that, since speculation latency is fully hidden behind the target pipeline step, the speculation network can be made deeper without increasing end-to-end latency.

The paper also introduces Equivalent Acceptance Length, a metric intended to better reflect pipelined speculative decoding. Standard acceptance length can overestimate gains because it ignores pipeline fill and flush costs after rejection. The new metric explicitly accounts for initialization overhead and rejection penalties, making the theoretical speedup analysis more faithful.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are conducted on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B, evaluated on MT-Bench, GSM8K, and HumanEval. The main reported result is that SPD achieves comparable or better equivalent acceptance length and surpasses EAGLE-3 in theoretical speedup under most settings. The paper appears more careful about theoretical throughput than about claiming universal wall-clock dominance.

Several experimental choices matter. First, comparisons against PPSD are important because they isolate the value of multi-depth aggregation over shallow first-stage speculation. Second, the zero-bubble claim should be checked through ablations on speculation-module depth and whether its latency is truly hidden by the target pipeline step. Third, the proposed Equivalent Acceptance Length is itself part of the empirical story, since it explains why raw acceptance can be misleading in pipelined settings.

The excerpt provided does not include full tables, so the exact numbers are not all visible here. Still, the paper explicitly claims better theoretical acceleration than EAGLE-3 in most settings while maintaining comparable effective acceptance. When reading the full paper, the most important details to verify are: how gains scale with the number of pipeline stages, how severe flush penalties are after rejection, whether trends are consistent between 4B and 9B models, and how close wall-clock speedup is to the theoretical estimate.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Do not spend time on every derivation. Start with the introduction and lock onto the two critiques of prior speculative decoding: long-range decay and mutual waiting. Then go straight to the method figure. The key mental model is simple: SPD does not guess many future tokens at once; it predicts one token per cycle to keep the pipeline full.

Then focus on three parts. First, inspect exactly which token states and which stage features are used in multi-depth aggregation, and whether the aggregation module stays lightweight. Second, read the execution timeline for zero mutual waiting and confirm that speculation uses pipeline input states rather than output states. Third, read the definition of Equivalent Acceptance Length carefully; much of the speedup claim depends on this metric being the right one.

In experiments, prioritize the main comparison table against EAGLE-3 and PPSD, the ablations over stage count and speculation depth, and the relationship between theoretical speedup and measured latency. Around 30 to 45 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea and judge whether it is worth deeper follow-up.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统图和 speedup 假设；若硬件利用率和 acceptance rate 同时成立，单请求 serving 的 pipeline prior 要改。
recommendation.en: Read the system diagram and speedup assumptions; if utilization and acceptance both hold, this changes the prior on pipeline parallelism for single-request serving.

paper.title: HARP: Hadamard-Preconditioned Adaptive Rotation Processor for Extreme LLM Quantization
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is essential for deploying LLMs under memory and bandwidth constraints. However, extreme low-bit quantization remains highly sensitive to activation outliers and anisotropic weight curvature. Existing incoherence-based PTQ methods mitigate this issue with fixed randomized Hadamard transforms (RHTs), which improve quantization robustness but cannot adapt the rotated basis to the layer, calibration distribution, or quantizer. We introduce HARP (Hadamard-preconditio

summary.core_problem: 大模型极低比特训练后量化（PTQ）受激活离群点、权重曲率各向异性影响精度下降严重；现有基于固定随机Hadamard变换的非相干预处理方法无法针对层结构、校准分布、量化器做自适应调整，而现有可学习旋转方法要么破坏PTQ的即插即用特性要么计算成本过高。
summary.importance: 为LLM极低比特部署提供了更高效的量化预处理方案，兼容现有量化流水线，在几乎不损失推理吞吐量的前提下提升低比特量化精度，对大模型推理端落地有实用价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出HARP，一种可学习的双端正交非相干处理器，核心设计包括：1）采用类蝴蝶的分块正交级联结构实现旋转，计算复杂度接近Hadamard变换的O(d log d)；2）初始化时等价于固定随机Hadamard变换，可直接替换现有流水线中的Hadamard预处理，再通过校准数据学习结构化正交微调，适配不同层和量化后端；3）保持严格正交性，不会改变全精度模型的原始输出和量化重建目标。
summary.experiments: 在2-4比特量化设置下，覆盖1B到70B参数规模的模型，相比固定随机Hadamard变换方法取得一致的精度提升，同时通过硬件感知优化保留了大部分Hadamard变换的吞吐量优势，代码已开源。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议重点看第1章的现有PTQ预处理方法的局限性、第3章HARP的结构设计、实验部分的跨模型量化精度对比，跳过硬件实现细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Extreme low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ) for LLMs suffers from severe accuracy degradation due to activation outliers and anisotropic weight curvature. Existing incoherence preprocessing methods based on fixed randomized Hadamard transforms (RHT) cannot adapt to layer structure, calibration distribution or quantizer design, while existing learnable rotation methods either break the drop-in property of PTQ pipelines or have excessive computational cost.
summary_en.importance: Provides a more efficient quantization preprocessing solution for extreme low-bit LLM deployment. It is compatible with existing quantization pipelines and improves low-bit quantization accuracy with almost no inference throughput loss, which has practical value for large model inference deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes HARP, a learnable two-sided orthogonal incoherence processor with three core designs: 1) Uses butterfly-like cascaded block-orthogonal structures to implement rotation, with computational complexity close to the O(d log d) of Hadamard transforms; 2) Initializes to be equivalent to fixed RHT, so it can directly replace Hadamard preprocessing in existing pipelines, then learns structured orthogonal fine-tuning via calibration data to adapt to different layers and quantizer backends; 3) Maintains strict orthogonality, so it does not alter the original full-precision model output or quantization reconstruction objective.
summary_en.experiments: Tested in 2-4 bit quantization settings across models with parameter sizes from 1B to 70B, achieving consistent accuracy improvements over fixed RHT methods. It retains most of the throughput advantage of Hadamard transforms via hardware-aware optimization, and the code is open-sourced.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 1 for limitations of existing PTQ preprocessing methods, Section 3 for HARP structural design, and cross-model quantization accuracy comparison in experiments. Skip hardware implementation details. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和消融即可；若低比特 serving 是瓶颈，learned rotation 比固定 RHT 更像可复现实用改进。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations only; if low-bit serving is a bottleneck, learned rotations look more actionable than fixed RHT.

paper.title: LFQ: Logit-aware Final-block Quantization for Boosting the Generation Quality of Low-Bit Quantized LLMs
paper.abstract: As large language models continue to scale, low-bit weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) offers a practical solution to their memory-efficient deployment. Although block-wise PTQ is capable of matching the full-precision (FP) baseline on basic language modeling and understanding, its quality is degraded for generative tasks -- especially at longer responses and extended chains of thought, which is critical in boosting task accuracy. We attribute this shortfall to two factors: (i) the omi

summary.core_problem: 低比特 weight-only 的 block-wise PTQ 往往能保住困惑度/理解类指标，但在长文本生成与长 CoT 上质量明显下降。核心问题是：用 block 输出的 MSE 做目标并不能保证 next-token 分布（logits/概率）对齐，且现有 block-wise 流程通常忽略了与采样分布直接相连的 LM head/最终层结构。
summary.importance: 这是偏推理侧的量化论文，但对“训练目标与最终行为对齐”这条主线有直接启发：中间表征的 MSE 对齐不足以约束生成分布，误差会在自回归采样中累积放大。对做预训练/蒸馏/对齐的人来说，它提供了一个很具体的反例：你以为对齐了 hidden states，就等价对齐了行为；在生成任务上往往不成立。方法本身也很工程可落地：只改最终 block 的优化目标，就能显著改善生成质量，适合直接并入现有 PTQ pipeline。
summary.technical_approach: LFQ（Logit-aware Final-block Quantization）的设计很克制：前 N-1 个 Transformer block 仍沿用主流 block-wise PTQ 的做法——量化时最小化 FP block 输出与量化 block 输出之间的 MSE，以处理块内跨层依赖；但对最后一个 Transformer block，作者改用“logit 级别的交叉熵对齐”来优化，即最小化 FP 模型 logits 与量化模型 logits 诱导的 token 分布之间的交叉熵（等价于对 FP 分布做蒸馏式对齐）。动机是最后一块直接连接 unembedding/LM head，决定 next-token 采样分布；在这里继续用 MSE 对齐 hidden states，可能在 logit 空间造成小但关键的相对排序/间隔扰动，从而在长生成中滚雪球。LFQ 也强调把 LM head 纳入考虑：传统 block-wise 往往把它当作“块外固定层”而跳过，导致最终分布缺少直接约束。
summary.experiments: 作者在多类模型上验证（指令模型、推理模型、MoE），并把评测重点放在生成类基准：IFEval、GSM8K、MATH500、AIME，同时用 WikiText2、MMLU 检查语言建模/理解不退化。结论是：在相同低比特 weight-only 设定下，LFQ 相比标准 block-wise PTQ 能更接近 FP baseline 的生成表现，且不牺牲（有时还略优于）WikiText2/MMLU。你给到的全文片段未包含具体 bit-width、校准数据规模、以及各基准的绝对分数/提升幅度；精读时建议重点核对：提升是否主要来自长输出设置、是否对不同采样策略/温度鲁棒、以及对不同量化方法（GPTQ/AWQ/其他 block-wise 变体）的可插拔性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
1) 读 Introduction + Problem Statement：抓住作者对“生成质量退化来自分布失配而非 MSE 未收敛”的论证链。
2) 直接看方法部分对 final block 的目标定义：交叉熵是对 logits 还是对 softmax 后分布；是否用温度；校准 batch 如何采样。
3) 看主结果表：优先看 IFEval 与数学推理（GSM8K/MATH500/AIME），再回看 WikiText2/MMLU 确认没有用生成指标换理解指标。
4) 看消融：是否必须只改最后一块、改倒数第二块是否也有收益；是否必须包含 LM head；以及 CE vs KL vs MSE 的对比。
如果你做训练侧研究：把它当作“目标函数选择影响最终生成行为”的案例，类比到蒸馏、representation matching、以及 RL/偏好对齐中的 reward shaping。

summary_en.core_problem: Why block-wise PTQ that matches FP hidden activations via MSE can still severely degrade long-form generation: the procedure does not explicitly preserve the next-token sampling distribution (logits/probabilities), and it typically ignores the unembedding/LM head coupling at the final stage.
summary_en.importance: Although this is an inference/quantization paper, it is highly relevant to foundation-model training intuition: matching intermediate representations is not equivalent to matching generative behavior, and small logit misalignments can compound during autoregressive sampling—especially for long responses and long chains-of-thought. Practically, the method is a minimal change to existing PTQ pipelines (only the final block objective changes) with meaningful gains on generation benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: LFQ (Logit-aware Final-block Quantization) keeps standard block-wise PTQ for blocks 1..N-1 by minimizing MSE between FP and quantized block outputs. For the final Transformer block, it switches the optimization objective to a logit-level cross-entropy that aligns the token distribution induced by the quantized model with that of the FP model (a distillation-style objective). The rationale is that the last block is directly upstream of the LM head and therefore directly determines the sampling distribution; MSE alignment in hidden space can still perturb relative logit geometry (rankings/margins) in ways that matter a lot for sampling. LFQ also highlights that conventional block-wise PTQ often omits explicit treatment of the unembedding layer, further weakening distribution fidelity.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover instruction-tuned, reasoning, and MoE models. Generation-focused benchmarks include IFEval, GSM8K, MATH500, and AIME; WikiText2 and MMLU are used to verify language modeling/understanding quality is preserved. The reported outcome is that LFQ consistently improves generation quality over standard block-wise PTQ while maintaining comparable (sometimes better) WikiText2/MMLU performance. The provided excerpt does not include exact bit-widths, calibration setup, or numeric deltas; when reading the full paper, the key is to verify where the gains come from (long outputs vs short), robustness to decoding settings, and plug-and-play compatibility across PTQ variants.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the motivation + problem statement to understand the “MSE-aligned blocks but misaligned token distribution” argument.
- Focus on the method definition for the final block: what distribution is matched (logits vs softmax), whether temperature is used, and how calibration data is constructed.
- Check the main tables on IFEval and math reasoning first, then confirm WikiText2/MMLU do not regress.
- Scan ablations: final-block-only vs more blocks, inclusion of LM head, and CE/KL/MSE objective comparisons.

recommendation.zh: 只看量化目标和 final block ablation；它提醒别用困惑度判断低比特模型的长生成质量。
recommendation.en: Read the quantization objective and final-block ablation; it is a useful warning against judging low-bit models by perplexity alone.

paper.title: RW-TTT: Batched Serving for Request-Owned Test-Time Training State
paper.abstract: Test-time training (TTT) adapts an LLM during generation by reading and updating request-owned state, such as fast weights, low-rank deltas, or streaming learner state. This breaks batched LLM serving, which assumes shared static weights: serial execution is correct but slow, while naive batching can corrupt request state. We formulate this problem as read-write TTT serving and present RW-TTT , which tags each decode step with its owner, version, and READ/WRITE effect, batches only compatible ph

summary.core_problem: RW-TTT 解决的是带有请求私有、可变测试时训练状态的 LLM 如何做批量 serving：既要恢复 continuous batching 的吞吐，又不能让一个请求的 fast weights、LoRA delta 或 streaming learner state 泄漏到另一个请求。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值不在于提出新的 TTT 训练算法，而在于把 TTT 从“单请求实验范式”推进到可服务化的运行时语义。对预训练研究员的启发是：如果未来模型在推理时携带可写的模型侧状态，训练目标、状态表示和 serving contract 必须一起设计。传统 vLLM/SGLang 假设权重只读；S-LoRA/Punica 支持请求级 adapter，但 adapter 仍是只读。RW-TTT 明确指出，在线自适应模型需要 owner、version、READ/WRITE effect 和 commit 语义，否则批处理会产生隐蔽的状态污染。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案是把每个 decode step 标注为某个请求 owner 的某个 state version 上的 READ 或 WRITE。READ 只读取当前状态版本，不改变状态；WRITE 执行请求自己的更新规则，并在成功后把版本从 v 提交到 v+1。系统层面，RW-TTT 将 READ 和 WRITE operator 分开调度，只把兼容阶段放进同一个 batch；WRITE 的结果只 commit 给对应 owner。这样可以支持 fast-weight In-Place-TTT、LoRA-style test-time learning、streaming learner state 等不同状态载体，因为后端只需提供 payload 和 update rule，RW-TTT 负责所有权、版本、回滚安全和 batching planner。与简单串行或每请求副本不同，它保留了可共享计算的 READ 阶段，同时避免 WRITE 对其他请求可见。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 fast-weight In-Place-TTT checkpoint 做长上下文 serving。8 个 stream 场景下，RW-TTT 达到 274.61 aggregate tok/s；相比 sequential TTT path 的 29.51 tok/s，提升 9.31×；相比同等显存预算下的独立副本方案 79.78 tok/s，提升 3.44×。论文还在 RULER 长上下文评测上检查 32K/64K 行为保持，结论是 RW-TTT 保留了 adapted checkpoint 的任务表现。同时通过 owner/version correctness gates 验证状态不会跨请求污染，WRITE 失败、fallback、rollback 和 speculative branch 都能依赖显式版本语义处理。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。重点看 §3 的 serving contract，这是论文最有信息量的部分；它定义了 READ/WRITE、owner、version 和 commit 语义。然后看 §4 的 batching planner，理解哪些阶段能合 batch，哪些必须隔离。§5 的吞吐实验值得看表格，不必过度关注 RULER 分数本身，关键是行为保持和 correctness gate。若关注 TTT 或 inference-time adaptation，建议额外留意它把 fast weights、LoRA delta、streaming learner state 统一成“request-owned mutable model-side state”的抽象。

summary_en.core_problem: RW-TTT addresses batched serving for LLMs whose test-time training state is request-owned and mutable, where fast weights, LoRA deltas, or streaming learner state must be updated during generation without leaking across requests.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly a systems contract for online-adaptive models, not a new TTT algorithm. Its relevance is that it makes the serving implications of writable model-side state explicit. Existing LLM serving stacks assume shared immutable weights; adapter-serving systems allow request-specific state, but that state is fixed during decoding. RW-TTT shows that inference-time adaptation needs ownership, versioning, read/write effects, and rollback-safe commit semantics. This is useful for pretraining and model-design work because future adaptive checkpoints may need to co-design the training objective, state representation, and runtime contract.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system tags every decode step with an owner, a state version, and a READ or WRITE effect. A READ observes the request’s current state version and leaves it unchanged. A successful WRITE applies the backend-defined update rule and commits a new version only for the owning request. RW-TTT separates read and write operators, batches only compatible phases, and maintains explicit versions for rollback, failed writes, fallback paths, and speculative branches. The abstraction covers fast-weight In-Place-TTT, low-rank test-time deltas, and streaming learner state because the backend supplies the state payload and update rule, while RW-TTT supplies ownership, version control, commit semantics, and batch planning.
summary_en.experiments: On a long-context serving workload with a fast-weight In-Place-TTT checkpoint, RW-TTT reaches 274.61 aggregate tokens/s with eight streams. This is 9.31× faster than the sequential TTT path, which reaches 29.51 tokens/s, and 3.44× faster than independent per-stream replicas under the same memory budget, which reach 79.78 tokens/s. The paper also evaluates behavior preservation on RULER at 32K and 64K context lengths and reports that the adapted checkpoint’s task behavior is preserved. Owner/version correctness gates are used to verify that mutable state is not corrupted or exposed to the wrong request.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take about 30–40 minutes. Read Section 3 carefully for the serving contract: owner, version, READ/WRITE effect, and commit semantics are the main contribution. Section 4 is the next most useful part because it explains how legal batching is recovered under these constraints. In Section 5, focus on the throughput table and correctness checks rather than the benchmark scores alone. The most useful abstraction is the unification of fast weights, low-rank deltas, and streaming learner state as request-owned mutable model-side state.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统模型和吞吐表；它不证明 TTT 有效，但把“可写权重还能不能合批”这个坑讲得很干净。
recommendation.en: Read the system model and throughput table; it does not validate TTT itself, but it cleanly exposes the batching failure mode for mutable per-request state.

paper.title: Stateful Inference for Low-Latency Multi-Agent Tool Calling
paper.abstract: Multi-agent tool calling is becoming the dominant interaction pattern for LLM-based systems, yet existing inference frameworks treat each tool call as an independent request, re-processing the entire conversation from scratch even though 85-95% of the prompt is unchanged from the previous turn.   We present a stateful inference architecture that converts the $O(n_t)$ per-turn cost of conventional serving into an $O(Δ_t)$ delta-only cost: a persistent KV cache lives across turns and advances by i

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是多轮、多 Agent 工具调用中的重复 prefill 问题。Agent 会不断在已有上下文后追加少量新 token，但常见推理框架仍把每次 API 调用当成独立请求，反复处理几乎相同的长前缀。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更偏 serving 和 agent inference system。但它对理解新型 LLM 工作负载有参考价值：Agent 场景的主要瓶颈不一定在 decode，而是在大量短增量请求反复 prefill。若基座模型未来在训练或评测中大量纳入工具调用轨迹，这类 stateful execution 也会影响数据生成、在线评测和 RL rollout 的系统成本。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案是把 stateless request 改成 stateful session。系统为每个长期会话保留 KV cache，只处理本轮新增 token，将每轮 prefill 从 O(n_t) 降到 O(Δ_t)。具体机制包括：用 sequence pool 预分配并复用命名 sequence ID，避免每次请求重建上下文；用 radix prefix cache 在统一 KV cache 上做元数据级 aliasing，使长前缀恢复接近常数时间；调度侧用 cell-budget admission 控制 KV 资源，并把共享完全相同前缀的请求做 grouped prefill；对完全相同 prompt，使用由 prompt hash 决定随机种子的 response cache；decode 侧加入 prompt-lookup speculation、流式 JSON 工具调用校验、设备端 greedy sampling，以及异常安全的 RAII session 生命周期管理。与 vLLM/SGLang 这类以请求为中心的 prefix caching 不同，它把会话状态作为一级抽象，而不是把 cache 当成可有可无的加速项。
summary.experiments: 文中给出的关键 workload 观察是：典型 5 轮 Agent 对话中，相邻轮次 85–95% prompt token 相同。示例里系统提示约 200 token，每轮约 150 token，到最后一轮 prompt 约 950 token，但新增 token 只有约 150。论文主张这类结构使传统 per-request prefill 产生接近多倍的重复 FLOPs。给出的复杂度收益是从每轮 O(n_t) 转为 O(Δ_t)，共享前缀的 N 个 slot 可由 leader-follower prefill 合并为一次 forward。提供内容中未看到可独立核验的端到端吞吐、TTFT、显存占用或多并发压测数字，因此实验部分更像系统设计论证，而不是完整 benchmark 结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 Agent traffic 的 workload 刻画，以及九个机制的边界分工。Problem Formulation 值得看，因为它把多 Agent 交错请求下的 prefix-extension 关系写清楚了。若只关心 LLM 基座训练，可跳过实现细节；若关心 RL rollout、工具调用数据生成或长上下文 serving，可以重点看 radix prefix cache、cell-budget admission 和 streaming tool-call validator。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets redundant prefill in multi-turn, multi-agent tool calling. Agent prompts grow by appending small deltas, yet common inference stacks often handle each API call as an independent request and reprocess a large repeated prefix.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in serving infrastructure rather than pretraining. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but useful: agentic workloads can be dominated by repeated prefill rather than token generation. If tool-use traces become a larger part of data generation, evaluation, or RL rollouts, stateful inference will materially affect system cost and experiment throughput.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central move is to replace stateless requests with stateful sessions. A persistent KV cache is kept across turns, so each request only ingests newly appended tokens, changing the per-turn prefill cost from O(n_t) to O(Δ_t). The design combines several mechanisms: a sequence pool with reusable named sequence IDs; a radix prefix cache that restores cached prefixes through metadata aliasing over a unified KV cache; cell-budget admission and prefix-aware grouped prefill; a prompt-deterministic response cache using prompt-hash seeding; prompt-lookup speculative decoding with concurrency caps; a streaming JSON validator for tool calls; on-device greedy sampling; and RAII-style lifecycle management for session slots. Compared with prefix caching in request-driven systems such as vLLM or SGLang, the key distinction is that session state is treated as a first-class abstraction.
summary_en.experiments: The main quantitative workload claim is that consecutive turns in typical 5-turn agent conversations share 85–95% of prompt tokens. In the paper’s example, a 200-token system prompt plus roughly 150 tokens per turn yields a final prompt of about 950 tokens, of which only about 150 are new. The claimed algorithmic gain is delta-only prefill, and shared-prefix grouped prefill can collapse N redundant forward passes into one. The provided text does not include independently checkable end-to-end numbers for throughput, TTFT, memory pressure, or high-concurrency stress tests, so the evidence should be read primarily as a system design argument.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Focus on the workload characterization in the introduction and the division of responsibilities across the nine mechanisms. The problem formulation is useful because it makes the prefix-extension structure explicit under interleaved multi-agent calls. For foundation-model training interests, most implementation details can be skipped; for RL rollout systems, tool-use data generation, or long-context serving, the radix cache, cell-budget admission, and streaming tool-call validator are the parts worth reading more carefully.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计和 workloads；若真实 agent 流量确有 85–95% prompt 复用，这类 stateful KV 会比继续卷 attention kernel 更先省钱。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and workloads; if real agent traffic indeed has 85–95% prompt reuse, stateful KV reuse will save money before another attention-kernel tweak does.

paper.title: Frontier: Towards Comprehensive and Accurate LLM Inference Simulation
paper.abstract: Modern LLM serving is no longer homogeneous or monolithic. Production systems now combine disaggregated execution, complex parallelism, runtime optimizations, and stateful workloads such as reasoning, agents, and RL rollouts. Simulation is attractive for exploring this growing design space, yet existing simulators lack the architectural completeness and decision-grade fidelity it demands. Their monolithic-replica abstractions are ill-suited to disaggregated serving, while average-case analytical

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决现代 LLM inference serving 难以准确模拟的问题。生产系统已经不再是同构、单体 replica：prefill/decode 可能解耦，attention/FFN 也可能解耦，还叠加 TP、PP、DP、EP、continuous batching、PagedAttention、prefix caching、chunked prefill、speculative decoding 等机制。已有模拟器常用平均化的单体抽象，容易在 SLA、吞吐和配置选择上给出错误结论。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在训练后阶段和系统-算法接口。长链推理、agent、多轮工具调用和 RL rollout 都会把 inference 变成训练成本的一部分，尤其是 RL post-training 中的大量采样。一个能模拟 stateful workload、decode tail、KV cache 压力和 disaggregated serving 的工具，可以帮助判断模型结构、上下文长度、MoE 路由、speculative decoding 策略对真实成本的影响。它不直接改变预训练目标，但能让 scaling 和 post-training 预算估算更接近生产约束。
summary.technical_approach: Frontier 是一个 discrete-event simulator。核心设计是把 serving 系统拆成 control plane 和 fidelity plane。control plane 将 serving specification 编译成 role-specific cluster workers，不再假设所有 replica 执行相同操作。它显式建模 co-located、Prefill-Decode Disaggregation 和 Attention-FFN Disaggregation，并把同步、KV-cache transfer、不同硬件池之间的数据移动作为事件处理。runtime optimization 不是用事后修正系数近似，而是以 feature-specific adapter 的方式嵌入 scheduler–batch-engine loop，直接改变调度器可见状态。workload 侧引入 stateful request 抽象，可表示 thinking rounds、tool-call delay、每轮 token plan 和 phase transition，用来覆盖 reasoning、agent 和 RL rollout 场景。这个设计重点不在单个 kernel 的极限优化，而在保留 serving closed loop 中的队列、内存、batch 形状和调度反馈。
summary.experiments: 论文指出平均化 proxy 会带来明显误差：token-count proxy 在 FlashAttention 上可产生 32.6% runtime error，在 MoE GroupedGEMM 上可产生 21.0% error；用“总显存减权重”估算 KV-cache budget 会最高高估 27.2%，并导致吞吐预测最高高估 32.4%。这些数字说明，在连续 batching、KV 增长和变长请求共同作用下，小的 operator 或 memory 误差会被 closed-loop 调度放大，进而改变 Pareto frontier 和配置选择。完整实验应重点检查它在真实系统 trace 或 microbenchmark 上的校准方式，以及对 PDD、AFD、speculative decoding、prefix caching 等组合配置的预测误差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 section 2.2，那里给出了已有模拟器为何会反向判断优化收益的具体误差来源。然后看系统设计中 disaggregated abstraction、stateful request abstraction 和 scheduler adapter。实验部分重点看三类内容：operator/runtime fidelity 如何校准，KV-cache memory model 如何建，配置选择是否与真实部署一致。对做 RLHF/RLVR 或 agent rollout 基础设施的人，workload model 比具体 UI 或模拟器接口更值得读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets accurate simulation of modern LLM inference serving. Production serving is no longer a set of homogeneous monolithic replicas. Systems now combine prefill/decode disaggregation, attention/FFN disaggregation, multiple forms of parallelism, continuous batching, PagedAttention, prefix caching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding, and stateful workloads. Existing simulators often use averaged monolithic abstractions, which can mispredict latency, memory pressure, throughput, and even the direction of an optimization.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining research is indirect but practical. Inference is now part of the training loop for RL post-training, synthetic data generation, reasoning rollouts, and agent evaluation. A simulator that captures long decode tails, KV-cache pressure, phase-changing requests, and disaggregated execution can improve budget estimates for RL rollouts and help evaluate architecture choices such as MoE, long context, or speculative decoding under realistic serving constraints. It is a systems paper, but the feedback signal is useful when model design and post-training cost are considered together.
summary_en.technical_approach: Frontier is a discrete-event simulator built around a disaggregated serving abstraction. A control plane compiles a serving specification into role-specific cluster workers rather than assuming identical replicas. It explicitly models co-located serving, Prefill-Decode Disaggregation, and Attention-FFN Disaggregation, including synchronization and data movement such as KV-cache transfers. Runtime optimizations are represented as feature-specific adapters inside the scheduler–batch-engine loop, so they modify scheduler-visible state instead of being added as analytical correction factors. The workload model uses stateful requests that can include thinking rounds, tool-call delays, per-round token plans, and phase transitions, which makes it suitable for reasoning, agentic, and RL-rollout traffic. The design prioritizes closed-loop fidelity: queue evolution, batch shape, memory pressure, and scheduling feedback are treated as first-class effects.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that common analytical proxies can be substantially wrong. Token-count runtime proxies can produce 32.6% error on FlashAttention and 21.0% error on MoE GroupedGEMM. A memory model based on total memory minus weights can overestimate KV-cache budget by up to 27.2% and throughput by up to 32.4%. These errors matter because continuous batching, variable sequence lengths, KV-cache growth, and memory limits interact in a closed loop. Small per-operator or memory errors can move TTFT, TPOT, and throughput across SLA boundaries and change the selected configuration. The key experimental sections to inspect are the calibration against microbenchmarks or real traces, and the prediction accuracy for combinations of PDD, AFD, prefix caching, chunked prefill, and speculative decoding.
summary_en.reading_guide: A productive skim takes around 25–35 minutes. Start with the motivation and the failure cases in section 2.2, especially the examples where average-case proxies lead to the wrong optimization conclusion. Then read the design of the disaggregated abstraction, the stateful request model, and the scheduler adapters. In the evaluation, focus on fidelity calibration, KV-cache memory modeling, and whether predicted configuration choices match real deployments. For researchers running RLHF, RLVR, or large-scale agent rollouts, the workload abstraction is more important than the simulator interface details.

recommendation.zh: 推理服务设计空间探索的实用工具，分解式抽象是关键创新，对训练推理协同设计（如RL rollout批量策略）有参考价值，建议看§3系统设计和§5评估
recommendation.en: Practical tool for inference serving design space exploration; the disaggregated abstraction is a key innovation; useful for training-inference co-design (e.g., RL rollout batching strategies); read §3 system design and §5 evaluation

paper.title: KVServe: Service-Aware KV Cache Compression for Communication-Efficient Disaggregated LLM Serving
paper.abstract: LLMs are widely adopted in production, pushing inference systems to their limits. Disaggregated LLM serving (e.g., PD separation and KV state disaggregation) improves scalability and cost efficiency, but it also turns KV into an explicit payload crossing network and storage boundaries, making KV a dominant end-to-end bottleneck. Existing KV compression are typically static runtime configurations, despite production service context varies over time in workload mix, bandwidth, and SLO/quality budg

summary.core_problem: 在 PD 分离与 KV 远端化的解耦式 LLM serving 中，KV cache 从“GPU 内部状态”变成跨网络/存储边界传输的显式 payload，通信带宽成为端到端瓶颈；而现有 KV 压缩通常是静态配置，无法随在线服务上下文（带宽、workload 结构、SLO/质量预算）变化自适应选择，导致在某些场景下不但不降延迟，反而出现负优化。
summary.importance: 这篇工作主要是 serving 系统贡献，不是预训练方法论文；但它对基座研究的间接价值在于：长上下文与 agentic workload 会把 KV 体量与带宽压力推到“系统主导”的量级，进而反向约束模型侧的设计（上下文长度策略、KV 结构/精度、长上下文训练与推理预算）。它把 KV 压缩从“选一个算法”提升为“受约束的策略选择问题”，给后续做端到端 co-design（模型结构/量化友好 KV、训练时对 KV 量化鲁棒性）提供了更清晰的接口。
summary.technical_approach:
KVServe 的核心是把分散的 KV 压缩方法抽象成可组合的模块化流水线，并在此之上做离线搜索 + 在线自适应控制。
1) 统一抽象与策略空间：将 KV 压缩拆成若干可插拔组件（如变换/预处理、量化粒度与位宽、编码/codec 等），把 CacheGen/KIVI/KVQuant 等代表方法“解耦重组”，并额外引入作者设计的新量化组件，使得不同方法的部件可以复用与组合，形成可枚举的策略集合。
2) Bayesian Profiling Engine：策略空间组合爆炸，端到端 profiling 成本高。用贝叶斯优化在离线阶段选择少量高价值候选进行 profiling，以显著减少需要跑的配置数；论文声称将离线搜索开销从约 1000 小时量级降到约 20 小时量级。
3) Service-Aware Online Controller：在线阶段感知服务上下文（workload、有效带宽、SLO/质量预算等），从离线候选中快速选取策略。控制器结合解析延迟模型（用于快速估算与约束）+ 轻量 bandit（用于修正离线 profiling 与线上真实运行的偏差/漂移），支持策略切换并避免因环境变化导致的负优化。
4) 系统集成：集成进 vLLM 推理流水线，面向 PD-separated 与 KV-disaggregated 两类解耦架构评估。
summary.experiments:
论文在端到端实验中指出 KV 通信可占 job completion time 的最高约 60%。在效果上，作者报告：
- 在 PD-separated serving 场景，相比 baseline 与若干 SOTA KV 压缩方法，最高可达 9.13× 的 JCT 降低。
- 在 KV-disaggregated serving 场景，最高可达 32.8× 的 TTFT 降低。
引言还给出若干量级例子用于说明瓶颈强度：如 Llama 3.1-70B 在 128K token 时 KV 约 39.06GB；以及某些大模型长输入场景下 prefill 集群对 KV egress 带宽需求可达 Tbps 量级，而常见跨集群带宽远低于此（<100Gbps）。这些数字主要用于动机与系统约束刻画。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Sec.2.2（或对应的动机章节）里“静态配置为何会切换最优/产生负优化”的测量与例子，这是把问题从算法选择变成策略选择的关键。
- 重点看系统抽象图（KV 压缩流水线的模块划分）和策略空间如何枚举；这决定了它能否真正复用现有方法而不是“重新实现一个压缩”。
- 看 Bayesian profiling 的目标函数、约束与采样策略：它决定离线成本是否可信，以及是否会偏向某类 workload。
- 看在线控制器的解析延迟模型假设、bandit 的反馈信号与切换开销处理；这里最容易出现工程上“论文可行、线上难用”的落差。
- 结果部分优先看：不同带宽/不同 workload mix 下的策略切换曲线与鲁棒性，而不只是峰值倍数。

summary_en.core_problem: In disaggregated LLM serving (prefill/decode separation and remote/disaggregated KV state), the KV cache becomes an explicit payload crossing network/storage boundaries, turning KV transfer into a dominant end-to-end bottleneck. Existing KV compression methods are typically configured statically, but the latency-optimal configuration depends on the live service context (workload mix, effective bandwidth, and SLO/quality budgets). A fixed choice can therefore be suboptimal or even increase latency (negative optimization).
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a serving-systems paper rather than a pretraining-method contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but practical: long-context and agentic workloads can make KV bandwidth the limiting factor, which in turn constrains model-side choices (context length policies, KV precision/structure, and robustness to KV quantization). The paper reframes KV compression from “pick an algorithm” to a constrained, context-dependent strategy selection problem, which is a useful interface for future model–system co-design (e.g., training-time robustness to KV quantization or KV-friendly architectures).
summary_en.technical_approach:
KVServe combines (i) a modular abstraction of KV compression into a composable pipeline, (ii) efficient offline search over a combinatorial strategy space, and (iii) an online controller that adapts to changing service conditions.
1) Modular strategy space: it decomposes representative KV compression methods into plug-and-play components (e.g., transforms/preprocessing, quantization schemes and granularities, codecs), enabling cross-method reuse and composition; the authors also introduce a new quantization component.
2) Bayesian Profiling Engine: because exhaustive end-to-end profiling is infeasible, it uses Bayesian optimization to select a small set of promising configurations to profile offline, reportedly reducing search cost from ~1000 hours to ~20 hours.
3) Service-aware online control: at runtime, it senses service context and selects an optimal profile from offline candidates under SLO/quality constraints. It combines an analytical latency model (fast constraint-aware selection) with a lightweight bandit mechanism to correct offline/online mismatch and handle drift, enabling robust switching.
4) Integration: implemented in the vLLM pipeline and evaluated for both PD-separated and KV-disaggregated serving architectures.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports that KV communication can account for up to ~60% of job completion time in their end-to-end measurements. Claimed improvements include:
- Up to 9.13× JCT reduction for PD-separated serving versus baselines and prior KV compression methods.
- Up to 32.8× TTFT reduction for KV-disaggregated serving.
Motivating scale examples include ~39.06GB KV for Llama 3.1-70B at 128K tokens, and Tbps-level KV egress demand in large-model long-input settings, contrasted with typical cross-cluster bandwidth limits (<100Gbps) and remote storage throughput constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Start with the motivation/measurement section that demonstrates regime switches and negative optimization under static configs; this is the key problem statement.
- Focus on the pipeline abstraction figure and how strategies are enumerated/composed across prior methods.
- Read the Bayesian profiling objective and sampling procedure to judge whether the offline cost and coverage are realistic.
- Inspect the online controller: assumptions in the analytical latency model, the bandit feedback signal, and how switching overhead is handled.
- In results, prioritize robustness across bandwidth/workload regimes and strategy-switching behavior over peak “×” numbers.

recommendation.zh: 读系统设计和 profiling 部分即可；它不改预训练方法，但会影响长上下文模型的服务侧真实成本模型。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and profiling sections; it does not change pretraining, but it updates the real serving cost model for long-context LMs.

paper.title: PALS: Power-Aware LLM Serving for Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference has become a dominant workload in modern data centers, driving significant GPU utilization and energy consumption. While prior systems optimize throughput and latency by batching, scheduling, and parallelism, they largely treat GPU power as a static constraint rather than a controllable resource. In this paper, we present a power-aware runtime for LLM serving, PALS, that treats GPU power caps as a first-class control knob and jointly optimizes them with softw

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM serving 中 GPU 功耗被当作静态约束的问题，尤其面向 dense 与 MoE 模型的吞吐、延迟和能效联合优化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统优化。它把 GPU power cap 作为运行时控制变量，与 batch size 等软件参数一起调度，目标是在满足吞吐需求的同时提高能效。
summary.technical_approach: PALS 在 vLLM 中实现，无需模型重训或 API 改动。系统先离线构建轻量级 power-performance 模型，再用反馈控制器根据吞吐目标选择 power cap、batch size 等配置。
summary.experiments: 在多 GPU 系统上测试 dense 与 MoE LLM。摘要报告 PALS 最高提升 26.3% 能效，并减少 QoS violation；具体模型规模、硬件配置和完整 baseline 需看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Boston University 和 Harvard University，工作落点是数据中心 LLM serving 的能耗控制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the fact that GPU power is usually treated as a static constraint in LLM serving, especially for dense and MoE models where throughput, latency, and energy efficiency interact.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-system optimization. It makes GPU power caps a runtime control knob and jointly tunes them with software parameters such as batch size to meet throughput targets while improving energy efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: PALS is implemented inside vLLM without model retraining or API changes. It combines lightweight offline power-performance models with a feedback controller that selects power caps, batch sizes, and related configurations under a throughput target.
summary_en.experiments: The system is evaluated on multi-GPU setups with both dense and MoE LLMs. The abstract reports up to 26.3% energy-efficiency improvement and reduced QoS violations; exact model sizes, hardware, and full baselines require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Boston University and Harvard University, with the work focused on energy-aware LLM serving in data centers.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练只给间接信号；读系统设计和 MoE serving 曲线即可，别把能效结论外推到训练侧。
recommendation.en: It gives only indirect signal for pretraining; read the system design and MoE serving curves, but do not extrapolate the energy claims to training.

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the KV-cache communication bottleneck in disaggregated LLM serving. With prefill/decode separation and remote KV-state disaggregation, KV is no longer just an internal GPU-resident state; it becomes a large payload transferred across network and storage boundaries. Under changing workloads, bandwidth, quality budgets, and SLOs, a fixed KV-compression configuration can be suboptimal or even increase latency.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant to foundation-model research. Long-context models, RAG, and agent workloads are increasingly limited by KV movement. Those constraints feed back into model architecture choices, context-length targets, and KV-efficient design. The useful shift in this work is to frame KV compression as a service-conditioned strategy-selection problem, not as a static compression-algorithm benchmark.
summary_en.technical_approach: KVServe decomposes KV compression into a modular pipeline with pluggable components such as transforms, quantization choices, granularities, and codecs. It also adds a new quantization component and uses cross-method composition to build an enumerable strategy space. Since exhaustive profiling is too expensive, the offline stage uses a Bayesian Profiling Engine to search for good candidates under quality and latency constraints. At runtime, a Service-Aware Online Controller senses the current service context and selects a profile. The controller combines an analytical latency model with a lightweight bandit mechanism, where the bandit corrects mismatches between offline profiling and online behavior. The system is integrated into vLLM and targets end-to-end KV transfer latency, not compression ratio alone.
summary_en.experiments: The paper provides concrete scale numbers for the bottleneck. Llama 3.1-70B produces about 39.06 GB of KV at 128K tokens. Serving 32K-token requests with Qwen3-235B on a 64-node prefill cluster requires about 2.1 Tbps of KV egress bandwidth. In the authors' end-to-end experiments, KV communication accounts for up to 60% of job completion time. The Bayesian profiling stage reduces offline search cost from around 1000 hours to the 20-hour range. Across datasets, models, GPU setups, and network configurations, KVServe reports up to 9.13x job-completion-time reduction for PD-separated serving and up to 32.8x TTFT reduction for KV-disaggregated serving. A central empirical finding is that the best compression strategy changes with workload and bandwidth, so static configurations can produce negative optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide: A targeted skim should take about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with the introduction and the motivation section, especially the measurements showing when KV transfer dominates latency and when static compression fails. Then read the modular strategy-space abstraction to see how methods such as CacheGen, KIVI, and KVQuant are represented. The Bayesian profiler and the online controller are the main method components. In the evaluation, prioritize end-to-end JCT, TTFT, bandwidth sensitivity, and strategy-switching results. If the goal is pretraining insight, skip low-level implementation details and keep the cost model for long-context serving.

recommendation.zh: 读系统设计和 profiling 结果就够；对 pretrain 的间接价值是提醒长上下文训练假设会被服务端 KV 通信成本反咬。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and profiling results; the pretraining-relevant lesson is that long-context ambitions can be constrained by KV movement at serving time.
