summary.core_problem: 降低 LLM 在实时广告生成和定向广告系统中的推理延迟与计算成本，同时尽量保持生成质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏工程集成。论文把量化、稀疏化和并行验证组合成面向业务部署的 Efficient Generative Targeting 框架；通用方法有一定参考价值，但实验场景强绑定广告业务，对基座研究的信息增益有限。
summary.technical_approach: 框架包含 adaptive group quantization、layer-adaptive hierarchical sparsification 和 prefix-tree parallel verification。前两者压缩模型计算和存储，第三者利用前缀树结构对候选生成进行并行验证，以减少实时服务中的串行等待。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在两个真实广告场景上进行了实验，并取得显著加速且质量下降可接受；但未给出模型参数量、量化 bit 数、稀疏率、延迟提升倍数、质量指标或通用 LLM serving 基线。需要谨慎看待其外推性。
summary.authors_note: 百度北京团队，论文主要服务商业广告部署。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce inference latency and compute cost for LLMs used in real-time advertising generation and targeting while preserving generation quality.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an engineering integration. It combines quantization, sparsification, and parallel verification into an Efficient Generative Targeting framework. The individual techniques may be useful, but the evidence is tied to advertising workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework uses adaptive group quantization, layer-adaptive hierarchical sparsification, and prefix-tree parallel verification. The first two reduce model compute and memory cost, while the prefix-tree verifier parallelizes candidate checking to reduce serial latency in production serving.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on two real-world advertising scenarios with significant speedup and acceptable quality degradation. It does not specify model sizes, quantization bits, sparsity levels, latency gains, quality metrics, or comparisons with general LLM serving baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Baidu Beijing and is primarily motivated by commercial advertising deployment.

recommendation.zh: 作为压缩方案组合案例知道即可；广告 workload 太窄，除非你做线上 serving，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a compression-stack case study; the ad workload is narrow, so skip the body unless you work on production serving.

paper.title: Regulating Branch Parallelism in LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Recent methods expose intra-request parallelism in LLM outputs, allowing independent branches to decode concurrently. Existing serving systems execute these branches eagerly or under fixed caps. We show that both are brittle: eager admission inflates the shared decode step, degrading co-batched requests in serial stages, while conservative fixed caps forgo the throughput that motivated exposing branches in the first place. We call the excess step latency caused by admitted branches the branch ex

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 LLM serving 里一个很具体但以前容易被忽略的问题：当系统暴露 intra-request parallelism，也就是把一个请求拆成多个可并行分支同时解码时，单个请求会变快，但共享 batch 中其他串行请求会为更宽的 decode step 付出额外时延。作者把这部分代价定义为 branch externality。核心问题不是“要不要做分支并行”，而是“在连续 batching 的共享系统里，每一步应该放多少分支进去”，因为安全宽度会随着 batch 组成、上下文长度、SLO slack 动态变化，固定策略很容易在不同负载下失效。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练论文，而是推理服务系统论文，按 digest 分类应放在 efficient。对基座研究员的价值主要有两层。第一，它把 IRP 从“算法上能并行多少”改写成“系统上该兑现多少”，提醒人们很多生成范式上的并行性只有在共享服务条件下才有真实收益。第二，它把 decode step latency、KV cache 驻留、SLO slack 这几个 serving 约束讲得很清楚，对评估 any-order generation、branching reasoning、tree decoding 这类新生成范式很有参考意义。贡献量级上，它更像一个调度控制器与系统建模工作，而不是新的语言建模方法；但如果关心推理阶段如何承载更复杂的生成结构，这篇是有信息量的。
summary.technical_approach: 作者的关键观察是：branch-level scheduling 可以把“算力调度”和“内存回收”部分解耦。传统 request-level 暂停/恢复之所以难做，是因为一旦暂停请求，就要决定是否保留整段 KV；若驱逐，再恢复会有明显代价。分支并行场景下，同一请求的多个 branch 共享 prefix KV，而每个 branch 自己新增的 branch-local KV 只覆盖该分支已生成的少量 token，通常远小于共享前缀。因此，某一步不让某个 branch 参与 forward pass，只是暂时不分配算力给它，不需要回收共享 prefix，也通常不需要驱逐 branch-local KV；下一步再把它加回 batch 即可。基于这个结构性质，作者提出 TAPER。它的策略分两层：先保护 single-token progress，保证每个活跃请求在下一步至少推进一个 token；再把额外 branch 当作 opportunistic width，只在预测的 branch externality 仍落在当前 batch 的 slack budget 内时才准入。实现上，TAPER需要一个 per-step latency/externality 预测器，以及一个 greedy planner 来决定本步额外接纳哪些 branch。utility 接口是可插拔的，因此可以按不同目标优化吞吐、goodput 或 SLO。和 eager admission 相比，TAPER不是默认把所有可并行分支都放进来；和 fixed cap 相比，它不是设一个静态 k，而是每步根据当前 batch 状态伸缩。方法上的重点不是复杂模型，而是把 admission control 粒度降到 decode step，并利用 branch deferral 的低恢复成本实现快速调节。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Qwen3-32B 上做 mixed workloads，对比对象包括 IRP-OFF、IRP-EAGER 和固定宽度策略。论文给出的主结果是：TAPER 相比 IRP-OFF 的 goodput 提升 1.77×，相比 IRP-EAGER 提升 1.48×；同时在 eager 策略的 SLO attainment 跌到 50% 以下时，TAPER 仍能维持 95% 以上。这个结果说明 eager admission 虽然可能提高 aggregate token throughput，但未必提高对服务系统更关键的 goodput 和达标率。作者还先用数据集统计说明 IRP 在真实工作负载里并不少见：ShareGPT Vicuna、RAG-12K、Math-220K 三个数据集上，可分解请求占比、parallel token share、平均 branch fanout 都不低，图 1 给出的 PDR/PTS/ABF 分别约为 ShareGPT 43.5%/70.5%/5.2，RAG-12K 67.0%/68.9%/4.2，Math-220K 84.2%/30.6%/2.7。这个统计很重要，因为它说明问题不是人为构造的极端角落。更值得注意的是评价指标的选择：作者强调 eager 可能让总 token throughput 看起来更高，但 co-batched 串行请求的 step latency 被拖慢，最终 goodput 和 SLO 反而更差。若继续深读，应重点看不同负载区间、不同上下文长度和不同 branch fanout 下，TAPER 的 admission 决策如何变化，以及预测误差对控制效果的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 如果只想抓主线，先读 Introduction 和第 2 节。第 2 节把 branch externality 讲清楚，是整篇最重要的概念。然后读 3.5 附近关于 branch-level scheduling 为什么能便宜地 reversible，这决定了为什么 per-step 控制在工程上可行。接着看 TAPER 的控制逻辑：single-token progress 保护、slack budget、greedy planner、pluggable utility。实验部分先看主表，确认 goodput 与 SLO attainment 的提升，再看 workload 统计图和不同 operating point 下的曲线，理解为什么 fixed cap 会在不同负载下失灵。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成泛读。若你在做 tree decoding、parallel reasoning、speculative branching 或 serving 调度，这篇值得细看 latency model 和 admission planner 的细节；若只关心预训练，可知道结论即可，不必深挖实现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific systems problem in LLM serving: once a serving stack exposes intra-request parallelism, a single request may speed up by decoding multiple independent branches concurrently, but co-batched serial requests pay for the wider decode step. The authors call this extra latency the branch externality. The real question is not whether branch parallelism is useful in isolation, but how much of it should be admitted at each decode step in a shared continuous-batching system. The safe width depends on batch composition, context lengths, and remaining SLO slack, all of which vary over time, so static policies are brittle.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficient-serving paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but real. First, it reframes intra-request parallelism from an algorithmic possibility into a systems admission-control problem: parallel generation only helps if the shared serving system can realize it without harming everyone else. Second, it gives a concrete way to think about decode-step latency, KV-cache residency, and SLO slack when evaluating branching generation schemes such as tree decoding, parallel reasoning, or other nonstandard decoding structures. The contribution is mainly a scheduling/controller design plus a systems model, not a new language-modeling method. Still, if one cares about how richer generation structures survive contact with production serving, this paper is informative.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central observation is that branch-level scheduling partially decouples compute regulation from memory regulation. Request-level pause/resume is expensive because pausing a request forces a decision about its KV state: keep it resident and consume memory, or evict it and later pay restoration cost. In branch-parallel decoding, sibling branches share the request’s prefix KV, while each branch’s private KV only covers the tokens generated on that branch so far, typically much smaller than the shared prefix. Therefore, deferring a branch for one step mostly means withholding compute from that branch; it does not require reclaiming the shared prefix and usually does not require evicting the branch-local KV. Re-admission in a later step is cheap. On top of this structural property, the paper introduces TAPER. The controller first guarantees single-token progress: every active request contributes exactly one token to the next step. Additional branches are then treated as opportunistic width and admitted only if the predicted branch externality fits within the current batch’s slack budget. This requires a per-step latency/externality predictor and a greedy planner that chooses which extra branches to admit. The utility interface is pluggable, so the planner can target different objectives such as throughput, goodput, or SLO attainment. Compared with eager admission, TAPER does not realize all available branch parallelism by default. Compared with fixed caps, it does not rely on a static width k. The main idea is to move admission control to decode-step granularity and exploit the cheap reversibility of branch deferral.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Qwen3-32B under mixed workloads and compares TAPER against IRP-OFF, IRP-EAGER, and fixed-width baselines. The headline result is that TAPER improves goodput by 1.77× over IRP-OFF and by 1.48× over IRP-EAGER, while maintaining over 95% SLO attainment in regimes where eager admission drops below 50%. This is the key empirical point: eager branch admission may increase aggregate token throughput, yet still reduce the metrics that matter for a shared service because serial co-batched requests suffer inflated step latency. The paper also argues that intra-request parallelism is common enough to matter in practice. Figure 1 reports workload statistics on ShareGPT Vicuna, RAG-12K, and Math-220K, with nontrivial proportions of decomposable requests, parallel token share, and average branch fanout: roughly 43.5%/70.5%/5.2 for ShareGPT, 67.0%/68.9%/4.2 for RAG-12K, and 84.2%/30.6%/2.7 for Math-220K. That matters because it shows the problem is not an artificial corner case. The most useful experimental lens is the metric choice: token throughput alone can be misleading, whereas goodput and SLO attainment expose the externality. A deeper read should focus on how TAPER’s decisions change across load levels, context lengths, and branch fanouts, and how sensitive the controller is to prediction error.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick pass, read the introduction and Section 2 first. Section 2 is where the paper earns its keep: it defines and motivates branch externality clearly. Then read the part around Section 3.5 that explains why branch-level scheduling is cheaply reversible; that systems argument is what makes per-step control plausible. After that, read the TAPER mechanism itself: protected single-token progress, slack budget, greedy planning, and the pluggable utility interface. In the experiments, start with the main goodput and SLO tables, then inspect the workload statistics and the curves across operating points to see why fixed caps fail across regimes. A skim should take about 20–30 minutes. If you work on tree decoding, parallel reasoning, speculative branching, or serving schedulers, the latency model and admission planner are worth a closer read. If your focus is strictly pretraining, the main takeaway is enough.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会修正你对 branch-parallel decoding 的直觉：问题不在能不能并行，而在 externality 是否被计入；先看调度模型和 latency 曲线。
recommendation.en: This should update your intuition on branch-parallel decoding: the real issue is not whether branches can run, but whether their externality is priced in; read the scheduling model and latency curves first.

paper.title: Irminsul: MLA-Native Position-Independent Caching for Agentic LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Agentic LLM workloads put bit-identical tokens at shifted positions every turn, voiding prefix caches at the first byte of divergence. Operators report cache-hit regressions ranging from moderate slowdowns to severe TTFT spikes of 10-16s on unchanged content. Prior position-independent caching systems correct RoPE on the full $d_K$-dimensional key, an architectural cost imposed by GQA, not by caching itself. Multi-Head Latent Attention, deployed at scale in DeepSeek-V2/V3/R1, Kimi-K2/Moonlight,

summary.core_problem: Agent类LLM推理负载中，相同token经常出现在不同位置，导致传统前缀缓存失效；现有位置无关缓存（PIC）方案针对GQA架构设计，需要修正全维度K向量，开销过高无法落地。
summary.importance: 首次利用MLA（多头潜注意力）的KV结构特性实现生产级位置无关缓存，给大规模采用MLA架构的大模型推理服务提供了明确的缓存优化路径，也从工程落地角度验证了MLA架构相比传统GQA的实用优势。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Irminsul缓存系统，基于MLA将KV拆分为无位置信息的c_KV和仅64维带RoPE的k_r的结构，只需要对k_r做δ旋转修正即可复用任意位置的重复内容KV；采用基于内容定义分块（CDC）的内容哈希作为键，跳过序列开头的注意力沉区域避免精度损失，修正逻辑直接融合到FlashMLA算子中。
summary.experiments: 在1035条Agent推理轨迹（共5.1e7 tokens）上测试，CDC+回退策略比固定分块哈希多找到3.8~4.8倍的可复用KV；δ旋转修正的bf16相对L2误差为4.7e-3，不影响输出一致性；在16B/2.4B、16B/3B、48B/3B等多个MLA-MoE部署规模下验证有效，预填充能耗相比传统softmax注意力缓存降低63%~86%，Agent场景缓存命中率最高提升至p95 48%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3章Agent负载特征分析、第4章分块策略对比、第7章系统实现细节，预计阅读时间20分钟；做MLA推理优化的可重点关注RoPE修正的算子实现部分。

summary_en.core_problem: In agentic LLM inference workloads, identical tokens often appear at shifted positions, invalidating traditional prefix caches. Existing position-independent caching (PIC) solutions are designed for GQA architectures, requiring full-dimension K vector correction with prohibitively high overhead for production deployment.
summary_en.importance: First production-grade position-independent cache leveraging the KV structure property of Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), provides a clear cache optimization path for LLM inference services adopting MLA architecture, and verifies the practical advantage of MLA over traditional GQA from the engineering deployment perspective.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Irminsul, a MLA-native PIC system. Based on MLA's KV factorization into position-agnostic c_KV and a 64-dim RoPE-carrying k_r, only k_r needs δ-rotation correction to reuse repeated KV entries at any position. It uses content-defined chunking (CDC) based content hash as keys, skips the attention sink region at the start of sequences to avoid precision loss, and integrates the correction logic directly into FlashMLA kernels.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 1035 agentic inference trajectories (5.1e7 total tokens), CDC with fallback recovers 3.8~4.8x more reusable KV than fixed-block hashing. The δ-rotation correction has 4.7e-3 relative L2 error in bf16, with no impact on output consistency. Validated across multiple MLA-MoE deployment scales (16B/2.4B, 16B/3B, 48B/3B), reduces prefill energy by 63%~86% compared to traditional softmax attention caches, and achieves up to p95 48% cache hit rate in agentic scenarios.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on agentic workload characterization in Section 3, chunking strategy comparison in Section 4, system implementation details in Section 7, estimated reading time 20 minutes. For MLA inference optimization practitioners, refer to the RoPE correction kernel implementation part.

recommendation.zh: 只看 MLA cache 推导和实验表；它提醒架构选择会改变 serving 可复用性，不只是训练 FLOPs。
recommendation.en: Read the MLA cache derivation and tables; it shows that architecture choices affect serving reuse, not only training FLOPs.

paper.title: Federation of Experts: Communication Efficient Distributed Inference for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture of experts has emerged as the primary mechanism for making Large Language Models (LLMs) computationally efficient. However, in distributed settings, communicating token embeddings between experts is a significant bottleneck.   We present the novel Federation of Experts (FoE) architecture. FoE restructures the MoE block of a transformer layer into multiple MoE clusters. Each cluster is responsible for only one of the KV heads and expert parallelism is applied between those experts. Betwee

summary.core_problem: 在分布式 MoE 推理中，expert parallelism 需要 all-to-all dispatch/collect，跨节点网络带宽成为主要瓶颈；目标是在不明显损伤生成质量的前提下，把高代价的 all-to-all 通信结构性地限制在更小的局部范围内，从而降低 TTFT/TBT 并提升吞吐。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统/并行策略层面的工作，不属于预训练方法，但对“MoE 架构如何与硬件拓扑共设计”很有现实价值。它给出一种结构性改造：把 MoE block 拆成多个与 KV head 绑定的专家簇，用更便宜的跨簇同步替代全局 all-to-all。对做大规模 MoE 训练/推理的人来说，启发在于：路由空间不必全局共享；把路由约束到局部子空间，可能换来显著的通信收益，而质量损失可控。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Federation of Experts (FoE)：
- 将一个 transformer layer 的注意力与 MoE FFN 重构为 H 个相互独立的 MoE groups/clusters。
- 每个 group 拥有 1/H 的 KV heads 与 1/H 的 experts，并在该 group 内做 expert parallelism；token 在每个 group 内独立选择 k/H 个 experts（per-group routing），而不是在全体 experts 上做一次全局 top-k。
- 各 group 的 post-attention residual 通过一次相对轻量的跨组 all-reduce 求和/同步，形成下一层路由所需的共享输入；但最昂贵的 dispatch/combine（与 k 成正比的 all-to-all）被严格限制在 group 内。
- 设计目标是提高 Local Activation Rate（专家选择在本地 GPU/本节点内解决的比例），尤其在多节点 InfiniBand 场景下减少跨节点 token 迁移。
从实现角度看，它相当于把“专家维度的并行”与“注意力 KV head 的分片”绑定，并用结构约束换取通信可预测性与负载均衡。
summary.experiments:
论文报告在 LongBench 上做端到端推理评测：
- forward-pass latency 最多降低 5.2×
- TTFT 最多降低 3.62×
- TBT 最多降低 1.95×
并声称在相同规模与训练配置下，生成质量与标准 MoE 相当。
摘要与引言还提到：单机可完全消除 all-to-all（因为每组专家都落在同一 GPU 内），多机将 all-to-all 限制在组内，从而把跨节点通信压到更小。精读时需要核对：对比基线的 MoE 具体实现（路由、capacity factor、top-k）、硬件拓扑（节点数/链路）、batch/seq 长度设置，以及“质量相当”的量化指标。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
1) 先看架构图与并行/通信分析：FoE 如何把全局 all-to-all 变成组内 all-to-all + 组间 all-reduce。
2) 再看实验设置：单机 vs 多机的通信量分解、TTFT/TBT 的测量方法、LongBench 的上下文长度与 batch 策略。
预计 20–30 分钟可判断是否适合自家 MoE serving；若要落地，需要进一步看实现细节（路由约束对负载/质量的影响、与现有 EP/TP/PP 的组合方式）。

summary_en.core_problem: Distributed MoE inference is dominated by all-to-all token dispatch/collect in expert parallelism, especially across nodes where network bandwidth is far below intra-node interconnect. The goal is to restructure MoE so expensive communication is localized while preserving generation quality.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference/parallelism paper rather than a pretraining-method contribution, but it is highly relevant for anyone operating large MoE models. The key takeaway is architectural co-design with topology: you can constrain routing to local subspaces (instead of global top-k over all experts) and trade a small structural restriction for large, predictable communication savings.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Federation of Experts (FoE) partitions a transformer layer into H independent MoE clusters:
- Each cluster owns 1/H of the KV heads and 1/H of the experts.
- Routing is performed per cluster: each token selects k/H experts within every cluster, replacing a single global top-k over all experts.
- After attention, clusters synchronize post-attention residuals via a relatively cheap cross-cluster all-reduce (sum), which then feeds routing for the next MoE block.
- The expensive k-proportional all-to-all dispatch/combine is confined within each cluster, increasing the Local Activation Rate and reducing cross-node traffic.
Conceptually, it binds expert partitioning to KV-head partitioning and uses structural constraints to enforce locality and load balance.
summary_en.experiments: On LongBench, they report up to 5.2× reduction in end-to-end forward-pass latency, 3.62× improvement in time-to-first-token, and 1.95× improvement in time-between-tokens, with comparable generation quality to a standard MoE model under the same size/training configuration. For a serious evaluation, you’d want to verify: baseline MoE implementation details (routing, capacity), hardware topology and node count, batch/sequence settings, and how “comparable quality” is quantified.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in this order: (1) the architecture/communication diagrams and the argument turning global all-to-all into intra-cluster all-to-all + inter-cluster all-reduce; (2) the communication breakdown and TTFT/TBT measurement methodology; (3) the quality comparison protocol. ~20–30 minutes to assess fit for a serving stack; more time if you plan to integrate with existing EP/TP/PP setups.

recommendation.zh: MoE推理通信优化的聪明架构方案，将KV头分组与专家路由解耦设计值得一读，对大规模MoE推理部署有实际参考价值
recommendation.en: Clever architecture for MoE inference communication optimization; the KV-head grouping decoupled from expert routing design is worth reading, with practical value for large-scale MoE inference deployment

paper.title: Coral: Cost-Efficient Multi-LLM Serving over Heterogeneous Cloud GPUs
paper.abstract: The usage of large language models (LLMs) has grown increasingly fragmented, with no single model dominating. Meanwhile, cloud providers offer a wide range of mid-tier and older-generation GPUs that enjoy better availability and deliver comparable performance per dollar to top-tier hardware. To efficiently harness these heterogeneous resources for serving multiple LLMs concurrently, we introduce Coral, an adaptive heterogeneity-aware multi-LLM serving system. The key idea behind Coral is to join

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决多模型 LLM 在线服务中的联合优化问题：在云上 GPU 类型、价格、地域可用性不断变化的情况下，同时决定购买哪些异构节点，以及每个模型副本如何切分和放置，目标是在满足吞吐和延迟 SLO 的前提下降低成本。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对基座模型研究有工程参考价值。模型族和模型尺寸越来越分散，训练团队在评估模型发布形态时，不能只看单模型质量，也要考虑 serving 可部署性、异构硬件适配和多模型组合成本。Coral 的启发在于把模型 placement 从在线决策中拆出来，形成可缓存的 Serving Template。这类思路也会影响预训练阶段的架构取舍，例如模型大小、层宽、KV cache 占用、prefill/decode 比例，以及是否容易在非同构 GPU 上切分运行。
summary.technical_approach: Coral 将问题拆成离线和在线两阶段。离线阶段针对每个 model 和 latency SLO，枚举一组有代表性的节点组合，并用 ILP 求解该组合上的吞吐最优模型放置方案。求得的结果被缓存为 Serving Template。关键观察是：给定模型、SLO 和节点组合后，最优 placement 只依赖这个组合，不依赖其他模型如何占用集群。因此 placement 可以离线复用。在线阶段只需要用轻量 ILP 在不同 region、GPU 价格和可用性约束下选择模板，满足各模型的实时吞吐需求并最小化成本。系统实现使用 ZeroMQ 和 NCCL，单节点执行引擎基于 vLLM，同时构建了事件驱动模拟器来做大规模评估。
summary.experiments: 评估覆盖 6 个模型、5 类 GPU、20 种 GPU 配置，并考虑资源可用性和吞吐需求变化。论文报告 Coral 相比最强 baseline 最高降低 2.79 倍 serving cost；在资源稀缺场景下，最高获得 2.39 倍 goodput。在线求解时间从直接联合搜索可能需要的小时级降到几十秒级，使系统能够跟上价格、可用性和请求量变化。论文还强调，已有方法如果把每个模型副本当作 homogeneous black box，会漏掉大量异构 placement 的成本空间；反过来，如果只做单模型异构 placement，再在外层枚举资源分配，搜索开销不可接受。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。优先看问题形式化、Serving Template 的定义、离线 ILP 与在线 ILP 的分解理由，以及资源稀缺场景的评估。对预训练研究员来说，不必深挖系统实现细节；更值得关注的是异构 serving 约束如何反过来影响模型架构和模型规格设计。若关心推理成本建模，可以看 vLLM/NCCL runtime 与 simulator 的校准部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses joint optimization for serving many LLMs on heterogeneous cloud GPUs. Given per-model demand, latency SLOs, real-time GPU prices, and regional availability, the system must decide which nodes to provision and how to place each model replica across those nodes at minimum cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-serving paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model engineering. Model providers increasingly serve many model families and sizes at the same time, and cloud supply is heterogeneous. The result is that model quality alone is not enough; deployability across mixed GPUs also matters. Coral’s template-based decomposition is useful for thinking about how architecture choices affect serving cost: parameter count, layer shape, KV-cache footprint, prefill/decode balance, and the ease of tensor or pipeline partitioning across non-identical hardware.
summary_en.technical_approach: Coral decomposes the joint problem into an offline placement stage and an online allocation stage. Offline, for each model and latency SLO, it enumerates a selected set of node combinations and solves an ILP to find the throughput-optimal placement on each combination. The resulting artifact is a Serving Template. The key observation is that, once the model, SLO, and node combination are fixed, the best placement does not depend on how the rest of the cluster is allocated. Online, Coral solves a smaller ILP that selects templates across regions under current price and availability constraints to satisfy demand at minimum cost. The implementation uses ZeroMQ and NCCL, with vLLM as the per-node execution engine. The authors also build an event-based simulator for larger-scale evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 6 models, 5 GPU types, and 20 GPU configurations under changing demand and resource availability. Coral reduces serving cost by up to 2.79× over the strongest baseline. Under scarce availability, it delivers up to 2.39× higher goodput. The online solve runs in tens of seconds, compared with the hours-level cost implied by direct joint search or by wrapping single-model placement solvers inside an outer allocation enumeration. The experiments support the main design claim: treating each model replica as a homogeneous black box leaves cost savings unused, while solving full placement online is too slow for changing cloud conditions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on the problem formulation, the Serving Template abstraction, the offline/online ILP decomposition, and the scarce-resource evaluation. For pretraining researchers, the system-runtime details are less important than the implications for model design under heterogeneous serving constraints. If inference cost modeling is a focus, read the vLLM/NCCL runtime and simulator calibration sections more carefully.

recommendation.zh: 读系统模型和实验设置即可；它不会改变预训练 recipe，但会影响你对模型尺寸和 serving 成本的取舍。
recommendation.en: Skim the system model and setup; it will not change a pretraining recipe, but it may change size-vs-serving-cost decisions.

paper.title: Parallel Prefix Verification for Speculative Generation
paper.abstract: We introduce PARSE (PArallel pRefix Speculative Engine), a speculative generation framework that accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by parallelizing prefix verification on a semantic level. Existing speculative decoding methods are fundamentally limited by token-level equivalence: the target model must verify each token, leading to short acceptance lengths and modest speedups. Moving to semantic or segment-level verification can substantially increase acceptance granularity, but pr

summary.core_problem: 现有推测解码受限于逐token验证逻辑，接受长度短、加速上限低，语义级验证方法又存在串行校验开销大的缺陷。
summary.importance: 推理优化方向的方法创新，提出并行前缀验证机制，提升推测解码的实际加速潜力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PARSE框架，通过自定义注意力掩码让目标模型单次前向即可并行校验 draft 输出的多个前缀正确性，直接定位最长有效前缀，消除串行校验开销。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未披露完整实验设置，未给出具体模型参数量、基线方法对比及实际加速比数据。
summary.authors_note: 杜克大学、纽约大学研究者，无公开可查的大模型领域知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing speculative decoding methods are limited by token-level sequential verification, leading to short acceptance length and low speedup ceiling, while semantic-level verification suffers from high sequential check overhead.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation in inference optimization, proposes parallel prefix verification mechanism to improve practical speedup potential of speculative decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes PARSE framework, which uses custom attention mask to enable target model to verify correctness of multiple prefixes of draft output in a single forward pass, directly locate the longest valid prefix and eliminate sequential verification overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Full experiment setup is not disclosed in abstract, no specific model size, baseline comparison or actual speedup data is provided.
summary_en.authors_note: Researchers from Duke University and New York University, no well-known authors in large model field publicly identified.

recommendation.zh: 推理方向的增量创新，仅需了解其注意力掩码设计思路即可，无预训练相关启发。
recommendation.en: Incremental innovation in inference optimization, only the attention mask design idea is worth knowing, no insight for LLM pretraining.

paper.title: GhostServe: A Lightweight Checkpointing System in the Shadow for Fault-Tolerant LLM Serving
paper.abstract: The rise of million-token, agent-based applications has placed unprecedented demands on large language model (LLM) inference services. The long-running nature of these tasks increases their susceptibility to hardware and software faults, leading to costly job failures, wasted resources, and degraded user experience. The stateful key-value (KV) cache, which grows with the sequence length, presents a central challenge as it is a critical and vulnerable component in distributed serving systems. In

summary.core_problem: 在长上下文、长时间运行的 LLM 推理服务中，如何低成本且快速地实现 KV Cache 的容错和恢复？
summary.importance: 针对长文本推理中 KV Cache 丢失导致的高昂重计算成本问题，提出了一种基于纠删码的轻量级内存级容错方案，对提升 Serving 系统的可靠性有工程价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GhostServe 系统，在后台使用纠删码（Erasure Coding）对流式 KV Cache 进行编码，并将校验分片存储在主机内存中。当设备故障时，可利用这些分片快速重建丢失的 KV Cache，避免全量重计算。
summary.experiments: 评估表明，GhostServe 能够实现快速的 KV Cache 重建，使推理过程无缝恢复，且开销较低（具体数据需看原文）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to achieve low-cost and fast fault tolerance and recovery of KV Cache in long-context, long-running LLM inference services?
summary_en.importance: Addresses the high recomputation cost caused by KV Cache loss in long-context inference by proposing a lightweight, memory-level fault-tolerance scheme based on erasure coding, offering engineering value for improving Serving system reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes GhostServe, a system that applies erasure coding to the streaming KV Cache in the background and stores parity shards in host memory. Upon device failure, it rapidly reconstructs the lost KV Cache using these shards, avoiding full recomputation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations show GhostServe enables fast KV Cache reconstruction for seamless inference resumption with low overhead (specific data requires reading the full paper).

recommendation.zh: Serving 层的容错工程优化，用纠删码保护 KV Cache，适合做推理系统和部署的同学关注，预训练研究员可跳过。
recommendation.en: Fault-tolerance engineering optimization at the Serving layer, protecting KV Cache with erasure coding. Relevant for inference system engineers, but pre-training researchers can skip.

paper.title: Position: LLM Serving Needs Mathematical Optimization and Algorithmic Foundations, Not Just Heuristics
paper.abstract: This position paper argues that LLM inference serving has outgrown generic heuristics and now demands mathematical optimization and algorithmic foundations. Despite rapid advances in serving systems such as vLLM and SGLang, their algorithmic cores remain largely unchanged from classical distributed computing: request routing uses join-shortest-queue or round-robin, scheduling defaults to FIFO, and KV cache eviction follows LRU. These general-purpose policies ignore the distinctive structure of L

summary.core_problem: 这篇 position paper 讨论 LLM serving 仍大量依赖通用启发式策略，而这些策略没有刻画 LLM 推理特有的资源与调度结构，因而难以在复杂负载下稳定最优。
summary.importance: 价值主要在问题定义与研究议程设定，而不是新算法或系统结果。它把 LLM serving 中几个长期被工程经验主导的问题——路由、调度、KV cache 管理——重新表述为需要数学建模与可证明算法保证的优化问题。
summary.technical_approach: 作者没有提出具体可复现的新系统，而是用立场论文的方式指出现有 serving 核心策略仍多沿用经典分布式系统默认件：如 JSQ/round-robin 路由、FIFO 调度、LRU 驱逐。论文强调 LLM 推理有几类特殊性：KV cache 动态增长、prefill/decode 非对称、输出长度未知、continuous batching 耦合，这些因素使传统启发式在某些 workload 下会系统性失效，因此需要运筹优化与算法理论介入。
summary.experiments: 摘要未体现系统实验、规模化 benchmark 或定量对比，更像研究方向倡议。没有给出模型参数量、训练数据或标准 baseline 提升，因此证据强度主要来自问题拆解而非实证。

summary_en.core_problem: This position paper argues that LLM serving still relies heavily on generic heuristics, while those heuristics fail to capture the resource and scheduling structure unique to LLM inference.
summary_en.importance: Its value is in problem framing rather than a new algorithm or system result. It reframes routing, scheduling, and KV-cache management in LLM serving as optimization problems that need mathematical models and provable guarantees instead of ad hoc engineering rules.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper does not introduce a concrete reproducible system. Instead, it critiques common defaults such as JSQ or round-robin routing, FIFO scheduling, and LRU eviction. The key argument is that LLM inference has special structure—dynamically growing KV cache, strong prefill/decode asymmetry, unknown output lengths, and continuous batching constraints—so classical heuristics can fail systematically under realistic workloads.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not indicate substantial experiments, large-scale benchmarks, or quantitative comparisons. This reads as a research agenda piece rather than an empirical paper, so the evidence is mainly conceptual rather than experimental.

recommendation.zh: 不是结果型论文，但问题提得对；做 serving 或训练-推理协同的人看摘要即可，真正有用的是把 KV/调度当优化问题而不是继续调参。
recommendation.en: Not a results paper, but the diagnosis is directionally right; skim the abstract if you care about serving, and keep the framing that KV/scheduling should be treated as optimization problems rather than endless heuristic tuning.

paper.title: Belief-Guided Inference Control for Large Language Model Services via Verifiable Observations
paper.abstract: In black-box large language model (LLM) services, response reliability is often only partially observable at decision time, while stronger inference pathways incur substantial computational cost, inducing a budgeted sequential decision problem: for each request, the system should decide whether the default low-cost response is sufficiently reliable or whether additional computation should be allocated to improve response quality. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Ver}ifiable \textbf{O}bservation

summary.core_problem: 黑盒 LLM 服务中，系统需要在响应质量不可完全观测、强推理路径成本更高的条件下，为每个请求决定是否追加计算。
summary.importance: 这是推理服务控制问题，贡献类型偏系统方法。它把 adaptive inference routing 建模为带预算耦合的序贯决策，而不是单次置信度阈值判断。
summary.technical_approach: Veroic 将请求时推理控制形式化为 POMDP，用输入-输出对构造轻量的可验证观测通道，聚合异构质量信号，并维护关于潜在响应可靠性的 belief state。控制策略据此在默认低成本响应和额外计算路径之间做风险感知决策。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验设置、模型服务类型、数据集和量化收益；可确认其评估对象是黑盒 LLM 服务中的预算化序贯推理控制。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Sun Yat-sen University 等；给定机构字段中另有一项不完整的 The University of。

summary_en.core_problem: In black-box LLM services, the system must decide per request whether a low-cost response is reliable enough or whether to spend more compute, while reliability is only partially observable.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-service control contribution. It frames adaptive inference routing as a budget-coupled sequential decision problem rather than a one-shot confidence threshold.
summary_en.technical_approach: Veroic formulates request-time control as a POMDP. It builds a lightweight verifiable observation channel from the input-output pair, aggregates heterogeneous quality signals, and maintains a belief state over latent response reliability to make risk-aware escalation decisions.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not include full datasets, model services, baselines, or quantitative gains. The evaluation target is budgeted adaptive inference control for black-box LLM services.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Sun Yat-sen University; one institution entry in the provided metadata is incomplete.

recommendation.zh: 服务系统问题多于建模问题；读 POMDP 和信号聚合即可，作为黑盒路由工程参考，不影响 pretrain prior。
recommendation.en: More service control than modeling; skim the POMDP framing and signal aggregation as black-box routing engineering, not as a pretraining prior.

paper.title: Pythia: Toward Predictability-Driven Agent-Native LLM Serving
paper.abstract: As LLM applications grow more complex, developers are increasingly adopting multi-agent architectures to decompose workflows into specialized, collaborative components, introducing structure that constrains agent behavior and exposes useful semantic predictability. Unlike traditional LLM serving, which operates under highly dynamic and uncertain conditions, this structured topology enables opportunities to reduce runtime uncertainty -- yet existing systems fail to exploit it, treating agentic wo

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 multi-agent LLM 应用的 serving 问题：现有 serving 系统把 agent 工作流当成普通随机流量处理，忽略了 agent 图结构、角色分工和执行模式带来的可预测性，导致 prefix cache、调度和扩缩容效率低。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于推理服务系统方向，不是预训练论文。对基座研究员的启发在于，它说明 agent workload 与普通 chat workload 的系统瓶颈不同：长上下文、固定角色 prompt、阶段性突发、跨模型调用会改变模型部署侧的成本结构。这会反过来影响基座模型设计，例如上下文组织方式、prefix 复用友好性、模型路由、不同规模模型的协同部署，以及 agent-native 模型接口设计。
summary.technical_approach: Pythia 的核心思路是利用 multi-agent workflow 的结构可预测性。传统 serving 系统主要依赖运行时反馈，看到负载上升后再调度、迁移或扩容。Pythia 则尝试提前知道工作流图、agent 类型、各节点请求长度和执行时间分布，然后进行全局协调。系统包含几个关键机制：第一，用 example-driven synthesis 从示例执行中推断或补全工作流结构，降低开发者手动标注 agent 图的负担；第二，根据请求在工作流中的当前位置和 agent 的预期输出规模，估计剩余执行时间；第三，用这个估计做优先级调度，减少长请求和短请求互相阻塞；第四，利用预测结果做 prefix cache 预热和 proactive autoscaling，在下游 agent 被调用前准备资源。与通用 LLM serving 的区别在于，它不把所有请求都看成独立随机事件，而是把请求放回 agent workflow 中理解。
summary.experiments: 论文基于生产 agent-serving 平台 traces 和内部 multi-agent coding assistant 做分析。作者观察到三个主要瓶颈：第一，prefix cache 命中率低，因为不同 agent 使用不同系统 prompt，且同一 agent 调用之间间隔较长，缓存容易被驱逐；第二，workflow-agnostic 调度会把异质请求混在一起，引发副本间负载不均、显存竞争、preemption 和重算；第三，multi-agent 工作流会产生结构化突发，分钟级负载尖峰可超过 50%，反应式 autoscaling 难以及时处理。Pythia 的实验重点应是端到端延迟、队列时间、GPU 利用率、cache 命中率、preemption/recompute 开销和扩缩容提前量。给定内容中未提供完整性能数字，因此不应只看平均延迟，需要关注尾延迟和多模型级联拥塞是否下降。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 25–35 分钟。建议先看生产 trace 分析，这部分最有信息量，能帮助判断 agent workload 和普通 serving workload 的差异。然后看 workflow synthesis 和剩余执行时间估计机制，确认系统假设是否现实。实验部分重点看对比基线是否包括 vLLM 类通用 serving、是否在动态 agent 图上测试、是否报告尾延迟和资源利用率。若只关心预训练，可以跳过工程实现细节，重点保留对未来 agent-native 模型与 serving co-design 的启发。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses serving inefficiency in multi-agent LLM applications. Existing LLM serving systems treat agent requests as generic unpredictable traffic, while real agent workflows expose structure through fixed roles, workflow graphs, repeated prompts, and predictable execution patterns.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-serving paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from the workload shift. Agent systems create long-context bursts, role-specific prefixes, cross-model cascades, and structured fan-out. These properties affect the cost model of deployment and may feed back into model design choices: prefix reuse, context layout, model routing, mixtures of model sizes, and interfaces designed for agent-native execution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pythia exploits predictability in multi-agent workflows. Instead of relying only on reactive scheduling and autoscaling, it uses workflow structure and per-agent execution profiles to coordinate resources ahead of time. The system uses example-driven synthesis to infer or complete workflow graphs from example runs, which reduces the burden on developers who may not explicitly specify the graph. It then estimates a request’s remaining execution time from its current node and the expected output footprint of that agent. These estimates drive priority scheduling, cache warm-up, and proactive model autoscaling before downstream agents are invoked. The key distinction from generic LLM serving is that requests are not treated as independent events; they are scheduled in the context of a workflow.
summary_en.experiments: The paper analyzes production traces from an agent-serving platform and profiles an internal multi-agent coding assistant. The analysis identifies three bottlenecks: low prefix-cache effectiveness because different agents use distinct prompts and are separated by long temporal gaps; resource inefficiency from workflow-agnostic scheduling, including load imbalance, memory contention, preemption, and recomputation; and structured bursts in multi-agent workflows, with minute-level spikes exceeding 50%, which reactive autoscaling handles poorly. The provided text does not include full quantitative speedup numbers. The relevant metrics to inspect are end-to-end latency, tail latency, queueing delay, GPU utilization, prefix-cache hit rate, preemption/recompute overhead, and how early autoscaling decisions are made.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Start with the production trace analysis; it is the most useful part for understanding why agent workloads differ from ordinary chat serving. Then read the workflow synthesis and remaining-time estimation mechanisms to assess whether the assumptions are practical. In the evaluation, check whether the baselines include generic serving systems such as vLLM-style schedulers, whether dynamic workflow graphs are covered, and whether tail latency is reported. Readers focused on pretraining can skip most implementation details and retain the implications for agent-native model and serving co-design.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文；只看 trace 分析和 serving 接口，能提醒长上下文 Agent 负载会反向约束模型设计。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; read the trace analysis and serving interface as a signal for how long-context agent workloads may feed back into model design.

paper.title: Cloud to Edge: Benchmarking LLM Inference On Hardware-Accelerated Single-Board Computers
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly capable at small parameter scales. At the same time, conventional cloud-centric deployment introduces challenges around data privacy, latency, and cost that are acute in operational technology and defence environments. Advances in model distillation, quantisation, and affordable edge accelerators now make local LLM inference on single-board computers feasible, but the high dimensionality of the configuration space makes identifying optimal d

summary.core_problem: 评估小参数 LLM 在带硬件加速的单板计算机上本地推理时，如何同时权衡吞吐、延迟、能耗、成本和硬件利用率。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是效率评测方法和边缘部署基准。它不推进预训练方法，但对理解小模型、量化模型和边缘推理硬件之间的实际约束有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出多维度 benchmark 方法，在四种适合 IoT 的边缘平台配置上测试 LLM 推理，并把模型推理性能与硬件效率联合评价。重点不是新模型，而是覆盖真实单板计算机和硬件加速器配置空间。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明测试四种边缘平台配置，并对比现有 CPU-only 或泛化任务的边缘 LLM benchmark；提供片段未给出具体模型规模、量化格式、吞吐/延迟/能耗数值和最终排序。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Lebanese American University、Carnegie Mellon University 和 University of Exeter。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to benchmark local LLM inference on hardware-accelerated single-board computers while jointly measuring latency, throughput, energy, cost, and hardware efficiency.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an edge-inference benchmarking methodology rather than a modeling advance. It is useful for understanding practical constraints around small LLMs, quantization, and accelerator-backed edge deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a multi-dimensional benchmark across four IoT-suitable edge platform configurations, evaluating both inference performance and hardware efficiency. The focus is real single-board computer coverage, not a new model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments over four edge platform configurations and positions the work against CPU-only or generic-task edge LLM benchmarks. The provided excerpt does not include exact model sizes, quantization settings, latency, throughput, or energy numbers.

recommendation.zh: 作为边缘部署配置表备查即可；对预训练没有新信号，最多看 benchmark 维度设计。
